notes.title: Napoleonic multiplayer shooter celebrates "massive response" to crossplay update
notes.content:
Multiplayer first-and-third-person shooter Holdfast: Nations at War isn't new to PC, but it's currently seeing a resurgence thanks to the launch of a crossplay update. The roleplay-friendly war game, which includes conflicts across both the Napoleonic Wars and World War I, has just landed on consoles, spurring a new player count record. Developer Anvil Game Studios thanks the community for its "massive response" across all platforms, saying the launch "will be a day to remember."

Read the rest of the story...

Before taking a read of the blog, if you haven't already be sure to watch the official release date announcement trailer for Holdfast on consoles. 
[/p][previewyoutube="K898a8yIWCI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
As we approach the ever so exciting console release, we're here to dish out a few more tweaks and balances to further prepare the game for launch day. Featuring new quality of life improvements, gameplay tweaks and a load of bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]QOL & Gameplay [/h2][p]
A small focus of the update was to improve the squad camp experience, now players will be offered to join other squads if their squad camp is destroyed or not set up. Players spawning fresh into the round will also be prompted to join a random squad from the available list.[/p][p][/p][p]To further promote squad gameplay and improve some balancing we've taken a pass over the classes that are allowed to spawn on squad camps  Here are the changes we've undertaken:[/p][list][*][p]Light Infantry from 3 to Unlimited[/p][/*][*][p]Rifleman from 0 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Musician from 2 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Flag Bearer from 1 to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Surgeon from 1 to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Carpenter from 1 to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Sergeant from 1 to 2[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The squad camp ability has also had its cooldown reduced to just 2 minutes.


[img src="https://i.imgur.com/YUt97Jd.gif"][/img][/p][p] 
To tackle a long stemming issue of new players especially not knowing what combat state the player is in, players using a controller will now also be given a new indication when using a firearm and swapping from shooting to melee mode and vice versa. This can be disabled via the options for those who don't wish to see it.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just handful of the changes and additions with this release, for a more detailed view of the tweaks and fixes check out the changelog linked at the bottom of the post.[/p][p][/p][p]Do let us know on Discord if you face any issues folks. We’ll be sure to look into it. notes.title: Game Update! Tweaks & Balances
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d8e736231f8ddc7b8729e9156adab1edf6149079.png[/img]

Holdfast updated! Continuing strong in our mission of polishing up the game and making it ever more accessible we’re pleased to announce the release of this next update.

Featuring a plethora of quality of life features, optimisations and bug fixes, this release steers us ever closer to completing our mission and eventually what will be one of Holdfast’s biggest releases to date. 

More on that in future posts, for now take a look at everything coming with this update down below.

[h2]QOL & Gameplay[/h2]

Quality of life was a key focus of this release. Keeping the game fresh and up to par with modern standards is a key element required to bring Holdfast into the new era. 

Capturing the last point on the Army Siege game mode will now immediately end the match. This has been introduced to combat 'backcaping' on certain maps where it was prevalent. 

Extended capture zones have been tentatively introduced firstly for Frontlines Invasion maps that feature beach landings. These extended zones allow for more unique capture zone layouts and will eventually make their way into the Napoleonic side of the game should they be required. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f35254b069bd4ce96007acf9f5a723409a24e87c.png[/img]
A slew of new indicators to better distinguish your characters states have also been introduced. You’ll primarily notice these when reloading, attaching and detaching your bayonet and when performing other actions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dod1UaD.gif[/img]

One of the more obvious of these changes is the new addition of showing the playercard of the enemy you have just killed. This will allow you to see the accolades and titles immediate of the player you’ve just bested in combat.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8t406LQ.gif[/img]

Another part of this update was refreshing the public server experience, this included multiple reinforcement changes to maps along with improved map voting functionality in order to provide a more varied experience on Army Siege, Army Battlefield and Army Conquest maps.

[h2]Event Hosts - A Call To Arms [/h2]

Are you an enjoyer of all the regimented chaos that Holdfast Linebattles offer? We’re looking for the next generation of Event Hosts to join our team of dedicated volunteers who host the weekly Official Public Linebattle events.

You’ll also be able to take advantage of our Event Host rewards programme featuring unique in-game rewards and free DLC as a show of thanks for your efforts. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//28169799/b6c3aa9674d32d64642b471c50909db265d1e047.png[/img]

So… Think you have what it takes to run these 200+ player events with your fellow hosts? Then enlist today via the form below to get involved.

[url=https://forms.gle/B1VMkjwrHzLLEess9]Event Host Application[/url]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Optimisations[/h2]

The team has been very hard at work and making good progress with our optimisation efforts. The last release saw some impressive performance increases and we’ve since been taking good care in addressing any regressions that may have occurred - Check out the massive changelog for all the intricate details.

Multiple RAM-oriented optimisations have been done to improve performance on lower end hardware along with yet another large reduction in the overall file size of the game. Taking it down from 19 Gigabytes to just 17 Gigabytes.

The game engine has also been upgraded to expose even more potential optimisation techniques and methods for future releases.

Do let us know on Discord if you face any issues folks. We’ll be sure to look into it. As always, we thank you for your generous support, and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Game Update! Optimisations & Community Rewards
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//28169799/ca9b3f881109ee195357985a984832c5de590786.png[/img]

Holdfast updated! After some months of dedicated and hard work we’re pleased to announce the release of this performance and optimisation update.

It introduces community rewards and brings forth a whole slew of optimisation that will cater to more consistent and stable framerates and hopefully provide an overall smoother Holdfast experience across the board. 

Find out more by taking a read all about it in greater detail below.

[h2]Performance[/h2]

Staying true with our commitment to continue bringing Holdfast into the new age, this rather large optimisation pass we’ve undertaken will be a key instrument into making the game more accessible and playable for generations new and old.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TQP3Dpd.gif[/img]

It is a major step forward in our ongoing efforts to support Holdfast and its beloved community for years to come. It certainly wasn’t an easy task but a necessary one and involved looking back at almost 8 years worth of game's art, systems and processes then bringing them up to our current standard.

The art team dedicated time optimising old meshes and where missing introduced new lower detailed meshes that will get rendered at a distance. A good portion of the textures were also optimised to further improve ram usage along with much stricter animation culling. Lastly, the ever-dedicated fellows in the programming team continued doing their magic to reduce RAM and improve CPU utilisation.

All this and more had the added benefit of the games install now being even smaller by a few gigabytes. 

This truly only grazes the surface of the work undertaken by the team these past few months. It’s almost impossible to count the many changes made. Expect more to follow on this front in future releases.

Despite the many testing passes this release has undergone, there's of course a chance some bugs may have slipped through the net. Should you encounter any of these then please do report them via the #bug-reports channel in our official Discord server linked at the end of this post.

[h2]Community Contributions[/h2]

A portion of this update brings entirely new rewards for players who go above and beyond the call of duty. 

From event hosts to workshop modders and everything in between, those who lend a helpful hand or create something truly special will be granted (by our discretion) a whole slew of new medals and rewards to showcase their brilliance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b6c3aa9674d32d64642b471c50909db265d1e047.png[/img]

We’ll begin awarding theses out in the coming months retroactively and look forward to awarding them to many more of you in the future. If you are wanting to take that next step in helping to grow the great Holdfast community, then head over to our Discord server and get involved.

[h2]Regiments[/h2]

Have the inner desire to stand in the rank and file or sail the seven with a more regimented experiences?  Earn your 40 shillings and enlist for a regiment today to participate in 200 player organised events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/aca6b6ad70f8a07b338ababeec5dbf403482f758.png[/img]

It’s easy to apply, there’s plenty of regiments, crews and communities available via the main menu’s Regiment Registry tab. Regiments offer access to private events, unique ranking structures and have that great Holdfast community spirit.

Alternatively you can check out the Regiment Registry in the official Discord server. Our welcoming community would be more than willing to show you the ropes.

notes.title: Game Update! Audio Mastering
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca9b3f881109ee195357985a984832c5de590786.png[/img]
Good fellows of the Holdfast community we’re kicking off the new year by taking a much-needed look at the game’s audio. Having trouble hearing those valiant officers in command in the chaos-ridden battlefield of Holdfast? Fret no longer as it’s now a thing of the past.

Should you be looking at further customising your experience you can easily do so by heading over to the game’s audio settings. Configure voice chat, weapons, artillery, weather and a whole lot more audio sliders individually.

Wondering about what’s next to come? Continue reading below.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Performance improvements will be the primary focus of the upcoming release hitting Holdfast this Q1 2025. Despite the major complexities involved in optimising massive 150+ players battles, everyone in the team is committed to delivering a smoother experience.

Here’s to another great year of Holdfast with you, our most beloved community. You enable us to make this all happen. A thank you and salute from all of us at Anvil Game Studios as we move onwards to yet another exciting year for Holdfast.

Until next time, we wish you all the best and may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Holdfast Frontlines WW1 2.0 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d32e50614e577ae491bec28d8279e853180baa45.png[/img]
Gentlemen! The time has come to head back to the trenches once again to fight for king and country. Engage in a [b]150+ player WW1 experience[/b] spanning land and sea in this [b]FREE total conversion DLC [/b]for Holdfast: Nations At War.

There's a whole lot to get through in this one so before diving in take a watch of the official Frontlines release trailer below.

[previewyoutube=ZJqtULn5hOs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Holdfast Great War Pack[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25824/Great_War_Pack/

[h2]The Trench Raider[/h2]

Storm the trenches as the armoured trench raider class. Equipped with a trench gun, a trusty axe and a handful of smoke or HE grenades, this fellow will clear a trench in no time should you let him get close. 

Their armour does more than just make them look dashing, when face on to enemies you'll take significantly less damage as you surge forward in a rage with the 'Raid' ability gathering yourself an additional 20% speed boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca481c8557bd6a1fa5c8649e2f54093148bac144.png[/img]

A sturdy headshot will still stop these fellows in their tracks however so do watch out for those crack shots!

[h2]10 New Diverse Battlefields[/h2]

10 new unique battlefields have been released alongside this update. 4 new invasion scenarios and 6 new offensive maps ready to set the stage for some Frontlines glory. 

[b]Over The Top (Invasion)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dJG1PFD.gif[/img]
Inspired by great period films of our times. Over The Top offers an immersive trench experience. With rows of dug in trench lines and no mans land, fight your way to the final train yard objective and secure a victory for the allied forces.

[b]Estate (Invasion)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lz3co9D.gif[/img]
Battle up the steep cliffs from the bombarded shorelines and capture the grand Estate that overlooks a trench filled battleground.

[b]Kingsman Bay (Invasion)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y785Q6S.gif[/img]
Storm the beaches and fortresses of Kingsman Bay and assert dominance over the chains of rocky coastlines.

[b]Red Tides (Invasion)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tzLjxi.gif[/img]
Push your way across multiple islands with support from the Dreadnoughts and 3-inch Gunboats then siege the great fortress that overlooks the field of play.

[b]Archipelago (Offensive)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GMiBSbM.gif[/img]
Tropical and engaging! Archipelago features an explosive mixture of naval and land warfare.

[b]Charleville (Offensive)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JcHOoxo.gif[/img]
Fight for supremacy over the town of Charleville, full of alleyways, murals, buildings and a grand clock tower.

[b]Stalemate (Offensive)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uYnxOfV.gif[/img]
Get close up and personal with your enemy on this cramped rocky offensive map that truly represents the chaos of shotgun warfare.

[b]Junction (Offensive)[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6PjTOhO.gif[/img]
The winner of the Battlefield Forger 2.0 mapping contest Junction, created by Spammy McJunkmail, puts you in a battle across railroads overlooked by harsh cliffs. Take control of the station or defend the factory that overlooks this industrial hub. 

..... and a whole lot more! Play today to discover Requiem and Depot.

[h2]Hailing Aloud[/h2]

Bark orders or hail from afar with the brand new loudhailer! This useful tool will be made available for officers and captains across both the WW1 and Napoleonic fronts. With an increased VoIP range and a sprinkle of reverb this is most definitely going to be an officers dream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/718fdb4a032ed17c99bbfc7c1f513d745d4efe43.png[/img]
[h2]Daunting Coast Gun[/h2]

Defends the shores from enemy invaders with the powerful Coastal Gun making its way to the coasts of Frontlines. This great beast can take down Steamboats and leaves a pretty nasty mark on infantrymen too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ogQCtWI.gif[/img]

[h2]2-Gun Steamboat[/h2]

Hop aboard the 2-Gun Steamboat and assist your allies landing on the shorelines with blasts of 3-inch shelling. This grand new artillery ship will be of great help when storming the beaches and fortresses of Frontlines' invasion scenarios. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/krEqer9.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapon Unlocks[/h2]

Following through with the introduction of the decorated weapons for Nations At War, Frontlines now too has a whole slew of new firearms to unlock. With entirely new models, textures and designs these weapons will make you stand out as you launch your assault over the top.

Check these new weapons out in first-person by pressing the 'C' key.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yu10W12.gif[/img]

[h2]Winter Uniforms[/h2]

Wrap up warm from the cold with the newly introduced Winter Uniforms for the Rifleman class. Inspired by the Battlefield Forger Uniform winning entry by Binghampton, these exceptional uniforms keep you nice and toasty during these winter months.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GrpuefG.gif[/img]

This post truly doesn’t do justice to the amount of new features and changes for this major update for the game so be sure to take a read of the entire changelog below and keep an eye out for more yet to come.

notes.title: Head To The Trenches December 19th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/92295d9e245bfd5825cca6cd1953cce199be9d44.png[/img]
Incoming! Prepare to head back to the trenches once more with the major Frontlines 2.0 update releasing [b]December 19th 2024[/b]. 

Embark on large scale amphibious invasions and advance through war torn trench lines in this major release coming for free to the game. From a new class to a whole lot more this update will land us back in the trenches before Christmas. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W0eGf1I.gif[/img]

Over the course of the days leading up to the release we'll be sharing some sneak previews of some of the new additions to the game. Take a read below to checkout today's sneak peak.

[h2]The Trench Raider![/h2]

Storm the trenches as the armoured trench raider class. Equipped with a Trench Gun, a trusty axe and a handful of smoke or HE grenades, this fellow will clear a trench in no time should you let him get close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca481c8557bd6a1fa5c8649e2f54093148bac144.png[/img]
Their armour does more than just make them look dashing, when face on to enemies you'll take significantly less damage as you surge forward in a rage with the 'Raid' ability gathering yourself an additional 20% speed boost.

A sturdy headshot will still stop these fellows in their tracks however so do watch out for those crack shots!

[h2]Hailing Aloud![/h2]

Bark orders or hail from afar with the brand new loudhailer! This useful tool will be made available for officers and captains across both the WW1 and Napoleonic fronts. With an increased VOIP range and a sprinkle of reverb this is most definitely going to be an officers dream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/718fdb4a032ed17c99bbfc7c1f513d745d4efe43.png[/img]
[h2]Over The Top![/h2]

1 of the 10 new maps coming to the game with this release will be the new invasion map 'Over The Top'. Inspired by great period films of our times this cinematic masterpiece offers an immersive trench experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG3gj72.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SieVGtP.gif[/img]

With rows of dug in trench lines and no mans land, fight your way to the final train yard objective and secure a victory for the allied forces.

Be sure to join the official Discord where we’ll be [b]featuring snippets of the update[/b] leading to the release just on the horizon. Keep your eyes peeled as we have plenty more in store for Holdfast’s Napoleonic and WW1 fronts.

notes.title: Field Orders! Fixes & Additions V2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca9b3f881109ee195357985a984832c5de590786.png[/img]
Firstly, a thanks from the AGS team for all your support and feedback since the games latest release. It’s been a great joy to see players old and new on the battlefields of Holdfast. We’d also like to extend this thanks to those who obtained the latest Blackpowder Firearms DLC. Your generosity allows us to continue bringing this genre of games we all love so dearly into the limelight. :oheart:

[h3]Holdfast Updated[/h3]
Following up from the update prior, we’re pushing through today an update that introduces a new feat chain that provides shilling rewards for levelling classes along with tackling the most pressing bugs and providing more stability to the game's new unlock and levelling systems. We're also dishing out a few additions based on community feedback including the ability to view one's class level experience and other gameplay-focused adjustments to the orders system.

It’s important to note that all levels and unlock data was correct on the server side and that those who experienced high-levelling or level reductions would have had a visual client bug which has now been addressed to correctly show the accurate data. All progress is retained.

[h3]Building Legacy[/h3]
A new feat chain ‘Building Legacy’ has been introduced which will reward players for reaching certain milestones with a class.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1c7a5243f10d2fc2b1a6ad89a0c89c65071c831a.png[/img]
Earn the King's shilling by reaching class rank 10, 25 and 40 for a total shilling reward of 1,500 plus get an additional playercard title ‘Battle Cry’ for completing all 3 feats. Those who levelled a class previously to any of the ranks will retrospectively receive the rewards providing them with an additional head-start alongside the prestigious 'Williamson' unlocks. Complete a single round on an official server to reap the rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2b0bcc72099f9a9f40b70dbfd4a015795614cad4.gif[/img]

Shillings will forever remain obtainable only through in-game achievements. We've stuck with cosmetic-only DLCs throughout these long-years to enable us to continue supporting Holdfast and we don't plan on changing that.

[h3]Sale, Sale, Sale![/h3]
With the latest major update to the game there’s no better time to [b]hop on Holdfast[/b] for a massive 50% off. Through grit and might, fight along order chains and earn shillings to unlock decorated muskets, heads and melee weaponry to stand out on the chaotic 150+ player battlefields. The game's cosmetic-only DLCs can now also be purchased for a discount of up to 50% off too.

notes.title: Field Orders! Pans & Unlocks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca9b3f881109ee195357985a984832c5de590786.png[/img]
Shoulder arms and await further orders! The next major release for Holdfast: Nations At War is here.   Earn the King's shilling by completing orders and unlock new cosmetics to make your characters stand out from the rank and file. 

From Spanish muskets to backpacks, siege map reworks, bug fixes and much more we’ve got you covered. This update brings a whole slew of new additions to the game and complete overhaul of the game's progression system.

Plus the release of the brand new Blackpowder Firearms cosmetic DLC to compliment the new progression systems available in the game.

[b]Blackpowder Firearms DLC[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320400/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__Blackpowder_Firearms

Before diving in, be sure to take a read below of everything this release has to offer.


[h2]Order In The Ranks[/h2]

One of the largest overhauls to the games progression and customisation system releases with this update. Now, alongside having an individual level for each class, players will have a singular Soldier Rank, displayed on their playercard, with a max rank of 50 which is also tied into the new orders system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/435e14712a945bd26cd348f52511d342f30cb658.png[/img]
This order system introduces over 120 unique field orders to complete on the battlefields of Holdfast in turn rewarding you with Shillings to spend within the barracks. These Shillings can only be obtained through in-game orders. Chains of orders can likewise be completed to earn additional shilling rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/09228030b6d307a1cc024521a1250cde74971291.gif[/img]

Order tiers are locked through Solder Rank and orders within them can only be completed or progressed if they’re selected in one of the four active order slots. To add an active order, simply navigate to the armoury, select a slot in the active orders container and then select an order to replace it with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3d0c010b5c5a3a0d4a4fd9595a1dd075757e274e.gif[/img]

But that’s not all… Show your might and mettle through Feats of Strength that reward you with an even grandeur number of cosmetics to unlock for your player profile and exclusive character unlocks. Keen on featuring a few unique medals for your player profile? Start looking here.

We’ve taken some inspiration from the community for a few of these and also made sure to pay homage and references beloved era films and a solid serving of puns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e68edbe095ea33d0491883d31183b16ccb36c9fa.png[/img]
If that’s still not enough, you’ll also be able to complete simple daily missions to earn a small amount of extra shillings and gather an XP increase. Should none of them take your fancy, feel free to use a limited re-roll to change the mission to one that's easier to complete but features a smaller reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/253082f1356771c1557bb6aeee966f4070caa4be.png[/img]
Something key to highlight is that under this new order and shilling system cosmetic unlocks are now universal across all classes. Purchasing a head, backpack or weapon with shillings will unlock it for available classes. 

This has unfortunately meant that heads and weapons previously unlocked via class rank have had to be re-locked under the new shilling system. Special player profile unlocks and cosmetics have however been introduced to commemorate those who reached various milestones such as levelling a class to 75 on the previous legacy progression system.

This chain rewarding the most-veteran of players features a new medal, the 'Sweaty' title and the 'Freddy Williamson' head unlocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5ad4ab6871c02525d453a290f9ce80f621f26862.png[/img]

[h2]Just A Touch Of Paint[/h2]

Dropdowns be gone! To accommodate the new cosmetics, a complete rework of the games barracks and in-game class selection spawn screen has been undertaken. This new design brings to the front and centre a plethora of new cosmetic unlocks that can quickly and easily be purchased with shillings and equipped onto your character.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BXQaFA7.gif[/img]

We’ve also simplified a lot of the sections to give way for more clarity and useful information pertaining to your classes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/35e64dfe3b2c032f6c151ea293f6f62b9540fc78.png[/img]
In the barracks you’ll also be able to easily customise your player profile with a barrel full of new playercard banners, portraits, medals and titles to purchase with shillings or unlock through feats of strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c0ee4b093ec5cc323f3ba60ee16893dba1033a24.png[/img]

[h2]Pans, Backpacks and Guns![/h2]

Every Nations At War firearm has received a new lick of paint and model touch up along with special decorated and rusty variants to select from. Those who wish to go camping may now do so and pack up all their troubles in an old kit bag. Backpacks can now be purchased with shillings via the barracks. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PAH388k.gif[/img]

Of course, no camping trip is complete without a bit of food so make sure to pack your pans too! Bonk people on the head, or give em a smack round the chops, with the brand new frying pan sword weapon skin. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNwbJT7.gif[/img]

Featuring unique hit and block sounds plus a special unlockable gold coated version for those who take their pan action to the highest of levels.

Officers will also find 2 new Legendary Officer Sword skins available for unlock. These are the glistening ‘Napoleon’s Sword’ and a entirely unique looking ‘Yatagan Sword’. Musket enjoyers will also be able to sport the Legendary 'Iroquois Musket'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/219c01fdf30d76fc34791eeb42c396d7ddc7bb0b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Blackpowder Firearms DLC[/h2]

With valour and glory, march onto the battlefields of Holdfast with a brand new selection of firearms featuring entirely new models and decorated details to make you stand out in the rank and file. From Nock Guns to Sporting Rifles this weapon pack has it all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0b35516c6dbbb712e7443bbc4276f63a16f49bae.jpg[/img]
The Blackpowder Firearms pack features 6 new unique firearms unlocked by default plus an additional 6 decorated versions that can be unlocked by completing the 6 new feats of strength challenges that are also unlocked by this pack.

Content present in Holdfast: Nations At War DLCs is purely cosmetic. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay. Your kind generosity will be put to good use and bring this genre of [b]roleplay warfare[/b] games that all of us are fond of into the limelight.

[b]Blackpowder Firearms DLC[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320400/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__Blackpowder_Firearms


[h2]The Great Siege Map Rework[/h2]

Following the previous releases implementation of Squad Camps onto the siege gamemode we’ve been hard at work monitoring gameplay and identifying areas of maps which could play better. 

This first pass tackles maps that most needed some attention. Fort Pierre, Al Farid, Darial and Christina have undergone important changes to better improve the experience. Fort Christina and Al Farid in particular underwent some drastic improvements to provide both attackers and defenders an enjoyable and balanced fight.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vVbRhIu.gif[/img]

Other changes were made to most siege maps and can be found in the full change log at the end of the post.


[h2]Achievements Return[/h2]

Fixing the achievements system for the game was also at the forefront of this update and we have now not only made the system far more robust and reliable but we’ve also tied it in to the in-game feats of strength and orders features found within the Armoury.

A complete redesign of the look of the Steam Achievement will now give some well deserved flair to those heard earned feats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/66c9feeb3e4cc1819458641b98d7b1bb60a40818.jpg[/img]

There's plenty more still to come before the years end and beyond. From preparing to head over the top once more, to marching into new found land, there's a lot left in store for Holdfast.

Be sure to take a read of the entire changelog below and keep an eye out for more yet to come. Your support always comes most appreciated and it allows us to continue developing the game we all love. Until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Battlefields Expanded! Server Queue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b299ea81d741685ac411d1c7b1f41d4b1e89554a.png[/img]
[b]Follow Us On Steam[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/anvilgamestudios


Rally the troops and prepare to march to pastures new with the release of the Battlefields Expanded major update! Featuring the long awaited queue system, 8 entirely new maps, a complete overhaul to existing game levels along with a volley full of features pertaining to Holdfast's squad system and so much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/62fdf130b53b8efb81af4d513aeaff037ed80e5c.png[/img]

Take a read of everything below to get a taste of the scale this update has to offer.

[h2]British Person Simulator[/h2]

Thanks to a complete overhaul of our back-end across previous updates totaling to over 9 months worth of development hours, we’ve been able to develop some long awaited features for the game. One such feature is a server queue system which will now be implemented across all official servers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4a3f71a230f391b88c999473bd03cc667ecb5154.gif[/img]

When a server becomes full, players wishing to connect will be placed within a queue. As slots become available your position in the queue will advance until you are the next to join. Players will also be prompted to join a recommended server should they not wish to wait around for a slot to become available. 

You’re also free to continue browsing the main menu or head over to the barracks to customise your character as you wait in queue.

[h2]8 New Battlefields[/h2]

To compliment the new queue system and to help keep fighting engaging for those populating fresh servers, [b]8 entirely new maps[/b] have been added into the public rotation.

Buckland Banks, Crossroads, Convoy, Domont Gardens, Isle of Wake, Lindisfarne, Tropics and Vestiges are all playable across both the Army Battlefield and Army Conquest game modes. Each map features a unique environment and design along with some new playful additions that’ll make for some good fun.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9UvWjI3.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wOTCtv5.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3u7JJAP.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OBZogzz.gif[/img]

[h2]Reinventing The Wheel[/h2]

Alongside the new additions to the battlefields of Holdfast. we also took the time to go back and rework some of the game's longest serving maps, some of which dated back to the game's release on Early Access in 2017.

A good majority of these changes were environmental changes, especially the Oak Environment which was entirely overhauled [i](thanks to the Oak summoning circle 🌳)[/i] but with some maps we paid extra attention to the design of their gameplay areas and issue some much needed improvements. 

We’ve made sure to pay proper tribute to these classics by staying true to their character while bringing them into the new age. Check out the full change log for a list of all the maps that have undergone a redesign.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CfrGB4B.gif[/img]

[h2]Squading Up[/h2]

This update also brings with it a plethora of quality of life changes, namely we’ve taken a look at the officer squad camp system to further improve the flow of both placing and joining squad camps.

A new ability bind for placing the squad camp has been added for the officer along with the new 'Reinforce' order allowing them to ping a location to direct their squad members. Officers now gather experience for kills earned by their squad members.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y1tnrZk.gif[/img]

Gather up squad mates with greater ease while playing as the officer class! Now players will be able to enlist in your squad simply by running up to you or your squad camp and pressing their ‘USE’ key.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WBeutUI.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fZBvK7S.gif[/img]

Additionally, all players no yet in a squad will be notified with a small widget when a squad camp is placed for the first time. Simply hold ‘USE’ to join a squad when this quick widget pops up and you’ll respawn at the camp upon next life.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dDdmnLj.gif[/img]

In efforts to improve the general siege experience, attacking forces are now able to employ the use of Officer Squad Camps in order to gain additional attacking positions during a siege promoting a much more engaging gameplay for those on both sides of the engagement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8oOvwOx.gif[/img]

The locations in which these tents can be placed has been heavily restricted in order to maintain a good game-play balance and reinforcements have been adjusted accordingly. 

We look forward to welcoming any and all feedback regarding these changes.

[h2]Quality Of Life Changes[/h2]

Finally a brief look at some of the many quality of life additions we’ve implemented this update. On first game launch players will now be prompted to calibrate their monitors to the desired brightness, this can be adjusted again via the games video settings tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c38cb3939937960a2d5412e43ef5909d305fb7a6.gif[/img]

For further clarity on intractable objects a new highlight effect will show around objects which you can interact with. Similarly, sapper objects that cannot be built due to a obstruction will now appear slightly transparent.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XcZNxzC.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ezt9eHQ.gif[/img]

Faction balancing has also been adjusted to prevent one faction from having an overwhelming number of player on low-pop servers and will reactively adjust according to the number of players in the server.

This post truly doesn’t do justice to the amount of new features, changes and general development time taken for this major update for the game. It comes as part of one of many updates focused to continue with our aim of bring Holdfast into the new era. 

Be sure to take a read of the entire changelog below and keep an eye out for more yet to come. Your support always comes most appreciated and it allows us to continue developing the game we all love. Until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Holdfast Launches On Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/127d3639cc2a32ef322c58220ecafd3c0232496f.png[/img]
Engage in large scale Holdfast battles on the go with the official verification and release of Holdfast: Nations At War on the Steam Deck. From land to sea you'll now be able to partake in all that Holdfast goodness in powerful handheld format.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ddcfbe84f80067a0a21aa966ffb3887dca9182c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/59195829702112fff1527cb1c8364c6d4a10782e.png[/img]
As part of our efforts to bring Holdfast into the new age, a portion of the team has been hard at work not only making Holdfast accessible for those who prefer to play with a controller but also gaining the verification and official support for the Steam Deck console. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/bce1dd1512f51dd0660b1a51925cb707d281ec69.gif[/img]

Development with the Steam Deck was pleasantly straightforward and a lot of the game worked with little to no intervention. With a few touch ups and thanks to the Steam Deck's powerful hardware and brilliant design, it happily runs Holdfast and it's shenanigans with great graphical fidelity and at an impressive frame rate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5fce3c1d47cb993ad7b3ccc9b5229cbad611874f.png[/img]

[h2]On The Horizon[/h2]

Following up this Steam Deck release, next month will introduce the [b]Battlefields Expanded[/b] update, the largest undertaking of map reworks we have done to date. Featuring improved gameplay designs, new environments and much more. Every single Nations At War map has been looked over and updated to our current standard.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zvvomMq.gif[/img]

But that's not all! Alongside the map reworks we will be bringing [b]8 entirely new public play battlefields[/b] that will be made available for both low and high population servers. These maps will compliment the queue system that'll also be featured within this update. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RCA4Ze4.gif[/img]

Quality of life improvements have also been on the forefront of this update and part of this will include easier ways to join squads created by officers. Get ready to rally the troops! One of these new ways will be a prompt on the officer itself allowing nearby players to simply interact with the officer to join their squad. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fZBvK7S.gif[/img]

The above is just a taste of a plethora of new features and additions to the game, there's plenty more that'll be dropping with this update. Public testing is currently ongoing with an estimated release scheduled for next month once the testing phase has concluded. 

Want to take part in the next Public BETA Test? Head over to our Official Holdfast BETA Discord server to get involved and provide feedback.

[url=https://discord.gg/AqvKswexg9]Join The BETA Discord[/url]

Stay tuned for more to come and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Regiment Warfare! Fixes & Additions V2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/cc4eb986669308874100e1b2d62ac7cd5fb4b590.png[/img]

Greeting good fellows of the Holdfast community! Today releases the second update in a series of smaller releases tackling some of the bugs and player feedback following the latest major update release. 

In-line with community feedback tracers from other players will be shorter and fade faster while still maintaining that chaotic feeling of musket balls flying around you. Your own trail will remain as it was before to provide a visual feedback to adjust your shots. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lt8H8Kk.gif[/img]

The adjustment on the melee mode camera to be accurately centred has been reverted to ensure the melee experience remains as it was before. We’ve also fixed the slight visual delay on the flintlock mechanism animation when firing that was making the firearms feel unresponive. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AttgzkS.gif[/img]

Additionally we've tackled instances with the Steam-deck that wouldn't allow players to use a keyboard and mouse as their main input if desired. We also introduced the ability for the UI to be scaled to increase clarity and size of the elements for those on smaller displays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/25758f359c8c5abc5589b80a576ac519f9d72393.gif[/img]

Make sure your game has been updated to Version 2.21 to see game servers in the lobby. 

Stay tuned for more to come and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

[b]Changelog 94 - Game Version 2.21.0000.0000[/b]

[b]Features & Improvements (7)[/b]
[b]●[/b] Holdfast now features full controller support thanks to the addition of an on-screen keyboard.
[b]●[/b] You can now control ship sails when using a controller.
[b]●[/b] Introduced a free-roam sensitivity setting for controllers.
[b]●[/b] You can now set the controller’s dead zone to a minimum of 0.05.
[b]●[/b] You can now have different ‘Melee Direction Input Type’ settings between controller and keyboard.
[b]●[/b] Introduced a setting allowing individuals to specifically define the control’s input they want to use disabling auto-detection. Search for ‘Input To Use’ under the game’s settings.
[b]●[/b] You can now adjust the game’s UI scale. Search for ‘In-Game UI Scale’ and ‘Menu UI Scale’.

[b]Gameplay Additions (6)[/b]
[b]●[/b] Adjusted melee camera pitch based on player feedback.
[b]●[/b] Tackled an issue concerning players commenting experiencing a slight delay when firing.
* Shortened and made quicker bullet pass-by trails from firearms by enemies based on player feedback. 
[b]●[/b] Performed changes to tackle an issue with FOL being stricter than the Elf Auto Admin mod iteration if you don’t define any of the new built-in commands in the server configuration file.
[b]●[/b] Adjusted the time it takes for auto-aim to lock off after firing to improve robustness.
[b]●[/b] Admin reason defaults to no text in the dialogue box rather than ‘None’.

[b]Optimisations (1)[/b]
[b]●[/b] Tackled issues concerning instances of memory not getting released in between map loads.

[b]Bug FIxes (29)[/b]
[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue where the player’s screen turns black due to upscaling technologies.
[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue which caused drawn tracers through console commands to be mismatched.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed Sapper defences to be built inside one another.
[b]●[/b] Solved an exploit which allowed the Flag Bearer to sit while having a flag equipped.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which prevented individuals from spectating other players through the ‘P’.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the main menu appeared broken if you disconnected at the exact same moment the map was rotating.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the map rotation admin chat entries didn’t show the correct rotation index.
[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue causing the game not to launch on Steam Deck.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the mouse and keyboard weren’t working when the Steam Deck was connected to the dock.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sometimes inputs were not being recognized on the Steam Deck.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where firearm tracers wouldn’t show when spectating other players.
[b]●[/b] Removed multiple unnecessary logs from the game client.
[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an instance which caused players to get stuck on map load.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the server-disconnect message to no longer show.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where you’d be unable to navigate if a faction becomes full while playing with a controller.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with rocket launchers not being destructible when deployed.
[b]●[/b] Solved multiple server-side exceptions.
[b]●[/b] Solved multiple exceptions on the client which occurred infrequently.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the chat box would close when you respawn.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the reason for a banned individual wouldn’t show when the player gets disconnected.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where carriable ladders remained highlighted after being placed.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the delayed all charge not firing until round_spawn_close_timer_seconds has passed.
[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue with the Sapper prop states desynching.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the equipment spawn tab not correctly resetting between map loads.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the Dark-Night weather preset using the Clear-Night skybox.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sometimes radials would overlay one another if buttons were pressed in quick succession.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where cancelling the password prompt using a controller loses navigation.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where pressing the ‘Select’ key when the disconnect reason is showing will make you connect to a server instead.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the firearm trails not looking as intended on lower-quality settings.

[b]Hotfix (16) - 01/07/2024[/b]
[b]●[/b] Fixed the faction selection emblems not being accurate to the actual faction selection.

[b]●[/b] Updated alignment of server browser's server name header.

[b]●[/b] Added a separate hotkey to access music player controls and updated the song selection behaviour.
[b]●[/b] Fixed several issues related to un-initialized faction data.
[b]●[/b] Fixed UI scale indicator not showing in the main menu.
[b]●[/b] Updated available banners in the regiment registry.

notes.title: Regiment Warfare! First Person Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/cc4eb986669308874100e1b2d62ac7cd5fb4b590.png[/img]
Sharpen the bayonets and prepare your powder! The Regiment Warfare update is out now. 

This update brings with it entirely reworked plains maps, officer voice chat, the new maps Bonnie Crags and Drill Grounds, a new first person camera experience, controller support, game optimisations and plenty more.

Make sure to take read below of all that this update has to offer.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25822/Napoleonic_Pack/

[h2]Drill Grounds[/h2]

The mighty Drill Grounds is here at last. This behemoth of a map is the largest we've made to date and includes completely unique structures and buildings all designed to offer up the ultimate roleplay experience. Use the map name 'DrillGrounds' to load this map on your own server.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AaiztaQ.gif[/img]

Range in the guns with the artillery training field, improve your accuracy at the firing range, hold ceremonies in the fortress walls or race horses throughout the expanse. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JbRW7L9.gif[/img]

Even those sea faring fellows can set sail and practice engagements while those on land look on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ef6958094d6875c060389f0f07af10cf71782ed3.gif[/img]

Why not take the King's 40 shillings and enlist in a regiment today? Check out the in-game Regiment Registry to get stuck in. With over 15,000 regiments registered you'll soon find a place within the ranks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1e104ee3e26b2f2150568903c47670f7ba3f01ae.gif[/img]
[h2]Bonnie Crags[/h2]

After giving your men a good drilling why not head over to the crag-lands of Bonnie Crags to put your skill to the test. This brand new map set in the rocky landscapes of the Scottish coastlines is the perfecting proving ground for regimental linebattles. :drill_picklock: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qDh6dpU.gif[/img]

[h2]Plains No More[/h2]

Enlist and fight the foe today, over the hills and far away. Battle across entirely reworked linebattle maps in this update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OYTr82Q.gif[/img]

No stone has been left unturned, we've completely reworked all of the plains maps to provide a better experience more fitting for the modern linebattle experience. We've also made sure to keep true to their character through community feedback. Not only do these maps now feature new unique interest points and environments but they've also been renamed to provide better memorability and clarity. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uYF0zXs.gif[/img]

A moment of silence for all plains maps. :GoldCross:

[h2]First Person Camera[/h2]

A complete overhaul to the first-person camera experience! All of the Nations At War firearms have been freshly re-modeled and re-textured to bring them up to standard with the rest of Holdfast's art style. With the new view providing a closer look at one's trusty black-powder firearm, we wanted to make sure to do the weapons of this era justice. 

To this effect all black-powder firearms also come with unique animation when firing in first-person.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JYlywQi.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SDhXbm9.gif[/img]

[h2]Firearm Tracers[/h2]

As if balls of lead being fired at you at close range couldn't be scary enough the new firearm tracers provide a "close call" experience alongside a visual aid to help you make any required aiming adjustments for your next shot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3N43F4u.gif[/img]

These tracers can be disabled via the game settings tab should you not wish to see them.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]

Inline with our efforts to make Holdfast more accessible for players new and old this update brings with it full controller support for the game. This will greatly improve the experience of those playing Holdfast on Steamdeck along with those who prefer using their controller when playing on PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0cad09ac858200ee49688344dd2ed57b2a516b4e.png[/img]
Players using a controller will be provided with an aim assist to help centre their crosshair on their enemies unless obstructed by smoke. Adjustments to this system are ongoing while we find a good balance. We look forward to welcoming feedback on this front so please feel free to plug a controller in and give it a go. 

Those both with and without a controller are now also able to via the settings change their melee block and attack directions to be based on their movement direction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b1c3d6936482a5f81484ec676866f0eed4519369.png[/img]

Additionally a lot of the user interface has been reworked to include the use of radial menus for easier access to the games many mechanics and roleplay features. As such, now players can select a favourite selection of gestures and shouts per class to populate their radial menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F646hFh.gif[/img]

The officer orders are also now within a radial, however, those who wish to may opt back to the legacy version of the menus by selecting 'Legacy' mode via the game menu selection settings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W0e1Av1.gif[/img]

[h2]Officer Voice Chat[/h2]

Officer and Captain classes now have the brand new 'Personal Courier' ability allowing them to communicate with one another across the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/167046c61ee5e870defb407a4c4811c51c2e2945.png[/img]

Call for help from your fellow commanders and organise offences by swapping through the new officer voice chat channels. Your calls for help will also be heard by those around you locally for the ultimate rambling British officer experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e0f24dfd9b7815fa56cb31557cc103eb9a5dad79.gif[/img]

[h2]New Admin Tools[/h2]

We've also heavily expanded on the toolset available to event hosts and server administrators. Expanding upon what was present in the great community modification made possible trough the Holdfast SDK - 'Elf's Auto Admin', now admins on official and community servers alike will have access to a plethora of new tools and automations to help lighten the load when hosting organised events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/78122582238b012a92caeadb804ffb505991bdb9.png[/img]
Here's a brief breakdown of some of the new features available via the new Holdfast Admin Panel.

Navigate to the game's Wiki for more information on this: [url=https://wiki.holdfastgame.com/Admin_Features]Holdfast Wiki - Admin Features[/url]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Change maps at ease via the new map rotation tab.
[*] Create custom polls.
[*] Trigger and setup all charge variables for organised linebattle events.
[*] Configurable systems preventing players from firing out of line (FOL).
[*] A kill log history with the ability to revive and slay.
[*] Change naval wind settings on the fly.
[*] Target players in free-cam or in-game using the new ray-gun system for quick action.
[*] And a whole lot more.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/19a7293b2e49554cdfde2d6b44eadcb9138cd388.gif[/img]

[h2]Regimental History[/h2]

A reworked version of the regiment history section can now be found when viewing a regiment. Simply press the scroll widget in the bottom right corner to be presented with a whole list of regiment activity and history.

See how much score members of the regiment have gathered for the regiment on official servers, view administrative actions, keep track of promotions and newly joined recruits all within this widget. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/7871b7e8839e184f245b54c9c91eae03e9fe553b.gif[/img]

All this information will be visible and available for all players of the game regardless if they are in your regiment or not. 

[h2]Customise Your Main Menu[/h2]

The games main menu background scene has been entirely recreated to feature a brighter atmosphere more fitting of Holdfast's gameplay. 

Customise what nation is represented in your main menu scene by simply selecting it via the barracks. Whatever faction you last select will be represented within the scene. This also includes Frontlines-specific factions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vc0Pd4Z.gif[/img]

There are many more changes, features, bug fixes and quality of life additions being introduced in the this release. Have a read at the change-log for all the details.

Thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/137cdefa816292f12fa2676d8bd666661b0570f7.png[/img]

These servers introduce 10 new modded maps alongside the base game ones, custom ship match-ups for more variety and tweaks to damage. Battle fleets of ships or take coastal fortresses by force with the might of cannon, simply head over to the server browser and look for any of the servers below. 

These servers will also gather you XP towards your class levels and the daily XP score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4d34cbf7707b2d73c26487a48fd88cce96e85dee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b2171978664149ef412fa4f248da15e3c7c55121.png[/img]

[b]Naval Warfront Tips[/b]
[list]
[*] Going with the wind is faster.
[*] When going against the wind do not deploy 'square sails' as they will cause you to go much slower and act as a wind brake.
[*] Do not load cannons if you aren’t using them: A loaded cannon is a dangerous cannon. It can explode when hit and damage the ship.
[*] Teamwork is key, work with your fellow crew mates to help with ammunition, pass along orders and fire off volleys at the enemy fleet.

notes.title: Napoleon's Rise Release! Holdfast OST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c11de2e33d04f9cd3434e8ecfe2c98659e949874.png[/img]
Holdfast updated! The past few months we have been hard at work undertaking one of Holdfast's largest updates to date. 

We've upgraded Holdfast's game engine and render pipeline allowing us to utilise new technology for optimisations while also improving the graphical fidelity of the game. Holdfast has never looked better and now as a result of these optimisations will also run smoother and more consistently across various setups.

But that is not all... [b]Your Emperor calls[/b]. Napoleon himself marches onto the battlefields of Holdfast along with some iconic uniforms of his past in the new Napoleon's Rise cosmetic DLC available for the game. Plus the official soundtrack for Holdfast is out now! 

A brand new urban map featuring new environments themed on the city streets of France will also be playable for all for free.

[previewyoutube=tLb7IebbabE;full]https://youtu.be/tLb7IebbabE[/previewyoutube]
[b]Napoleon's Rise DLC[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692480/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__Napoleons_Rise

[b]The Plight of War OST[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692500/Holdfast_OST__The_Plight_of_War

Development efforts targeting framerate improvements on large player count servers are also ongoing and will be present in future updates. This has all been made possible thanks to the above mentioned engine upgrade exposing the team to new tools to further optimise the game.

Just before you go though be sure to take a read of what this update brings down below!

[h2]Holdfast's New Look[/h2]

An entire rework of the games graphics was yet another one of the mammoth tasks throughout this update. No stone was left unturned to bring-forth the new graphics for the game. The entire post processing stack for the game was changed from the ground up and now features some excellent looking sun rays, reflections, colour grading and many more effects to give you the full Holdfast immersive experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o8Y8QiN.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hl9IMg9.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8Nlskcl.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mmCGfHc.gif[/img]

Many structures and props have been freshly retextured bringing a more consistent and vibrant appearance to the game's battlefields. We also spent some time [i]touching grass[/i] as the foliage has undergone a complete rework from the smallest blade to the tallest of trees. Foliage will also interact with players as they move through it, something especially handy for spotting a sneaking carpenter in the wheat fields.

[h2]Slimming Down Holdfast[/h2]

A significant benefit of our work across these months has been that reduction in Holdfast's file size. Given the number of battlefields and faction diversity that Holdfast offers it was inevitable that this would eventually catch up to us and needed remedying.

Thank's to the updated engine and new optimisation efforts we have successfully brought the games install size down from over 40gb to a now much more comfortable 17gb while still maintaining both Nations At War and Frontlines in one game install for all to enjoy.

Its safe to say that we've speed run our way through a most challenging new year resolution - Queue us the [i]Rocky theme[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c5334e3bf99723113b01a5db6b2c94ae2ec314ab.gif[/img]

[h2]Napoleon's Rise[/h2]

Explore Napoleon’s rise to power through this cosmetic content dedicated to the Emperor Napoleon. Lead the armies of France to victory as either First Consul Napoleon or Emperor Napoleon with the 2 new character heads and iconic uniform of the great tactician himself. Players will also be given a new portrait, banner and medal to showcase on their playercard via the in-game barracks.

[b]Napoleon's Rise DLC[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692480/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__Napoleons_Rise

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/08e341d2300135d5fce9faccb3081d24fbbacc34.png[/img]
Rise up in the streets of France with the new French Republican Infantry uniform available for the Line Infantry class, charge forth into the fray as the Imperial Guard Chasseur-a-Cheval or skirmish the enemy as Light Infantry dressed in the dashing uniforms of the Guides a Pied de Bonaparte.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ee8bd1f296cc8ee3ad69edae0fd2da2026cfb3a6.png[/img]
Make use of the the new unique officer gestures that display some of Napoleon's most iconic poses of the time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l2lYpkp.gif[/img]

Napoleon’s horse Marengo is also available as a horse skin for cavalry players and features the saddle Napoleon would have sat upon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/476ea08c16c2aad56973b04884a1e1a69c54afb2.png[/img]

[h2]Empire City Map[/h2]

Battle throughout the city streets of Empire! This tight urban environment is the first of its kind and offers unique verticality and urban city combat all in one map. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kl5ZrTi.gif[/img]

Charge through the grand mansions of nobility and capture the city square or sneak under the city and traverse through the sewage system to flank the enemy. Keep your bayonet fixed and stay alert, there wont be a moments break from the rage of war.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IdASwnZ.gif[/img]

[h2]Original Soundtrack[/h2]

With great pomp and circumstance the Holdfast original soundtrack ‘The Plight of War’ presents to you a plethora of epic renditions of some all time classics to uplift spirits and set the tone as you charge forward to glory. 

[b]The Plight of War OST[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692500/Holdfast_OST__The_Plight_of_War

Featuring iconic songs spanning from the Napoleonic Wars to The Great War this soundtrack brings-forth not only 20 tracks (including instrumentals) but an entire music player available both in the main menu and in-game so that you’ll never be without the choirs of war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/110a46b950f13376bd32e426d3b5a0740850f433.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/qrNd2cC/musicplayer.gif[/img]

There are many more changes, features, bug fixes and quality of life additions being introduced in this update so be sure to check out the change log! Thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: Holdfast Updated! Howitzers & UI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e3520f72c8a98245384cf1874e83b35a0e213536.png[/img]

The time has come to announce the release of this long anticipated update. For some while now we have been hard at work rejuvenating both Holdfast’s frontend and backend in order to lay the foundations for the updates to follow.

Our goal is to make Holdfast more accessible to a wider audience while staying true to its core. This will prolong Holdfast’s shelf life so that you can continue enjoying Holdfast for many more years to come! This update will be the first big step in that direction.

[h2]Introducing The Howitzer[/h2]

This long requested artillery piece now makes its way to the battles of Holdfast. With its skilled based air burst and flying shrapnel this new disrupter of organisation will change the way engagements play out across the game.

Load a shot and set the fuse timer on the fuse interface then fire away and watch as chaos ensues from afar. Those wanting a more precise fuse timer can hold down 'Shift' by default and make smaller timing changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f0b2ea9511bf1f3c03c559084d05651e434ad158.gif[/img]

The Howitzer’s primary attack is the air burst, timing the fuse and judging the distance correctly will allow skilled artillerymen to burst the shell above the enemy causing the most damage and killing those closest.

Shells that land near or at the floor of the enemy will cause damage but will not kill unless they are directly on top of the shell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/94f1063b4a4a3bcf1c3ce86064402dfd8809fee5.gif[/img]

[h2]Holdfast’s New Look[/h2]

One of the biggest changes to come to the game with this update is a complete redesign of the games user interface.

From the moment you launch the game and all the way until you finish a match you’ll see a whole new UI that has been designed and created to further improve the user experience and provide much needed modularity for future updates that the old UI simply didn’t allow for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d041c55762f97a2c80eece32d924eecba50a0859.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/96bd243aaf0d474c789b558d076647c02de53f0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/00529c174b93e589b3a1eb7d238529607a165b95.gif[/img]

This is indeed a big change but comes with a whole new slew of features such as the new playercards, regiment leaderboards, barracks and customisation, in-game regiment registry and much more. There’s plenty to explore so hop on Holdfast and check out everything this new interface has to offer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/dacff0f3f530f4d26864f11a5adb91c92d51801e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/57a4b971ca3e4173d2e78eb5d35dad9e02f40de8.gif[/img]

This initial introduction of playercards should be considered as a beta version of the full implementation as in updates to follow once we have tested and confirmed the robustness of the new systems, more portraits, banners, medals and unlocks will be available for players to complete specific challenges for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6ddd0760eaea15190308d85b1a966d8f172c6fb6.gif[/img]

All of the games DLC has been updated with this update to include unlocks for these and as the systems in place for this have long been in the game. 

We’ve also taken appropriate measures to ensure that you can customise the in-game UI exactly to your liking by visiting the games settings menu. Want your minimap smaller or the chat in the bottom left? Simply set it in the settings as shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f3e12495b95301e8f82b794088d0c4b0604603ce.gif[/img]

A new option has also been included for the end of round map voting screen. The selection has now been reduced to 3 maps with the 3rd of the options being a random map. This will load a random map from the servers rotation that is viable for the gamemode available in the vote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d1cc4245ce2338921f7c081945980223e22a5c4f.gif[/img]

Leaderboards have been completely redesigned and now regiments can compete for the top spot in their very own regimental leaderboards. These are seasonal leaderboards that will determine your regiment's position in the game's regiment registry during that season based on XP earned from public servers and official public events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3bc8f886f7b70ba3bab5294f7aa5be2763830a93.gif[/img]

Another feature of the new user interface is the games in-game cosmetics only store. This new storepage will make purchasing and rewarding DLC's far simpler and enables us to introduce additional cosmetics such as portraits and banners alongside the other content found within the DLCs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c81f859127e8ab29fb28a1802259a66be316d3f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2208b89009512337f1410bf06903fafc8b5c453e.png[/img]
Each of the game's DLC's has been upgraded to include a unique portrait that can be applied in the barracks, some DLC's also include additional banners. You can preview everything you get by heading over the store and selecting a DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/19658b8c814f01ddef86c4230de67c3afc592264.gif[/img]

[h2]Battlefield Forger Winners[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/7bab388c240bb89e0e01b8fab9e8f1cdc6e47131.png[/img]

Holdfast’s modding competition came to a close a few months back and we’re now ready to announce our winners. The art team took a look at each and every entry into the contest considering not only design but also execution. The level of quality compared to the previous forger contest truly showed how far the modding community has come and made the contest all that more difficult to judge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3e8a50d8a08d135973e8292418a58c900858fc94.png[/img]

Starting with the mapping contest in [b]1st place we have Spammy McJunkmail[/b] with their map Martense Point. This well crafted train yard village features plenty of height variation, close quarter fighting opportunities and flanking routes that all come together to produce a very splendid Frontlines battlefield.

A big congratulations to Spammy, we look forward to implementing this map into the game in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/10a381b92ef5ab976e17fa2484674967d456bc63.png[/img]
[i](Martense Point by Spammy McJunkmail)[/i]

[b]In 2nd place follows Kill’em[/b] with the map Port LeMerc. Set within sporadic islands this naval coastal siege map stood out as a very well designed battlefield for both ocean and siege engagements with its rocky cliff faces offering up a natural defence against the incoming invaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/9d89397863c37fedc14c1633c7b4fc2c17d7c559.png[/img]
[i](Port LeMerc by Kill'em)[/i]

Finally, [b]in 3rd place is Mattrobes[/b] and their map Little Map. A quaint little village sits within grassland and trees, segregated by broken fencerows this small map offered up a unique blend of urban and plains combat with plenty of cover within its overgrown outer fields for ambushing the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5515f30221a4cec9f6f1e5efaf2720b2c8f9e2b3.png[/img]
[i](Little Map by Mattrobes)[/i]

Now to announce our uniform contest winners, although there were less entries for this side of the contest, those we did receive were of some excellent quality. The attention to details and general execution of work was very impressive.

Kicking things off in [b]1st place[/b] with their entry to be added into the game is [b]Binghampton[/b] and their Frontlines WW1 Winter Uniforms. In their dashing winter coats and fingerless gloves these uniforms will offer up some warmth and comfort for those engaging in combat in snow and rain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2c892cd36a8eb587bb38007e91c638a0f1c050fe.png[/img]
[i](Frontlines Winter Uniforms by Binghampton)[/i]

[b]Coming in 2nd place is ApexPhantom[/b] with his Napoleonic Winter Uniforms. Once more these fellows look incredible in their long-coats and shako coverings with plenty of variations to pick from. A truly splendid job well done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/82887f2b30eb99a1bca8ebb0c717423ff8357dc6.png[/img]
[i](Napoleonic Winter Uniforms by ApexPhantom)[/i]

A big thanks to everyone who submitted entries into the contest; [i]Father Merrin, Toonu, Kill’em, Binghampton, CevCon, El Presidente, NPC Charles, Ragnar, thiccpoot, MiSFiT77, Mattrobes, Meal, Maggot, jklirr, Spammy McJunkmail, Banana, Masdock, ApexPhantom, Arsen and AMBLCO[/i]


While the road has been long we're committed to bringing Holdfast into the new era and ensuring the game continues to thrive for many more years to come.

Work on the games next update already began some months ago and we're making good progress towards a BETA release in the not too distant future. There’s a whole lot more in store for Holdfast and beyond.

There are many more changes, features, bug fixes and quality of life additions being introduced in this update so be sure to check out the change log! Thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours. :oheart:

notes.title: 5th Series. The Barracks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6f9265452d0810a59d55d9c21c4692b4ef7d6585.png[/img]

Greetings good fellows of the community! After many months of hard work we are now reaching ever closer to the release of the next major update. Internal quality assurance testing have been ongoing these past weeks and we have already undertaken early feedback sessions as we prepare to move into a larger scale closed BETA. 

This update has taken some time, however, testing and polishing has been integral for bringing in a fresh lick of paint to the game and laying the foundations for the updates that will follow.

[img]https://iili.io/HiHVD6F.gif[/img]

This update will bring with it an entirely redesigned user interface which will introduce some much needed modularity and scalability to the UI while also making Holdfast more accessible for all players. 

One feature of this is the new ability to customise your soldier and playercard within the main menu. Before heading into battle, visit the barracks tab and customise your soldier for each and every nation. Any changes here will also be reflected within the in-game spawn menu.

[img]https://iili.io/HPbgmKB.gif[/img]
[img]https://iili.io/HPbrxHX.gif[/img]
[i]*The above footage is a work in progress and may not be representative of the content upon release.[/i]

This introduction of the barracks will be the first phase of a new slew of cosmetic unlocks that will be obtainable through challenges coming with an update later this year. Playercard customisation for this update will be limited to begin with but we look forward to bringing in new medals, banners, weapon designs and much more into the barracks with the coming updates.

Rest assured that our commitment to Holdfast and its community remains as strong as ever! Revealing more of our plans for the year, sappers will be equipped with an improved arsenal of buildables. 

The sapper was always intended to have a far great presence on the battlefield and the introduction of these new constructible objects will bolster their impact throughout matches and provide some far greater and robust defences to dynamically change up the battlefield with towers, palisades and much more.

notes.title: 4th Series. Introducing The Howitzer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6f9265452d0810a59d55d9c21c4692b4ef7d6585.png[/img]

Greetings good fellows of the community! We now step ever closer to the next update for Holdfast. The team are working endlessly to polish off this first of larger updates coming in 2023 all of which will aid in expanding and maintaining this great community we all love so dearly.

Soon we will be undertaking closed BETA sessions to test and gather feedback prior to the update's full release. While there is indeed a lot of change coming with this update it is a very important stage of our plans to ensure that players new and old can continue enjoying Holdfast for the years to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d160e8ca5783dcc75ed5e4c1daf41dd637f9922d.jpg[/img]
The newest members Gest, Matt and Grandayy slotted into the team effortlessly and have all already begun directly working on multiple sections of this next update coming to the game. They are all very excited for you to see what they have been working on.

Speaking of which, we’re pleased to announce that the long-awaited Howitzer artillery piece will be added to the game with this update. This new foe on the battlefield makes up what it lacks in range with devastating shrapnel explosions and blasts that will knock back those who are near. 

Here’s a sneak peek of this beast of the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b75f5a6301a04103e6ee7a4a1f03ca6592627260.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8db2ebbd75ff6d183ca9449021f5e63a6c3e6544.gif[/img]
[i]*The above footage is a work in progress and may not be representative of the content upon release.[/i]

One of the changes coming to Holdfast with this update is an entire redesign of the game's user interface. Holdfast is a game that has been in development since 2013 and over the years, it has come to be rather dated in a lot of ways, often limiting the development of many features due to its lack of modularity.

Part and parcel of the above-mentioned redesign are customisable player cards. You will be able to brilliantly showcase your hard-earned achievements through a selection of customisable medals, portraits, titles and banners in your own style and liking. It will show to players you kill and also within the game’s leaderboards. These will be visible across all fronts of the game including Naval, Nations At War and Frontlines.

The initial introduction of these cards will have a limited pool of portraits, banners, titles and medals to pick from. Other updates will see the inclusion of a wide selection of customisable elements that can be unlocked by completing service challenges and feats of strength.

We’re doing this to limit the scope of the upcoming release ensuring that we’re able to deliver it to you as soon as humanly possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1c7c2ce4cca781c8cdbf1f83beb157ac61e76b07.png[/img]

Our systems backend which cares for stats and experience collection as well as the regiment registry was similarly rudimentary in its construct. This severely limited our designers from enlisting features aiding with both community building and player retention. Needless to say, this was quite the involving task to see come to fruition but was a necessary step forward.

Thanks to these changes, the team has brought to life a more robust and responsive regiment registry along with various tools to bolster and assist with community building. The registry has also been made accessible whilst playing a match enabling new players to join a clan with ease.

Here’s a hint at some of the features that will be complimenting the new regiment registry in this coming update. Anvil Game Studios is determined to [b]bring Holdfast into the new age[/b] all the while staying true to its core design values and pillars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/42a076ccc6918958ae3b3e3b7f1e2674318e3f14.png[/img]
[i]*The above image is a work in progress and may not be representative of the content upon release[/i]

[h2]Holdfast Game Sale[/h2]

Should you have yet to enlist and fight for Emperor or King, now’s the ripe moment to do so as Holdfast and all of its cosmetic DLCs will be on sale up to 55% off for a limited time! We hope to see you with us soon on the battlefield.
