notes.title: 3rd Series. The AGS Team Grows!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6f9265452d0810a59d55d9c21c4692b4ef7d6585.png[/img]

Greetings good fellows of the community! Continuing with our commitment to bringing Holdfast: Nations At War into the new age the team has been hard at work laying the foundations for our 2023 plans which are just as much exciting as they are ambitious. 

Holdfast has always strived to break through boundaries and revolutionise this genre of roleplay shooters and our year ahead will remain focused on this target. Bringing forth the next chapter of Holdfast will ensure its continued growth and expansion of a community that we have all come to love so dearly.

Once more, we want to ensure that you can continue enjoying Holdfast for the years to come.

With this goal in mind, the Anvil Game Studios team has welcomed 3 additional talented individuals who will be joining us on this journey to uplift Holdfast, and community-focused games from the team beyond to newer and greater heights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2e1e601c0ff12006a3d747ab4dc3b3fbb7e46ce4.png[/img]

Those eagled-eyed fellows in the official Holdfast Discord server would have already noticed these new faces but as an official introduction, we now have the pleasure of introducing to you the latest members of the team.

[b]Gest - DevOps[/b]

Joining us as part of our development operations he's the one that makes systems happen for developers to work efficiently. It is an instrumental role that will enable the team to produce larger, more inspiring releases.

[b]Matt - Game Developer Int.[/b]

As an intermediate Game Developer, Matt will be heading the charge forward in our primary efforts to polish up the game ready for the current and next generation of Holdfast enjoyers to get their fix of musket and trench warfare for many more years to come. 

[b]Grandayy - Game Developer Jnr.[/b]

Covering all things Holdfast, Grandayy will be getting his hands dirty in bringing additional gameplay mechanics and content into the game to enhance the overall experience on the battlefield and at sea. 

While the onboarding process of these new fellows does of course take time, especially with Holdfast’s impressive 1 million+ lines of codebase, through the mentoring of our seniors all these chaps have made excellent progress. 

You can expect to see content in the game from them very soon.

[h2]Increased XP Event Announcement[/h2]

Serving as a small show of thanks from us for enabling our creative visions to come to life and making a dream come true, starting on the 15th of March 2023 until the 24th of March 2023 players can hop on Holdfast and get an increase of 1.5x for all score earned on all official servers. 

Join us on the above mentioned dates and feel free to say hello if you spot these new chaps in the game to bid them welcome!

[h2]What We've Been Up To[/h2]

Even with the team being busy to the brim onboarding these new individuals in the increasingly complex but awe-inspiring and rewarding field of game development, we're still set on bringing you more Holdfast content.

Be on the lookout for our next community-focused update targeting a late April release making accessible the regiment registry (clan system) while playing a match, bringing additional features to the said registry, a game-wide regiment chat, new leaderboards and much more. 

This will all be coupled with a complete backend redesign of all the above-mentioned systems enabling us to continue expanding on similar features in the future. Holdfast is built on community and we want to continue showing our support as you have done so generously throughout these brilliant years.

On behalf of everyone at Anvil Game Studios, I wish you all, our dear community the best of health. :oheart:

notes.title: Major Update! Austrian Empire Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6f9265452d0810a59d55d9c21c4692b4ef7d6585.png[/img]

The long awaited Austrians finally arrive! Ram your shot and prepare for battle, the Austrian nation marches into Holdfast with this major update release. These dashing fellows in white are the latest addition to the Napoleonic front of the game and feature unique uniforms, voice lines and music to accompany them. 

Before grabbing your musket and heading to the front, take a moment to watch the release trailer below and take a dive into the rest of this blog post to find out what else is coming and meet the latest fellow joining us on the battlefield… Nick ‘Wobblebang’ Claus.

[previewyoutube=GUC6rombf4g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Austria When? Austria Now[/h2]

The Österreicher marches onto the field of battle in this major update. Featuring unique uniforms, voice lines, music and of course very splendid headwear, the Austrians will certainly make an impression on the battlefield and leave their mark. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/15b93185dba072bc44775efbcccc7cff83ce2f13.png[/img]

These fine chaps in their glorious white are now available to play across all Holdfast Nations At War servers. So hop on Holdfast to enlist and fight for the Kaiser. :CrossSwords:

[h2]Nick 'Wobblebang' Claus![/h2]

After the antics of Fred during the dark Halloween nights we have been sent the ‘gift’ of none other than Nick ‘Wobblebang’ Claus who has come to cleanse the land of Fred's minion’s evil doing during this most festive season. Good ol’ Nick has brought with him not only his unwavering festive spirit but he has even kindly placed some presents for us all under the Christmas trees. 

Unfortunately for us however, someones been letting him at the whisky again… so don’t expect much from him as he can be a little explosive at times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ca3e9fa8cae74dec6620ccdbb49027b07a4314f4.gif[/img]

Players are able to select the Nick ‘Wobblebang’ Claus head for a limited time throughout this festive update, allowing them to spread Christmas joy the only way Mr Wobblebang knows how. Our good fellow is doing his best! :retro_beer:

[h2]Hills of Tyrol[/h2]

Accompanying Nick and the Austrians will be a new battlefield for the games Napoleonic front. Inspired by the western Austrian state of Tyrol this small country town sits quietly beside a still lake making it the perfect place for a spot of fishing or in the case of Holdfast, some good old fashioned volleys of powder and shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0c87fed943ecb0cece41142bbfdfe686fcc013e8.png[/img]

The Hills of Tyrol is now playable across all Nations At War servers.

[h2]A Christmas Gift[/h2]

All of the available Nations At War DLCs have been updated! Following this release, owners of the game's Napoleonic uniform DLCs will be treated with a free upgrade to the DLC that will introduce additional uniforms from both Italy and Austria to the various packs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/edb6493a7e973b6c2f0f0832a61fd099cb45b18c.png[/img]

This upgrade to the game's DLCs will also apply automatically to players who newly purchase them. All of Holdfast’s DLC will be on sale for the duration of the Steam Winter sale. Feel free to pick up some additional uniforms for your classes during this holiday season!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13424/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__Collectors_Edition/

[h2]Join Us[/h2]

Don't forget to join Discord for everything Holdfast! Partake in community-hosted events, enlist in a clan more widely known as regiments amongst the community, discuss the game and beyond or even chat with us, the game's developers. We'd love to hear about your recent escapades and your thoughts about the game.

notes.title: Steam Awards! Vote Holdfast - A Labor of Love
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

As yet another year comes to a close and we prepare for the holiday season, we can take a step back and reflect on the record breaking year Holdfast had in 2022 [b]a whole 5 years[/b] since we first released it into Early Access back in 2017! 

[h2]A Labor of Love[/h2]

This year was a big year for Holdfast starting with the release of Frontlines, the free World War 1 expansion for the game, which instantly broke our concurrent player count records. The Linebattle 2.0 major update also introduced many long requested features and player customisation and progression, the Anvil Game Studios team more than doubled in size and even Fred returned again to cause havoc on Halloween. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4c327a39d62bdff633f5d00ccb676eab8ab14296.png[/img]
The best part is, we’re only just getting started… Holdfast is very much a labor of love for the team, we are committed to continuing to support the game as we have been doing so for the past 5+ years since its release, you can [b]expect big things coming in 2023[/b], we want Holdfast to go down in the history books.

[h2]Nominate Holdfast[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/Holdfast_Nations_At_War/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5f505398f69b461bc1942331f0f779875bff425c.png[/img]
[/url]
The time of year has come around once again for the Steam Awards, this is your opportunity to cast your vote and nominate games for various awards. We ask kindly when voting for Holdfast this year that you select the [b]‘Labor of Love’[/b] nomination.  :CatsHeart:

This category best fits Holdfast not only because of our team's love for the game but also the love and dedication that the great Holdfast community has for it too, without your ongoing support this record breaking year and the years to come would not be possible.  

Head on over to the Holdfast storepage today and cast your vote to nominate Holdfast for the Labor of Love award.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

[h2]An Early Christmas Gift[/h2]

Of course, we wouldn’t be able to let this year come to a close without ending it with a bang so here’s a sneak preview of what [i](or in this case who)[/i] is coming to Holdfast in December this year.

notes.title: Kick-Off! Battlefield Forger Contest 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/7bab388c240bb89e0e01b8fab9e8f1cdc6e47131.png[/img]

Artisans! Dust off your paint brushes and re-import your project for the 100th time today because the Battlefield Forger contest returns once more for its second ever competition allowing fellows from our community to bring their brilliant creations into Holdfast.

Following the success of the first contest in 2020, which brought in an impressive 24 entries, this contest will now be held over a longer duration and also allow multiple entries for both the Napoleonic and WW1 sides of the game. Alongside maps, uniform modders shall also be tasked with creating a unique uniform or set of uniforms for an existing faction within Holdfast.

The Battlefield Forger contest this year is [b]bigger and better[/b] than ever with more opportunities and prizes for those involved. Make sure to take a read of the entire blog post for all the contest details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/279f5f69b9adb7773a664ea5aeefc8ccd7566947.png[/img]
[i]Winter Great War uniforms by Binghampton.[/i]

[h2]Contest Overview & Prizes[/h2]

If you are reading this then we’re already off to the races! Starting from the release of this post the Battlefield Forger contest has already gotten underway. 

The contest commenced on the [b]18th of November 2022[/b] and will run respectively until the [b]18th of January 2023[/b]. During this time artisans can create and submit either a new battlefield or custom uniform into the contest via the official Discord. Artisans that desire to do so can also submit both a map and a uniform into the contest as these will be judged separately from one another.

For more details and contest guidelines take a read below to ensure your submission will be accepted into the competition. Should you fail to follow these guidelines your entry will be disqualified. Purely cosmetic entries to the contest may be included as DLCs in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3e8a50d8a08d135973e8292418a58c900858fc94.png[/img]

[b]Contest Entry Categories[/b]
● Map Forger - Submit your Frontlines or Nations At War map creations. 
● Uniform Forger - Submit your Frontlines or Nations At War uniform creations. 

[b]Contest Prizes[/b]
● 1st Place - Entry is officially added to the game, a copy of Holdfast: Nations At War - Collector's Edition along with another copy of Holdfast: Nations At War to share with your friends. Awarded the verified artisan role.
● 2nd Place - A copy of Holdfast: Nations At War - Collector's Editions. Awarded the verified artisan role.
● 3rd Place - A copy of Holdfast: Nations At War to share with your friends. Awarded the verified artisan role.

[b]Contest Guidelines[/b]
● You will be given until January 18th 2023 to submit your entry.
● You may submit a maximum of 2 entries per era (4 in total).
● Your entries must be playable upon submission and well optimised (test before you submit).
● If making a map, you may only use the in-game objects found within the SDK tool.
» Custom assets may be considered only if they are of quality and you own the copyright to them.
● You may use any ground textures you desire as they may be replaced should you win.
● You may choose any official gamemode for your map to be played on.
● You may freely work in groups should you desire.
● Your entries design should be playful, unique and stand out but also appropriately mimic general themes of battlefields and uniforms officially in the game.
● Uniform entries must aim to be as historically accurate as possible. However, leeway to historical accuracy can be given to ensure better class recognisability.
● Uniforms should aim to be around the range of 16,000 triangles (without heads). 
● Aim to create a well-balanced battlefield fitting to a specific gamemode.
● Your map must be a maximum of 450 x 450 in playable size (out of bounds can extend beyond this).
● You may submit previously made maps / uniforms provided they have NOT been in a previous contest.

For any queries in regards to the contest please reach out to [b]Harper#0410[/b] on Discord.

[h2]Entering The Contest[/h2]

Whether you are new or a veteran to the uniform and map making tools of Holdfast the competition remains open to all. Take your time and get creative, the winner of our first competition hadn’t even made a map prior to their entry and still walked away with the glory. 

Obtaining the artisan role in the official Holdfast Discord is a requirement for entering the competition as it’ll allow you to submit your battlefield to the contest seamlessly. To acquire this role simply visit the #getting-started modding channel and press the reaction emoji below the post. This will assign you the artisan role and give you access to all available modding community channels including the #forger-submission channel.

Once your entry has been created you’ll need to submit it via the #forger-submission channel. Be sure to include a workshop link and one or two images that show your creation in all its magnificence.

Once your entries have been submitted, grab a nice cup of tea and sit back while the judging phases commence. Check the #getting-started channel to get going.

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a6b4f6a325866dc93b5ae849298507fd177b12e8.gif[/img]

[h2]Meet The Judges[/h2]

After the contest comes to a close it will then be time for the judging process to commence. Returning from the previous panel of judges will be Refleax, the producer of Holdfast; Rycon, the games lead artist; Harper, our media specialist and of course Storey, our resident structure and level designer. Joining the judging panel for the first time this year will also be none other than our character artist Jackson and Stan who joined the team earlier this year as a level designer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/00b912aefb0574c3d8da08aff7dbb08bf7513057.png[/img]

After the contest comes to a close the judging panel will take some time to go through each entry and rank them in comparison to one another. The team will then come to a unanimous decision on the placing of entries and ultimately the winners of this year's contest. 

[h2]A Word From Willy[/h2]

We caught up with the first ever winner of the Battlefield Forger contest, Willy. Willy’s entry into the first competition was the first map they had made, despite this, Willy’s map Aspern checked all the boxes and impressed the judges, so much so that it would go on to win the competition and be officially integrated into the game.

“Around the time when I was beginning to think if game design was something I should seriously consider as a career, Holdfast dropped a map making contest. I decided to try it out as I thought it would be an excellent opportunity. 

It was a massive shock seeing the results, even though I felt proud of what I created, it was still my first ever project in Unity so seeing Aspern sitting in first place brought a massive amount of happiness and a good confidence boost in my abilities. Aspern getting voted so often still to this day puts a massive smile on my face.” - [i]Willy[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/89333665ded26ee80b1b8313ece99efb030d31a2.png[/img]


We look forward to seeing what the Holdfast modding community can create. 

As always and until next time, may good health be yours.

notes.title: More Unlocks! Muppet, Jolly & Hammer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Holdfast: Nations At War has been updated! Lace your boots and make your uniform presentable for inspection as this update to the game will introduce 4 new unlock-able heads, version 6 of the Holdfast SDK providing modders with many more functions for the character editor alongside a whole slew of bug fixes.

Take a read below in more detail of all that will be coming in this update, you never know what you may find…

[h2]Heads, Heads And More Heads[/h2]

With the release of this update 4 new heads are now available in the game. These chaps feature some rather prominent facial expressions that will  have your fellow rankers questioning what you’ve been through and seen throughout the war. 

[b]New Unlocks[/b]
● George ‘Muppet‘ Burton unlocked at Silver 3 (Rank 30)
● Thomas ‘Shellshocked’ Baker unlocked at Decorated 2 (Rank 55)
● Albert ‘Jolly’ Saxton unlocked at Decorated 3 (Rank 60)
● Frank ‘Hammer’ Chapman unlocked at Valour 1 (Rank 65)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/aca8d6cf572ca73597aea66aec3114dabfa082cc.png[/img]

Anyone looking to further increase their collection of heads and has not already done so, can obtain a free special head by joining the official Holdfast Discord server via the ‘Escape’ menu while playing a match.

[h2]SDK Version 6 Released[/h2]

New modding systems arrive to the SDK further expanding upon the new additions made in-line with the Linebattle 2.0 update. Uniform modders will have a range of new tools available to them to further streamline the uniform creation process. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1e4297b491bb54348e5c6047186c42b59bf19dd7.png[/img]
[i]Created by ApexPhantom[/i]

Artisans can now set up their modifications to use the base Holdfast heads unlocked through progression when creating uniforms. In addition to this, mod packs featuring heads can also be created by artisans. The full list of SDK changes and new features can be found in the change log below.

[h2]Content Creator Spotlight[/h2]

The number of Holdfast content creators has grown rapidly over the last year and every day more and more new faces are sharing their Holdfast experiences for the world to see. With the addition of the content creators corner in the official Holdfast discord it is now easier than ever to get connected and network with other like minded creators in the Holdfast space.

We caught up with veteran Holdfast streamer Pirate Gamer 123 and the ever entertaining BippityBoppity to find out more about why they make content for Holdfast.

[b]Pirate Gamer 123[/b]
[url=twitch.tv/pirategamer123]twitch.tv/pirategamer123[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/746a01c0605baa827df0de253a5ed93dd9c042ff.gif[/img]

“I’ve been streaming for 9 years now. I wanted to share the silly things I do when playing games and meet other people who share similar passions in gaming. The Holdfast community is amazing. No round of Holdfast is ever the same as the last. There is always someone to bear witness to my awful moments in melee and I like laughing together with people around the world. 

There's never a dull moment and it makes me feel very special and warm inside that the AGS team not only engages with streamers but also talks to us on a personal level. Feel like part of a long distance family. 

The Holdfast content creators are more than happy to help with anything and a fair few of us Holdfast streamers have gotten to know each other and support each other too. We are always looking to meet new people/streamers.”

[b]BippityBoppity[/b]
[url=twitch.tv/bippityboppityzippityzop]twitch.tv/bippityboppityzippityzop[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/15dfbcceecee1ebe19863ad07d663742c064e214.gif[/img]

“I've been streaming for about 5 months now, my first stream was playing Holdfast! I've played the game for over a year, I didn't think of really getting into streaming and content creation until I watched some YouTubers play the game like SovietWomble and 5uhDude.I knew I wanted to make funny videos from Holdfast to put on YouTube, and figured streaming it on Twitch was a great way to help guide viewers there!

The best Twitch and YouTube content I've gotten out of Holdfast has been with other Holdfast content creators! You have to lean into the craziness, so be sure to join special events held by different regiments like Star Wars and The Great Emu War. Checking out the Holdfast Discord is a great place to start, and there's always people willing to play.”

[h2]Something Terrif..ying Is Coming![/h2]

Rumors have spread of fallen men rising from their bitter ends, an envious force has returned for revenge and soon he will arrive at the front. We must prepare or else our end will be one of chaos and peril. Ready your muskets men and aim for their heads, for soon it will be the Night of the Freds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e24aa3cd27b0a8fcce74bb6dfbe794c4aaa5d07b.png[/img]
Enlist to stop this evil from taking over Holdfast… or do Monsieur Fred’s bidding on the [b]24th of October 2022[/b] and [b]register your interest in this limited time event on our official Discord[/b].

notes.title: Linebattle 2.0! Customisation & Progression
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Fall into line and ready your musket with the release of the Linebattle 2.0 major update for Holdfast: Nations At War. Featuring player progression and customisation, the sergeant class, a rework of the game’s classes, new animations for all firearms, improved audio and much more. 

Celebrating this anticipated release, we’re [b]slashing the price of the game to 65%[/b] and all its respective [b]cosmetic DLCs to 15-20%[/b]. Now’s a better time than ever to join the beloved Holdfast community! We hope to see you soon on the battlefield with us.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

Before taking a read below of all that will come with this major update to the game, why not first check out the update’s cinematic release trailer? 

[previewyoutube=v9Mc8MUiCCw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Grenadier Regiments DLC[/h2]

Releasing alongside this update is the Grenadier Regiments DLC. Stand side by side with your fellow elites in dashing new uniforms available now.

Content present in Holdfast’s DLCs is purely cosmetic. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay. Your kind generosity will be put to good use and bring this genre of roleplay warfare games which all of us are fond of into the limelight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107250

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/fa6db13e5a3520bec01afe1aefd8d1a18b24549e.gif[/img]

[h2]Progression & Customisation[/h2]

Battle-hardened soldiers will now be able to cosmetically display their skill through Holdfast’s new player progression and customisation mechanics. 

Customisation is per faction and per class while also being tied into your class level. After reaching certain class levels players will be able to select from 17 new unlockable heads in the game, equip other nations' muskets, and melee weaponry and specify the pitch of their character's voice for shouts and calls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/07b7be7a5fe3a18c5968b2c028aed35abaf7b9ed.gif[/img]

Cavalry classes will also be able to unlock and select different horses to ride on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0fed0b25b49331a4db64aab20d3cad3c0b6055d7.gif[/img]

[h2]Sergeants & Rocketeers[/h2]

The sergeant arrives! This fearsome new class on the battlefield has the ability to order similar commands with buffs as the officer class to the rank and file and comes equipped with a long spontoon to face off any brave fellows who should dare challenge them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/bb7e6a38fe75a7a4e6dd1226f89f581607552fd2.gif[/img]

Previously something only specific to the British Empire, the rocketeer class is now playable across all factions in Holdfast: Nations At War. Previous to this update this class served little to no gameplay purpose but it has been now redesigned to specifically excel at the use of rocket launchers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/734584008c05c0473bbd17b2fe6b9b274194f9eb.gif[/img]

[h2]Squads & Class Redesign[/h2]

A variety of classes featured in Holdfast: Nations At War throughout this update have undergone a 
considerable rework to ensure classes not only have a place but also a purpose on the battlefield. This is the first version in a series of redesigns towards this effort.

Significantly reducing the amount of downtime and running spent on the game’s Napoleonic front, the flag forward position mechanic accessible to the officer class has now been redesigned to feature a squad system. Everyone apart of the squad including the officer himself will be able to spawn on this forward position making it easier to play the game in groups where the most fun is to be had. Additionally to this, more classes can now spawn on these forward positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/729e5650000a40c7ff2766163c01fb63eada5b6b.gif[/img]

Sappers now also have the ability to build ammo depots that can be strategically moved and placed around the battlefield to ensure everyone remains well equipped. Ammunition has been reduced across all weapons in balance with this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/71f6b8ede2dc5294ab7dd1c17f22329a6f5d5d96.gif[/img]

Carpenters looking to deal some real up close and personal damage with their two-handed axe can now enter a berserk mode by pressing their ability button (default ‘Q‘) allowing them to swing their axe in additional directions while having a slight run speed increase.

There’s plenty more to this first version of the class redesign! The full extent of the class rework changes can be found within the class selection UI under the abilities and traits section and within the changelog of this blog post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b2d6302579356f72d34d6e7c1604920d579956f6.gif[/img]

[h2]Animations & Audio[/h2]

As part of our ongoing efforts to improve Holdfast, this update brings with it brand new animations for all firearms across the game’s Napoleonic front (excluding melee weapons). Featuring new reload and firing animations for both the muskets and pistols, new bayonet attaching and detaching animations and new healing animations for the surgeons amongst other animation tweaks and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/17e2d43c591324ef2e4198cd46af882c99ba5674.gif[/img]

As a result of these new animations, surgeons healing and soldiers attaching or detaching their bayonets can now perform these actions while crouching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/9002981ffe3b7cb0724eed00bc355d163c898501.gif[/img]

Reloading and firing sounds for muskets and pistols have been completely reworked. A small collection of maps now also feature unique in-world ambience sounds to further develop the atmosphere of Holdfast’s battlefields. 

In-world audio across all maps is an ongoing process, those wishing to get a taste of what is to come on the audio front of the game should head down to the docks on Port Nile or sit with a picnic under the great oak tree on Ravenstone.

[h2]5 New Battlefields[/h2]

In this release, we’re introducing 5 new linebattle-themed battle maps. Engage in heated volleys or glorious bayonet charges on Al Kimar Pyramids, Avignon, Pillerone Pass, Vanoise Heights or Hudree Marsh. Hop in, stand shoulder to shoulder and make your stand on these new battlefields!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ba8221ad201f37ddfface94ae4d5fdf598188f7a.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Optimisations[/h2]

Efforts to optimise the game for low to high-end PCs have continued throughout the development of the Linebattle 2.0 update. Bringing Holdfast to a wider audience by making the game increasingly accessible will continue to be at the forefront of development to further aid in bringing this leading title in the roleplay shooter genre into the limelight. 

Experiment with different graphic preset settings in the game to gather the performance to graphical fidelity balance that you desire. This will not be the last time you’ll be hearing from us working on optimisation-oriented updates. 

Map loading is now also significantly faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c0a48fa1413c587b0b724fa1056e7ad384f0c1a7.gif[/img]

[h2]Community Discord[/h2]

Whether you’re interested in modding, participating in community events or just wanting to get involved deeper within our great community, the Holdfast Discord is the place to be. It is your central hub for all things Holdfast and houses a plethora of channels dedicated to event and game announcements, regiment (clan) recruitment, game support, suggestions, history discussion and more.

notes.title: Summer Sale! 1.5x Increased XP
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Kick the summer off with a bang as Holdfast goes on sale at an[b] impressive 60% off[/b]! Running parallel with this sale all DLC’s are now available at upwards of [b]15% off on selected DLCs[/b]. Hop on Holdfast and check out the newly released Regiment Assemble update featuring 3 brand new maps and plenty of new additions to the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

notes.title: Regiments Assemble! 3 New Maps
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Raise the banners and fall into rank with the release of the Regiments Assemble update. This update comes as precursor to the great ‘Linebattle 2.0’ update releasing to Holdfast in August. However, this update is rather plentiful in itself featuring 3 new maps, a new scoreboard, new medal designs and the introduction of new regiment registry features to the game. 

So before you head to the frontline be sure to take a read below of all that is coming to Holdfast with this update. Be sure to join us on Discord for all things Holdfast!

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]

[h2]Registry Upgrade[/h2]

Regiment owners rejoice! Coming with this update are a plethora of new features and upgrades to the in-game regiment registry system. 

Regiment owners will now be able to assign unique rank icons to each rank within their regiment that will then be displayed alongside player names and on the scoreboard in-game to showcase their position within the regiment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/be650705b6abaff4d87046c0a08a9047a672c9e6.png[/img]

Alongside this, promoting and assigning ranks has been streamlined to allow automated rank and tag assigning based upon a format defined by the regiment’s owner. When a regiment member is promoted their tags will now automatically update in their name, no longer will you need to hassle new recruits to ‘fix your tags!’, the in-game system will handle that all for you.

Players are given the option to opt out of this system via the naming options in the settings menu should they wish to temporarily merc with another clan. Regiment owners can also opt out of this system if they desire by simply leaving the tag formatting empty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c05ce11f485d51648d1577b4688ed352cd809d66.png[/img]

Those assigned as regiment moderators can now also kick and promote enlisted individuals. You will also no longer have to remove ranks to insert additional ones in between. Simply arrange their sorting ID and you’ll be good to go.

New custom regiment specific emblems have also been added into the regiment registry banner editor, these can all be found at the end of the symbol selection in the banner editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/85538cdd3ff80fc36ca2fdd7dcf29d222875eb58.png[/img]

A big thank you to those who took the time to send over their custom icons, any regiments wishing to have their own icons included should reach out via discord to [b]Harper#0410[/b] to then be added in future updates.

[h2]A New Scoreboard[/h2]

To compliment the regiment rank icons and to make the scoreboard easier to comprehend at glance we have designed and implemented a new in-game scoreboard. Parallel to this we have also re-designed every single medal found within the game and introduced new designs for the leaderboard ranking medals. 

Take a look at the new scoreboard and medals below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0a75596fafc73e09fece93918b15bf8dcb7ae5c8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8b6f91ca9b44e009307d5ca65529fceb78346c55.png[/img]

We’ve also created unique icons to represent the many classes one can play as once they hop in Holdfast. Different classes are playable across the game’s Napoleonic and Great War fronts on both land and at sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0e28578d3f447bbaebaebc48f0eb9158bfa089aa.png[/img]

[h2]3 New Maps! Freurlund Revisited[/h2]

The battle of the bridges! Featuring in this update are 3 new maps all of which have bridge crossings as a focus on their battlefields respectively. This update brings 2 new maps to Nations At War and 1 new medium sized map for Frontlines. Take a look at these maps in more detail below.

[b]Ryhall Vale - Nation At War[/b]

A deep crevice carves its way through the vale of Ryhall with rickety wooden bridges spanning across its crest. Watch your footing as the battle rages on from one side of the deep expanse to the other because there’s nothing that will save you from the drop below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/efbf914bdb5aa5ef472c02e7e1d9d0589362f5eb.png[/img]

[b]Ravenstone - Nation At War[/b]

A peaceful river flows through the valley of the farmland of Ravenstone with stone walls offering opposing lines of defense. Trampling on crops and using haystacks as cover will be a common sight on this battlefield as players try to push across the river to victory and glory! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/941497138bb572272df719a20b5742de7e5f4a25.png[/img]

[b]Lisart Valley - Frontlines[/b]

The once great train passage of Lisart has been ravaged by the great war. Take cover behind derailed train carriages from the rattling machine guns that overlook the central stone bridge and flank past the flowing waterfall that feeds the river below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6a272ddf1a83a7495b52bca48bbd110e117da57f.png[/img]

[b]Freurlund Revisited - Frontlines[/b]

Alongside the introduction of these new maps we have also introduced an update to Freurlund which now allows it to be played on the invasion gamemode for Holdfast Frontlines. Heros Landing has also ungone some changes to ease the landing process for attacks on the initial phase of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2b2b4623d085cfb7cf7c01ecb092710ea2562147.png[/img]

[h2]Linebattle 2.0 Major Update[/h2]

Coming in the following month/s is the greatly anticipated Linebattle 2.0 update, the team has been very hard at work preparing this next major update for the game. 

One key element of the Linebattle 2.0 Update is a new focus on character progression and customisation. Players across all eras of Holdfast will now be able to customise and progress each individual soldier (class) found within the game. 

Players will be able to select and unlock up to 15+ heads featuring impressive facial hair, accessories and scars by leveling up their class and completing certain tasks. You will also be able to set your character's voice pitch. We will be looking into expanding upon the customisation in the future as the game develops.

As mentioned in the Linebattle 2.0 announcement blog a new artillery type will be making its way to the Napoleonic side of the game. The Howitzer will feature a unique firing ability that allows you to set a fuse timer to explode the howitzer shot mid-air which will then rain down shrapnel upon those below.

Here’s an exclusive preview of this new artillery type in action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e177dcea71f2c1205fd4b1fb41c8e192599ef525.gif[/img]

Take a read of the Linebattle 2.0 blog post [url=https://discord.com/invite/holdfastgame]here[/url] to find out about what else is coming in that update. Expect some additional content to also make it into the game - This will be one of the largest updates to hit Holdfast since the release of Frontlines!

We’re extremely excited and we hope that you are as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[b]Changelog 80 - Game Version v2.6.8208.20814[/b]

[b]Regiment Registry[/b]

[b]●[/b] Regiments that haven’t submitted any score (by playing on official servers) for 10 consecutive days will be categorised as inactive. Those that are marked as inactive are not deleted, they remain static until a regiment member submits score again. Inactive regiments will not show in the #regiment-registry Discord channel.

[b]●[/b] The regiment registry is now much quicker. Have a go at opening one of the 150+ player regiments to see this for yourself.

[b]●[/b] Moderators can now kick enlisted. They are unable to kick other moderators and the regiment owner. The moderators will now also feature a unique stud icon in the registry.

[b]●[/b] You will no longer have to remove ranks to insert additional ones in between. Simply arrange their sorting ID and you’ll be good to go.

[b]●[/b] Regiment owners are now able to assign a rank icon within the regiment manager. These will show in game next to the enlistee’s name both in game and on the round scoreboard.

[b]●[/b] Promoting and assigning tags has been streamlined allowing you to now automatically assign regiment tags and ranks to your enlisted. The ‘Registry Name Formatter’ will allow owners to format their regiment’s tags as desired. By default players will use the given format of their regiment, however, at the enlistee’s discretion they will have the options to disable this feature from their name within the settings menu.


[b]3 New Maps! Freurlund Revisited[/b]

[b]●[/b] Ryhall Vale is now playable in Holdfast. Join the Nations At War game type to check it out.

[b]●[/b] Ravenstone is now playable in Holdfast. Join the Nations At War game type to check it out.

[b]●[/b] Lisart Valley is now playable in Holdfast. Join the Frontlines gametype to check it out.

[b]●[/b] Introduced Invasion support for Freurlund. Join the Frontlines gametype to check it out.


[b]A New Scoreboard[/b]

[b]●[/b] Made the scoreboard easier to comprehend at glance by giving a well deserved cleanup to this UI.

[b]●[/b] Re-designed every single medal found within the game and introduced new designs for the leaderboard ranking medals. 


[b]New Class Identification Icons[/b]

[b]●[/b] Created unique icons to represent the many classes in Holdfast. 
» Classes on Holdfast’s Napoleonic army front.
» Classes on Holdfast's Napoleonic naval front.
» Classes on Holdfast’s WW1 front.


[b]Holdfast SDK[/b]

[b]●[/b] Updated the script SDK DLL files to match the new Frontlines standard.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with local scope mod variables not working. Now local scope variables should be defined as mod_variable_local <string>.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the stonewall prop naming conventions.

[b]●[/b] Introduced several new props to the Holdfast SDK.
» Mountain cliff dark rock variants.
» Lettuce props.
» Carrot props.
» Gallipoli ivy.
» Gallipoli ferns and plans.
» Small train.
» Small lumber carriage.
» Small liquid carriage.
» Small train track set.
» Pre-destroyed brittany houses and variants.
» Pier with stands.


[b]Server Administration[/b]

[b]●[/b] Players that get banned directly through the server’s file will now be immediately kicked from the server once the file is reloaded.


[b]Gameplay Additions[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced spawn points for officer tables at the top of the destroyed church on Foxhole.

[b]●[/b] Removed a few MGs that covered the beachhead on Heroes Landing.

[b]●[/b] Moved the flag closer to the shoreline on Heroes Landing.

[b]●[/b] Changed a few tree sizes on Grassy Plains 5 to make them match ones pre the graphical additions with the Frontlines update.

[b]●[/b] Updated Ancient Plains to balance gameplay and reduce its size.

[b]●[/b] Port Nile is now playable on Army Conquest.

[b]●[/b] Introduced additional clime-able ladders to the back of Fort Salettes and a mortar for the attackers to make use of during the siege.


[b]Optimisations[/b]

[b]●[/b] Performed several minor LOD-based optimisations on props.

[b]●[/b] Optimised several textures in game to reduce VRAM usage.

[b]●[/b] Optimised Freurlund.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Performed a few additions to prevent people from getting stuck on map load.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where custom uniforms could sometimes crash the server on load.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with mod prefabs not featuring flag poles for the Kingdom of Italy, Central and Allied Powers factions.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the trees floating above ground on Fort Pierre.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue that allowed field gun cannonballs to explode using the explosive properties of a mortar.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue on Fort Pierre which disabled fire particles that killed players from showing if playing on the lower settings.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with occlusion on Wasteland.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with a few of the fence posts on Berkton Green not playing the correct audio and particle effects.

[b]●[/b] Replaced the old background trees on Fort Winston with new ones.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with incorrectly positioned water on Fort Winston.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with a tree floating above ground on Aunby Valley.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue on Causeways which disabled fire particles that killed players from showing if playing on the lower settings.

[b]●[/b] Updated a few of the trees on Causeways to be in line with the graphical upgrade introduced during the Frontlines update.

[b]●[/b] Ensured that all ruin props on Tahir Desert are applied one uniform sandstone brick texture.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue on Desert Plains (S) having twice the spawnable Carpenter classes available instead of the Sapper class.

[b]●[/b] Removed moonbows from showing.


[b]Changelog 81 - Game Version v2.6.8210.20814[/b]

[b]●[/b] The scoreboard is now more transparent allowing for greater visibility when having this UI open.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple layouting issues with the scoreboard.

[b]●[/b] Increased the speed at which players scroll down the scoreboard.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which restricted players to 25 character limit instead of 32 when inputting a custom name.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the new symbols for banners in the regiment registry weren’t selectable.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the 'Use Regiment Name' toggle not functioning as intended.

[b]●[/b] Solved a bug which prevented the class identification icons from showing in the spawn menu.


Do feel free to join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/holdfastgame]Discord[/url] for a chat. You’ll also find many regiments (game clans) on there willing to show you the ropes.

Once again, we thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours. ːrheartrː


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/64752cbe85e826e1678d4abeff312f08efa81198.png[/img]

notes.title: Join Us! Holdfast At The OTK Games Expo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Dust off your parade dress and shine your bayonets! Holdfast: Nations At War will be featured at the first-ever OTK Games Expo. Holdfast will be showcased in all its glory on [b]June 8th, 2022[/b] streaming live from [url=twitch.tv/asmongold]twitch.tv/asmongold[/url]. 

The OTK Games Expo is an online showcase of new and upcoming games, ranging from a variety of genres. Holdfast has kindly been accepted and will take centre stage featuring an exclusive interview with Holdfast’s Producer Refleax, a community showcase trailer and much more. We invite everyone to tune in on June 8th as we continue to bring the genre of roleplay shooter games into the limelight.

Take a read below about more of our plans and be sure to keep an eye out for the upcoming trailer as there’ll be a sneak preview at the end of an update landing soon to Holdfast: Frontlines.

Follow the OTK Games Expo here: https://twitter.com/OTKGamesExpo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a5c1db908db590b22ee613a58e1335a988540424.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Collaboration[/h2]

Leading up to the OTK Games Expo we have been working hand in hand with the video and live streaming content creators of Holdfast to make a community trailer that showcases all the glorious, funny and ridiculous moments that come with Holdfast. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/af14b80ea0fefd9f3de6cf0e706e5695805f4249.gif[/img]

We’ve collected some of the greatest and iconic clips from Holdfast to create a trailer that will show everyone what the Holdfast experience is really all about. We also took some time to reach out to some of the good fellows creating Holdfast content to get an insight into what inspires them to produce content of the game.

[b]₿itcoin ₿aron[/b]
[url=twitch.tv/thebitcoinbaron]twitch.tv/thebitcoinbaron[/url]

“I started playing in June 2019 with matches of 75v75 players, and tons of different classes. Holdfast hooks you in with its large vistas and the grand spectacle of historical warfare, even if you’re just following someone else's orders, it makes you feel part of something. 

At the heart of the game, it is all about the crazy, characters who step up and hit that push to talk button, whether they are role-playing as a 17th Century Officer leading the infantry, blasting out 80s classics, or partitioning off some corner of a map for a bare-knuckle fight club, the community is very creative, and proximity voice chat helps a great deal.

Because I use my voice in-game, and because Holdfast is a close-knit community, I’ve made a lot of friends inside the game, from all over the world. There are lots of cool people that turn up regularly for streams, and I got a lucky start in streaming this, by finding a fantastic group of friends (bruceluke420, nickymadison, pirategamer123 and thrashingbacon to name the main culprits). There are also a lot of random people that dropped by the stream, stayed around and became big supporters too. I have a nice little community of watchers that come by, and are the absolute best.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ff2f9034405751e48692add722f2d3a2a1c9a0c6.gif[/img]

[b]5uh Dude[/b]
[url=youtube.com/5uhdude]youtube.com/5uhdude[/url]

“I first got into Holdfast in 2018 after seeing a funny Twitch clip of it. The community is what brought me to the game, to begin with, and it's what keeps me playing to this day! I think it's just a great mix of all the best parts of gaming, from funny moments with friends to the epic charges and battles with 150 people!

To anyone who is looking into creating Holdfast content, my best advice is to get to know the regiments in the Holdfast community! They host some awesome events that make for good fun and great YouTube content!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8b1b1f0d42fef7296850e8d74e4c189ba179b752.gif[/img]

[h2]Get Involved![/h2]

Working alongside the content creators of the Holdfast community has been an absolute pleasure of ours and we look forward to soon revealing the trailer which will include a sneak preview of the next game-changing update coming to Holdfast: Frontlines.

If you’re interested in connecting with other Holdfast content creators or are just wanting to get involved deeper within our great community, the Holdfast official Discord server is the place to be! It is your central hub for all things Holdfast and houses a plethora of channels dedicated to the event and game announcements, regiment recruitment, game support, media, history discussion and more. 

Click below to join today!

notes.title: Modding! Holdfast SDK 5.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/0f487e1306c79baa72a8fbc8a6cd412e911e9d6e.png[/img]

Artisans rejoice with the release of the Holdfast SDK 5.0 update! Featuring over 1500+ new props, uniform atlasing and newly exposed code for scripting. This update comes as a precursor to the linebattle major update landing next month and artisans are encouraged to utilise these additions to the SDK to bring forth the next generation linebattle maps.

This update to the SDK tools will bring a new wave of community creations and not only make modding more accessible but also provide new opportunities for unique custom experiences such as commander battles to be created.

Join us on Discord today to get involved.

discord.gg/holdfastgame

[h2]The Editor Experience[/h2]

An important addition to this update is the streamlining of the SDK editor. The first step to achieve this was by updating to a newer version of Unity which now enables artisans to utilise the terrain hole functionalities as seen in Holdfast: Frontlines and a whole slew of new features that come with the upgraded SDK engine.

In addition to this, to make the map creation process less taxing we have introduced on-demand loading to the assets available in the SDK. No longer will you have to wait while the SDK loads up every single prop, rather you will simply only load the assets as and when they are being used in your scene. New filters have also been introduced to make searching for assets easier.

Following the release of this update we will be providing some informative quick and easy to grasp Holdfast SDK video tutorials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b3ffb319c2d64bc3ca69e78402b6627aed5e1608.gif[/img]

[h2]The Editor Expanded[/h2]

We have also spent some time expanding upon the already available possibilities of the Holdfast SDK. There have been some rather amusing, epic and extravagant modifications made across the years and we look forward to supporting the Holdfast modding community in their efforts to make new experiences for us all to enjoy.

[b]Uniform Editor[/b]

Reduce the download size of your uniforms by packing multiple uniforms together using and atlasing their textures into one file. You will optimise your uniform collection by packing textures into an atlas reducing draw calls. It takes some experience to do but this will greatly reduce the impact a mod uniform has on the client FPS.

Uniform creators will also now have the ability to introduce multiple variations for an existing uniform. IE. Randomly change the colour of the pants for your Line Infantry uniform when the player spawns with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2945bc0a7c354f5f0024d94372f4d14123614944.png[/img]

[b]Map Editor[/b]

Artisans can now find over 1500+ new assets to place within their own battlefields, featuring all the new props from the Frontlines update and some additional unused assets too. Even Fred, our beloved can now make an appearance on community made maps.

Moreover, the new Offensive and Invasion game modes will now be supported on community made maps. We are really looking forward to what the community can come up with using these new gamemodes.

Finally we have introduced new improvements to aid map makers with the graphical fidelity of their maps. Map makers will now be provided with temporary terrain textures inside of the SDK which will then be replaced by high-quality terrain textures in game. A new renderer for grass has also been implemented to allow for thicker fields without an FPS cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ae060136457817c0da6494b1fdd15b897aa35ca5.png[/img]

[h2]Spotlight. Commander Battles[/h2]

After exposing the functionalities of Holdfast’s bots to allow increased control of their functions and the brilliant work of the Commander Battles team, players can now take charge of a line of men and engage in battles on a scale never seen before. The team have set forth a new era for Holdfast modifications and have surpassed all expectations of the possibilities that the SDK presents. 

The team behind the Commander Battles modification has a lot more in store for this new game mode so please do join them on Discord! Everyone at Anvil Game Studios will make sure they have all the tools necessary to continue improving the mode.

[url=discord.gg/GhSXaPh46u]discord.gg/holdfastcommander[/url]

[b]Join A Server[/b]

Hop in one of the below servers featuring this game mode to have a go at the Commander mod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e5b16b5ab7fc64957793fb5112dd7e35c65085e7.png[/img] [b]EU - Europe[/b]
Commander Battle | EU | Powered by BMGHosting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/da4dd81283cde68a2ab67f7523f7a14a028adce6.png[/img] [b]US - Unites States[/b]
Commander Battle | NA | Powered by BMGHosting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/cae19b6412dc8f3c8ce390f41a6b30da22e051bd.gif[/img]

[b]How To Play[/b]

Once in, you can use the !addBots command to spawn yourself a line of infantry like so.

[u]Type In Chat[/u]
[b]●[/b] !addBots <Amount> [NamePrefix] [ClassName] [UniformID]
» Elements in [] brackets are optional.

[u]Examples[/u]
[b]●[/b] !addBots 20 
» Spawns 20 Line Infantry bots.

[b]●[/b] !addBots 20 [98th]
» Spawns 20 Line Infantry bots with prefix ‘[98th]’ in their name.

[b]●[/b] !addBots 20 [98th] guard 
» Spawns 20 Guard bots with prefix ‘[98th]’ in their name.

[b]●[/b] !addBots 20 [98th] lineinfantry 2 
» Spawns 20 Line Infantry bots using uniform id 2 and prefixed by the ‘[98th]’ tag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/605daa6b0b11ee83bbe99232ddd6774f4e6eabf1.gif[/img]

[b]Issue Orders[/b]

[b]●[/b] Form Line (Press Q then 1)
» This will form your men into a line facing forward.

[b]●[/b] Aim (Press Q then 2)
» Tell your line to aim in the direction you are aiming at the time the command is issued. Note: Aiming at a ground point will make your line aim straight at that point, while if you aim in the air (for long-range shot calls for example), your men will mirror your aim direction and pitch. Take that into account when engaging at long distances.

[b]●[/b] Fire (Press Q then 3)
» Your line will fire their muskets then reload.

[b]●[/b] Charge (Press Q then 6)
» Orders your line to charge at the enemy line or commander that you are directly looking at.

[b]●[/b] Toggle Double Rank (Press Alt+2 or N)
» Next time your line forms or follows you, it will form into a single/double rank.

[b]●[/b] Break Line (Press Q then 7)
» Orders your men to stop aiming (if they are), and removes the officer line.

[b]●[/b] Follow Commander (Press Alt+1 or B)
» Orders your line to follow you. Starting from the closest end of the line, your men will proceed to follow you on the battlefield in a single line. If the man in front reaches the Commander's position, the entire line will stop, forming a column behind the Commander.

[b]●[/b] Crouch Line (Press Alt+3)
» Orders your line to crouch or stand up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/269d6758d9da12e5472708d01dc295b49e046a96.gif[/img]

[h2]Artisans! Get Involved[/h2]

Should you find yourself inspired to get stuck in with the Holdfast SDK to make experiences of your own, then don’t hesitate to join the official Holdfast discord server and acquire the Artisan role. 

To acquire this role simply visit the [b]#getting-started[/b] modding channel and press the reaction emoji below the post. This will assign you the artisan role and give you access to all available modding community channels.

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/efa2e69e437820f956c7c678b3a49b85a80adb05.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[b]Changelog 79 - Game Version v2.5.8175.24022[/b]

[b]Holdfast SDK 5.0 - Level Editor[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced over 1500 new assets to design new maps with. There are more than 3600 assets to design maps with.

[b]●[/b] Drastically improved the loading of assets in the level editor.

[b]●[/b] Improved the performance of the editor while it is loading assets.

[b]●[/b] Exposed multiple functions enabling artisans to link custom destructible objects, have custom climbable props and prevent weather from showing inside buildings among other functions.

[b]●[/b] Introduced a new system allowing artisans to use Holdfast’s original terrain textures greatly reducing the map’s download size.

[b]●[/b] You can now collapse the filters to make up for more space.

[b]●[/b] UI now remembers what state your settings were between fresh launches.

[b]●[/b] Performed several additions to improve the level editor interface user experience and looks.
Set a minimum width to this UI so artisans don’t hide it erroneously.

[b]●[/b] Placed items on the ground will now align with other objects and not just the terrain. This allows for the easy placement of objects on top of objects (ie. in buildings).

[b]●[/b] Updated all the plugins being used in the editor to the latest version.


[b]Holdfast SDK 5.0 - Uniform Editor[/b]

[b]●[/b] Performed several additions to improve the uniform editor interface user experience and looks.

[b]●[/b] Introduced a new SDK Tools -> Screenshot Editor Tool which can aid artisans quickly taking screenshots for their custom uniforms.

[b]●[/b] Artisans can now package multiple uniforms in the same modification bundle.
» Reduce the download size of your uniform collection for your regiment by packing textures into an atlas.
» Optimise your uniform collection by packing textures into an atlas reducing draw calls.
» Package all of your regiment uniforms into one bundle to reduce complexity for event hosts.
» Ability to have multiple variations for an existing uniform. (ie. randomly change the colour of the pants for your Line Infantry uniform when the player spawns with it).


[b]Holdfast SDK 5.0 - Flag Editor[/b]

[b]●[/b] Performed several additions to improve the flag editor interface user experience and looks.

[b]●[/b] Artisans can now package multiple flags in the same modification bundle alongside uniforms.


[b]Holdfast SDK 5.0 - Misc.[/b]

[b]●[/b] Updated the SDK to Unity 2020.3.34f1 exposing additional terrain functionality.


[b]Holdfast SDK 5.0 - Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues when creating a new map using the Holdfast SDK editor tool.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with filters not working as intended when used in conjunction with search.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues whit dragging props into the scene to improve the experience.

[b]●[/b] Removed the ‘Prefab Type’ filter since this is now obsolete.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with layout sizes being wrong when undocking some windows.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the preferences window would crash the editor on launch.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues with props being half-placed under the terrain when dragged due to incorrect pivot placement.


[b]Map Balance & Changes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced more spawn locations to the final defender objectives on Fort Imraan.

[b]●[/b] Introduced another climbable rope near the ‘A’ capture point on Fort Imraan.

[b]●[/b] Engineers can no longer build defences to block doorways on the final defender objective on Fort Imraan.

[b]●[/b] Improved texture fidelity on several cliff props, rocks and stump textures.

[b]●[/b] Optimise multiple other textures to reduce VRAM usage.


[b]General Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with players getting stuck in a box when using one of the mortars on Fort Imraan.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with missing faces on a cliff near the artillery battery on Heroes Landing.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with missing faces on the stone walls a the back of the town on Heroes Landing.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues with cliff terrain blending on Berkton Green.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with ambient occlusion producing a ghosting effect. This will also improve performance.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the roundEndFactionWin erroring out when no variables were inputted.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with players sliding with the out of bound colliders on King George.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with missing stair colliders on the windmill base platform.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with alt-tabbing when in fullscreen mode changing to an incorrect resolution.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the main menu not showing in the game.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which enabled players to input empty names.

[b]●[/b] Possible fix for occlusion issues on Fort Al Farid.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with water being disconnected on Island Plains.


[b]Other Additions[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced a new broadcast mode enabling messages to show from ‘Game’ rather than ‘Admin’. Valid for the automation of server restarts amongst other gameplay features.

[b]●[/b] Introduced a ‘set ShouldUnlockMouse true/false’ command to support UI unlocking for mods.

[b]●[/b] Tweaked the scoreboard player count to look better when triple digits are involved.

[b]●[/b] Renamed the ‘Commander Battles’ override to ‘Commander’ so it fits better in the server browser.

[b]●[/b] Bots no longer show any medals.


[b]Changelog 80 - Game Version v2.5.8180.29273[/b]

[b]Client-Side Hotfix[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the water would overlay on screen due to an issue with anti-aliasing.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple instances of corrupted audio.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the river on Sacred Valley.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the server's 'Welcome Message' not being displayed.


We look forward to seeing what the community will produce with these tools.

Until next time, may good health be yours. ːrheartrː



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/64752cbe85e826e1678d4abeff312f08efa81198.png[/img]
