notes.title: Game Update. Battlefield Additions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ab1ae6cb75e3f3e476158c67587b658d9b2f1b03.png[/img]

Right after the release of the recent major update bringing with it 8 new battlefields, roleplay gestures and a whole slew of content to dive into, we’ll be pushing another featuring multiple bug fixes along with changes targeting gameplay balance. 

It’s been a delight welcoming all the new fellows joining the ranks of this much-beloved community. Thank you for your great show of support! Rest assured that you will be seeing more from us in future updates.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/

If you haven’t done so already, do join us on Discord. It’s a great way to stay in touch with everything that goes on in Holdfast and perhaps join one of the many game clans by looking at the [b]#regiment-registry[/b] channel while you’re at it.

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]


[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/88e05815524a48a619a78c5c08d35a117e6758d0.png[/img][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2f96ea558823e5b704287bff6664cb60430d7dee.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[b]Changelog 58 - Game Version 1.9.7559.27288[/b]


[b]Cavalry Units[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sprinting while on horseback was no longer working as intended.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue when striking with a sword while on horseback having an increased delay.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which results in some strikes with a sword while on horseback to miss its target if you’d hit your own horse and the enemy at the same time.

[b]●[/b] Players will now find it slightly easier to block an incoming strike from a player on horseback.


[b]Infantry Units[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the French Polish ‘Vistula’ Legion Line Infantry and Infantry Officer having a head that is smaller and therefore not particularly fitting on their shoulders. Don’t you worry, they were still sufficiently capable in the battlefield albeit this one minor mishap.

[b]●[/b] Adjusted the claymore to better fit in the Scottish Infantry Officer’s hands.


[b]Surgeons[/b]

[b]●[/b] Surgeons are no longer able to heal themselves or others whilst under water.

[b]●[/b] Surgeons are no longer able to heal themselves or others whilst carrying any object.


[b]Drowning[/b]

[b]●[/b] You will now take more damage the longer you stay underwater.


[b]Naval Warfront[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes results in only rowboats spawning for the invaders during the Coastal Siege game mode.


[b]Roleplay Gestures[/b]

[b]●[/b] You may now continue to chat while doing roleplay gestures.


[b]Game Load[/b]

[b]●[/b] Optimised the instantiating of audio during map load to slightly improve map load times.


[b]Game Levels[/b]

[b]●[/b] Updated the loading screen for Grassy Plains 4 (L), Grassy Plains 5 (L) & Island Plains 1 (L).

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with spawns on Sacred Valley being inverted on the Army Battlefield game mode.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the number of cavalry units on Sacred Valley to 2 per faction.

[b]●[/b] Changed one of the rocket launchers present on Sacred Valley to face outwards and included a wooden platform indicative of where it respawns should it be destroyed.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the water texture on Sacred Valley.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the rocks missing faces on Autumn Watch.

[b]●[/b] Removed cavalry units from being playable on Autumn Watch.

[b]●[/b] Improved performance on Autumn Watch.

[b]●[/b] Re-adjusted the conquest capture points on Autumn Watch.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with players being able to fire their weapon while standing on certain rocks present in Fort Darial.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the A and B capture points on Fort Darial being inverted.

[b]●[/b] Performed some minor optimisations on Fort Darial.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where you can swim inside the cave on Marquette even though no water was visible.

[b]●[/b] Placed more ammo boxes for artillery pieces on Marquette.

[b]●[/b] Included some more furniture inside the houses on Marquette. However, the good majority of this furniture has been turned into firewood to combat the harsh winter.

[b]●[/b] Sealed the well on Marquette so players can no longer get stuck inside it.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with spawn points on Marquette.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple client-side and server-side exceptions on maps.


[b]Server Administration[/b]

[b]●[/b] Restructured the output of the [i]rc shiplist[/i] and [i]rc playerlist[/i] command and included additional functionality to them.
» [i]rc shiplist[/i] now shows the ship names alongside their IDs.
» [i]rc playerlist not-ingame[/i] can now be used to display a list of individuals that are connected to the server but didn’t spawn. Use this to remove players that are not partaking in an event and simply staying in freeflight or spectate.


[b]Map Rotations[/b]

[b]●[/b] Sacred Valley is now playable on the Official Army Front servers.

[b]●[/b] You will now find newer maps introduced in Version 1.8 appearing more frequently on the Army Front rotation.

[b]●[/b] Increased reinforcements for the defenders by 15 on all siege maps with the exception of Fort Darial.

[b]●[/b] Increased reinforcements for the defenders by 60 on Fort Darial.


Until next time, may good health be yours.

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

Refleax, Rycon, Dreas, Wrexial, Walki, Cameron, Jackson, Rejenorst, Harper & Storey

notes.title: Major Update! Battlefields Expanded
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6840a7ad7513f0246b90c8f832fd96b63be7ad8b.png[/img]

Assemble your infantrymen and advance your cannons as Holdfast: Nations At War adds eight new battlefields to commence fire in volleys, siege formidable fortifications or charge for King and country on! Lead others into the fray as a Scottish Officer in the new High-Command DLC and so much more.

Gather the game for a price less than that of a few quality teas as Holdfast: Nations At War embarks on a [b]two-week long[/b] sale in celebration of this release. We look forward to welcoming plenty of new good fellows within the much-beloved community.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/Holdfast_Nations_At_War/

Come ready yourself for battle on these new grounds by taking a look at what each battlefield has to offer.

[previewyoutube=1c5t6wU21V4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1c5t6wU21V4[/previewyoutube]

[h1]8 New Battlefields![/h1]
Take your fight into snow-covered towns, engage in fierce close-quarters combat in the streets of Heartmound, topple fortified positions with artillery pieces or stand shoulder to shoulder on plains maps during organised play.

There’s plenty to look out for in these new battlegrounds.

[b]Autumn Watch[/b]
The rolling hills and valleys that have carved their way through this small farming and mill town prove for interesting grounds to fight on. Separated by a valley river, Autumn Watch puts enemies against enemies in gruelling battles over important river crossings, useful mortar dugouts and well-covering ruins. 

When fighting in this land ensure your men remain alert as the verticality differences caused by the valleys and hills will surely lend their hand in causing death from above and below…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/309c25919d270b068a79951584210db7233995ac.png[/img]

[b]Heartmound[/b]
Fighting on the streets of the once peaceful, now garrisoned, church town of Heartmound offers an engaging battlefield to conquer. Surrounded by a small ivy-covered brick wall a holy ground can be found. The town's church makes for the centrepiece of the battlefield and will undoubtedly see its grounds spoiled through the acts of muskets and powder.

Coordination and timed assaults against the many holdouts found in and around the town will be the key to victory on this battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8323ab82a99ecf1bbca79f6ca48289dc135f60c5.png[/img]

[b]Marquette[/b]
This old cold market town will see as many bodies fall as snowflakes do settling on its ground, either from the sharp shot of a rifleman from across open plains yonder or the silent death of hyperthermia from the freezing lakes that surround.

Though Marquette may not have the same rolling hills and valleys of the other battlefields, plenty of cover still remains, put to use the tall stretching wheatfields as cover or progress forward clearing the compounds and barns one by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b24d41960a741fce261df8a7508fae9fdfebc590.png[/img]

[b]Sacred Valley[/b]
The ancient valley running through this battlefield has laid eyes upon many iterations of the ‘war machine’ but perhaps none as powerful as that of musketry! Sacred Valley sits two opposing villages either side of a stone bridge holding them apart, infantrymen must be prepared to give their life for a greater cause.

Should attempts to cross the central bridge falter, additional flanking routes can be found adjacent to towns providing a flanking opportunity if used correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/85fb388137e4b217ee939899e3c3d2ce82fdafd2.png[/img]

[b]Fort Darial[/b]
This imposing fortress city, with its overlooking keep and impressive defences, has been host to many a great siege throughout its time. Long have the solid stone walls of Fort Darial held enemies at bay. 

Sight the cannons and brace yourself to follow the snaking cobbled path up into what will indeed be a long but always progressive fight through the many layers this fortress presents you.

Almost every wall and defence that protects this city can succumb to the strike of a solid round shot from a trained artilleryman. Utilising these gaps in the wall will be key to capturing this snow-covered city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/49ccd533428aece57f1898e23fcd15a0d01b1e4e.png[/img]

[b]Grassy Plains 4 & 5 (L)[/b]
In contrast to the other battlefields, the open fields and hills that roll through Grass Plains 4 & 5 make for a wonderful display of line battling.

You should do well to not be tricked by the simplistic yet beautiful nature of these battlefields. Though the endless green hills are a pretty sight, they quickly turn to strategic ambushing and flanking positions when used correctly against the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f3c752cbe322604afa89352b5e25b72986deba77.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/525746830ac332c2dbb360ff1fc7f7950c3a57ea.png[/img]

[b]Island Plains 1 (L)[/b]
The exposed weathered seafront and calm inshore grassland of this battlefield culminate to a unique fighting experience that sees soldiers marching across soggy shoreline one moment and trudging up muddy hills the next

The islands that have been carved into existence over time through the estuary make for perfect vantage points to fire off desperate volleys in attempts to turn the tide of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a115c887643a40aad183ac8e6643025e07271af6.png[/img]

[h1]4 New Officers! High Command DLC[/h1]
Muster up the men and order hails of devastating musket volley fire! Courageously lead others into the fray with the French Empire’s Polish Vistula Legion, the Prussian Kingdom’s Lützow Friekorps or the Russian Empire’s Interior Guard Battalion officers in High Command.

Honouring one of the most valiant of Scottish officers sporting the rather gentlemanly monicker of [i]Music C***[/i], we proudly announce that the beautifully tailored 92nd Gordon Highlanders officer uniform is now available in the very same High Command DLC. Leading those good kilt-wearing fellows can finally be done in proper style.

One will find no Scottish officer ill-equipped to lead a charge. When battling with this unit, you will spawn with a sword unique to these highlanders - The 1798 Pattern Claymore.

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@5uhdude/video/6860612980749470981]Video - Give Em' Steel, Lads![/url]

Content present in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/Holdfast_Nations_At_War/]Holdfast: Nations At War[/url] DLCs is purely cosmetic. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay. Your kind generosity will be put to good use and bring this genre of musket warfare games which all of us are fond of in the limelight.

The High Command DLC unlocks 4 unique uniforms for the Infantry Officer class and the 1798 Pattern Claymore.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415510/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__High_Command

[b]High Command DLC Uniform Unlocks[/b]
[b]●[/b] Unlock the British Empire’s 92nd Gordon Highlanders uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/caed298564d42dd013d657312d40e757e7798398.png[/img]

[b]●[/b] Unlock the 1798 Pattern Claymore for the British Empire’s 92nd Gordon Highlanders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/863652ee3c3678b6bb808a666590236c2d2d9bf9.png[/img]

[b]●[/b] Unlock the French Empire’s Polish Vistula Legion uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b0b824e31c4a1ec9e8fec2e8665779aadb6b76d3.png[/img]

[b]●[/b] Unlock the Kingdom of Prussia’s Lützow Friekorps uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4db3f974dbe1a89bf86ac7f927bb858ee36f6cc5.png[/img]

[b]●[/b] Unlock the Russian Empire’s Interior Guard Battalion uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/339020b096549358dc60226d81c524d0cbe7ca10.png[/img]

[h1]Cavalry. Horseback Movement[/h1]
Having some slight troubles navigating on horseback? You’ll be glad to hear that movement has undergone a significant redesign providing those fellows on a saddle with better control of the direction they want to steer towards. 

Remember that you’re still, after all, riding a mighty beast! Be sure to be wary when navigating through restrictive places.

Be sure to check out the change log for the entire list of fixes additions revolving around cavalry units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3baea2a5ad1842ce4c0c144dc614e9272c07935d.gif[/img]

[h1]Roleplay Gestures. Charge![/h1]
We’ll be adding more to your available arsenal of roleplay gestures in this update! Rest on your laurels as the battle ensues, order a glorious charge with your sword held forwards, taunt your enemies or in a fit of rage go full berserk pushing your adversaries into a cowardly retreat.

[b]Sit[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f4310111863580ca05e4f14789ed0da8ef145e9d.gif[/img]

[b]Charge[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/29b7f8f6e33825ad6431c52b417abf1e8b55ad4b.gif[/img]

[b]Taunt[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/11de9fbe4861a3ecf6fcde3319cf2a41e497fa02.gif[/img]

[b]Warcry[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/f77b4fdb2078ce98073287eeb30416ce794954c5.gif[/img]

[h1]Localisation. 5 New Languages[/h1]
Thanks to a community-wide effort, Holdfast: Nations At War has now been made available in 5 additional languages. Existing translations have also been revised correcting multiple grammatical errors.

It is always a delight to see the community grow and albeit supporting the game in another language is no simple feat, it will surely be worth the effort. Our sincere and heartfelt thanks go to all those individuals who partook in all of this.

If you’re wanting to give us a helping hand with translating the game into Thai or Vietnamese, feel free to reach out on Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/edecad2f09835cd8ff2b3c30a0545d531929cf3d.png[/img]

[h1]The Crew Grows. Storey[/h1]
Sound the salute as a widely known long-standing member of the community has enlisted with the crew as a Level Designer. Join us in giving this most talented fellow - [b]STOREY[/b] the warmest of welcomes! You can already see some of his work in this major update release.

He’ll be working hand in hand with Rycon, our Lead 3D Artist to bring you more battlefields with unique style and gameplay. Most certainly look forward to what he has in store for Holdfast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b797ed79acc45c397009b5a9ae37017bbe944d43.png[/img]

[h1]Community. Join The Discord![/h1]
Looking for a good bunch of fellows to play with? Do join our Discord. Linebattle events where players are encouraged to play in formations relevant to the Napoleonic era are hosted by the community through the week. Discord is also a great place to stay in touch with the game’s development.

If you’re a fellow in the ranks of a regiment, go [b]declare your enlistment[/b]. Through this, you can gather access to the ‘Barracks’ where clan specific discussion ensues. We look forward to seeing you there!

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]


[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/88e05815524a48a619a78c5c08d35a117e6758d0.png[/img][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1a980cf827dba840378b41ba92db6eb80595b248.png[/img]


There’s more to look out for in this release. Check out the changelog for all the details.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[b]Changelog 57 - Game Version 1.8.7557.25731[/b]

[b]New Features[/b]

[b]●[/b] [b]8 New Maps![/b] Take your fight into snow-covered towns, engage in fierce close-quarters combat in the streets of Heartmound, topple fortified positions with artillery pieces or stand shoulder to shoulder on plains maps during organised play.
» Autumn Watch
» Heartmound
» Marquette
» Sacred Valley
» Fort Darial
» Grassy Plains 4 (L)
» Grassy Plains 5 (L)
» Island Plains 1 (L)

[b]●[/b] Input the following command per map rotation to host any of these maps on your community servers.
» map_name autumnwatch
» map_name heartmound
» map_name marquette
» map_name sacredvalley
» map_name fortdarial
» map_name grassyplainsiv
» map_name grassyplainsv
» map_name islandplains

[b]●[/b] [b]4 New Officers! High Command DLC.[/b] Unlock four new Infantry Officers uniforms for each of the existing factions in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415510/Holdfast_Nations_At_War__High_Command]High Command DLC[/url]. You can access the Steam Store page to unlock these uniforms directly through the game. Content present in Holdfast: Nations At War Game DLCs is purely cosmetic. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay.
» Unlock the British Empire’s 92nd Gordon Highlanders uniform.
» Unlock the Claymore for the British Empire’s 92nd Gordon Highlanders. This weapon is a cosmetic override for the officer’s sword.
» Unlock the French Empire’s Polish Vistula Legion uniform.
» Unlock the Kingdom of Prussia’s Lützow Friekorps uniform.
» Unlock the Russian Empire’s Interior Guard Battalion uniform.

[b]●[/b] Players can toggle off the claymore cosmetic override should they wish to do so by deselecting ‘High Command Weapon Skin’ through the game’s settings.

[b]●[/b] [b]Roleplay Gestures. Charge![/b] We’ll be adding more to your available arsenal of roleplay gestures in this update! Rest on your laurels as the battle ensues, order a glorious charge with your sword held forwards, taunt your enemies or in a fit of rage go full berserk pushing your adversaries into a cowardly retreat.
» Check out the full selection of roleplay gestures by pressing the ‘V’ key and clicking on the pictogram.


[b]Game Translation[/b]

[b]●[/b] [b]Localisation. 5 New Languages.[/b] Thanks to a community-wide effort, Holdfast: Nations At War has now been made available in 5 additional languages. 
» Danish
» Greek (Including Greek fonts)
» Romanian (Including Romanian fonts)
» Swedish
» Turkish

[b]●[/b] Existing translations have also been revised correcting multiple grammatical errors.
» Simplified & Traditional Chinese
» Czech
» Dutch
» French
» German
» Italian
» Korean
» Polish
» Portuguese - Brazil
» Russian
» Spanish


[b]Gameplay - Cavalry Units[/b]

[b]●[/b] Movement has undergone a significant redesign providing those fellows on a saddle with better control of the direction they want to steer towards. 
» Remember that you’re still, after all, riding a mighty beast. Be sure to be wary when navigating through restrictive places.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused players to get stuck holding a strike when feinting to another strike direction while on horseback.

[b]●[/b] Striking with your sword at an environment object whilst on horseback will now properly play an animation showing the melee weapon retracting back. Same will occur when two cavalrymen swords clash with one another.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which caused players to end up facing the wrong direction if they got kicked and immediately mounted a horse.


[b]Gameplay - Melee Combat[/b]

[b]●[/b] Increased the speed at which players can feint from one strike direction to another for all weapons.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple instances where players could issue a ghost or lightning strikes with a melee weapon.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused musket down stabs to have a wider hit detection not reflective of the actual strike animation. It only occurred when players were stricken from up close and facing a particular direction.


[b]Gameplay - Forward Positions[/b]

[b]●[/b] You will no longer benefit from spawn protection immunity when spawning on forward positions placed by Infantry Officers.

[b]●[/b] The attacking faction is now allowed to place forward positions in limited numbers when the Army Siege game mode is in play with the exception of Fort Salettes.

[b]●[/b] Introduced additional functionality allowing server administrators to define which team to disable the ‘Reinforce’ ability for. 
» Input the following command per map rotation to host any of these maps on your community servers: [i]class_system_orders_reinforce true, false, attacking or defending[/i].
» Where ‘true’ allows the ability to be used by both teams, ‘false’ allows the ability to be used by none of the team, ‘attacking’ to be used only by the attackers and ’defending' to be used only by the defenders.

[b]●[/b] Reinforcements for the defending faction on specific Army Siege maps have also been increased due to the above addition.

[b]●[/b] Solved issues with forward positions on Desert Ruins.

[b]●[/b] Added punctuation to the message received when an officer cannot place a forward position due to them being too close to a base spawn.


[b]Gameplay - Player Controller[/b]

[b]●[/b] You will no longer go to a standing position when switching between weapons while crouching.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance where players could spawn outside the map on Fort Winston when selecting to spawn on a forward position.


[b]Regiment Registry[/b]

[b]●[/b] Players will now receive a notification encouraging them to join the regiment’s Discord upon enlisting with a regiment through the regiment registry. Make sure to correctly set a link to your Discord directly through the registry if you haven’t done so already!
» First navigate to view your regiment, then select ‘Manage’ and input a link to your Discord in the ‘Edit Discord Connection’ field.
» Ensure that the invite link you input does not expire and can be granted to an unlimited number of users.


[b]Achievements[/b]

[b]●[/b] Reduced the requirement to obtain the Ranker achievement to 100 players.


[b]Naval Warfront[/b]

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to select a pre-set name a naval vessel spawns with through the ‘spawn_ships’ command.
» Input the following command per map rotation to define a pre-set name: [i]spawn_ships <shiptype> <number> <faction> <color> <nameindex>[/i]

[b]●[/b] The ‘rc spawnships’ command now returns the name and ship ID to the console making it easier to use the rc removeShips <ship ID> command.

[b]●[/b] The ‘rc spawnships’ command will now refuse to spawn ships on the defender’s side when the Coastal Siege game mode instead of assigning them to the attackers.


[b]Holdfast SDK[/b]

[b]●[/b] Server administrators can now opt to disallow players from spawning with the base selection of uniforms and only allow that of modded ones. Should you want to create a scenario stretching outside that of the Napoleonic era, this has now been made possible.
» Input the following command per map rotation to disallow players from spawning with the base selection of uniforms: [i]exclusive_modded_uniforms true[/i]


[b]Quality of Life[/b]

[b]●[/b] You are now provided with the options to play the game in ‘Borderless Fullscreen’ mode in addition to the previously supported ‘Fullscreen’ and ‘Windowed’ modes.
» Switch between these different screen modes through the game’s video settings.

[b]●[/b] You will no longer have the ‘Escape’ menu show stopping your character from moving if you ‘ALT+TAB’ the game.

[b]●[/b] You can now access the game’s configuration file by going to ‘Settings’ then ‘Game’ and eventually selecting the ‘Open’ button next to the ‘Config File’ option.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the cooldown for roleplay gestures from 8 to 2 seconds.

[b]●[/b] Players that disband a regiment will now receive a warning stating that they will be unable to create or enlist in another regiment for 7 days upon doing so.


[b]Game Load[/b]

[b]●[/b] Optimisations targeting a specific subset of hardware will see map loading times reduced.


[b]Graphical & Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the ‘Present Arms’ roleplay gestures not looping correctly.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with golden borders for banners not showing correctly when a regiment reaches Rank 50.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the shacko’s colour appearing incorrect on the French ‘85eme Regiment d’Infanterie’ Line Infantry unit.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where if you spawn with the blue uniform variant of the French sailor, you would spawn with that of the red one.

[b]●[/b] You are no longer able to build Rocket Stacks whilst playing as the defenders on Fort Schwarz  and the Army Siege game mode is in play.

[b]●[/b] You are no longer able to build Rocket Stacks on Fort Christina and the Army Siege game mode is in play.

[b]●[/b] You are no longer able to build Rocket Stacks on Fort Salettes and Canyon.

[b]●[/b] Improved the loading screen for Lamarsh Fen.


Once again, we thank you and until next time, may good health be yours.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/64752cbe85e826e1678d4abeff312f08efa81198.png[/img]


[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Game Update. Bug Fixes & Additions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a488a868731814a5cc5d9f8df5a8dca7db8e79ed.png[/img]

Holdfast: Nations At War has been updated! Shortly after the release of the recently introduced major content update bringing with it a whole slew of gameplay-focused additions, we’ll be pushing forward bug fixes amongst other features targeting quality of life much requested by the community.

Come have a read of our blog post for all changes involving the regiment registry, forward positions, melee combat, crouching transitions and more.

[h1]Community. Join The Discord![/h1]

Looking for a good bunch of fellows to play with? Do join our Discord. Linebattle events where players are encouraged to play in formations relevant to the Napoleonic era are hosted by the community through the week. Discord is also a great place to stay in touch with the game’s development. Feedback is always greatly welcomed.

If you’re a fellow in the ranks of a regiment, go [b]declare your enlistment[/b]. Through this, you can gather access to the ‘Field Camp’ where clan specific discussion ensues. We look forward to seeing you there!

[url=discord.gg/holdfastgame]discord.gg/holdfastgame[/url]


[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/88e05815524a48a619a78c5c08d35a117e6758d0.png[/img][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1a980cf827dba840378b41ba92db6eb80595b248.png[/img]


Take a look at the changelog for all the details.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[b]Changelog 56 - Game Version 1.7.7501.29734[/b]


[b]Forward Positions[/b]

[b]●[/b] Infantry Officers are now disallowed from placing forward positions nearby base spawns.
» Players that attempt to do so will receive a message informing them of the fact.

[b]●[/b] Infantry Officers are now duly informed when their forward position runs out of reinforcements or gets destroyed.

[b]●[/b] You should now find it easier to hit forward positions with melee weapons. Their hitbox has been slightly increased.

[b]●[/b] Forward positions are now destroyed on death rather than when the Infantry Officer respawns.

[b]●[/b] You can no longer place forward positions while jumping or falling.

[b]●[/b] You can no longer place forward positions while mounted on horseback.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the player’s camera could sometimes clip with forward positions.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which was causing the ‘Reinforce’ ability cooldown to carry over and persist between rounds.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused a forward position to get immediately destroyed after the ability was used. 

[b]●[/b] Reinforce order is now being greyed out in the spawn menu if the abilities’ use is restricted through the server configuration file.


[b]Regiment Registry & Banners[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced additional functionality allowing players to search for a member within the registry. You’ll also find the same feature present in the recruit’s panel to accept or deny new applicants.

[b]●[/b] Members of the same regiment can now display one another’s Steam profile to stay in touch with one another.

[b]●[/b] Regiment leaders and moderators can now view a prospective applicant’s Steam profile in the recruits panel.

[b]●[/b] Slightly adjusted the positions for in-game banners and player names.

[b]●[/b] Performed multiple optimisations for a smoother experience when navigating through the Regiment Registry.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which was causing regiment to no longer function if the regiment changed their tag. 

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused regimental banners not to display in the game.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused the ‘Leaders’ column in the Regiment Browser to remain stuck in a loading state after closing the Regiment View.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused regiments having over 100 enlisted from showing history and player names within the Regiment Registry.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused regiments in the registry to no longer function if all ranks were removed.

[b]●[/b] You are now required to input a minimum number of characters in the regiment name and tag fields prior to registering your regiment.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the recruit panel to no longer function if there were new recruits waiting to be accepted and a regiment changed their tag.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the recruit panel to no longer function if a player with an invalid Steam profile submitted an application to a regiment.

[b]●[/b] Introduced further instruction informing leaders and moderators of a specific regiment how to troubleshoot issues when messages related to insufficient permissions are displayed.

[b]●[/b] Included ‘Greece’ to the list of available regions selectable through the Regiment Registry.

[b]●[/b] Removed multiple logs being outputted for debugging purposes related to the banner system from the F2 console.


[b]Game Chat[/b]

[b]●[/b] Regiments now have a dedicated channel to communicate in whilst playing the game.
» All > Team > Class > Regiment > Recruit > Admin

[b]●[/b] Harmonised the colours of all the class-specific chat channels.

[b]●[/b] Renamed the ‘Skirmishers’ chat channel to ‘Skirmish’.

[b]●[/b] Infantry Officers are no longer able to see the class-specific ‘Cavalry’ chat.


[b]Bayonet Attaching & Detaching[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where other players could sometimes be seen repeating the attaching or detaching animation.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where other players could sometimes be seen striking with a musket without a bayonet attached.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with playing gestures then attaching or detaching a bayonet. This would cause the bayonet to display outside its intended position.

[b]●[/b] Removed multiple logs being outputted for debugging purposes related to the bayonet attaching and detaching mechanic from the F2 console.


[b]Kicking & Knockbacks[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players kicked while abord naval vessels resulted in them being castaway a distance afar. Wilson!! 

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused a player to get kicked a shorter distance than intended.

[b]●[/b] Reduced instances for an issue which was sometimes causing a player to not get knock-backed after they got kicked and where colliding with another.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which occurred when a player was kicked whilst carrying an object. The carriable object would be dropped to the ground while another remains in the player’s hands.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where a player kept viewing the spyglass after they got kicked.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with kills through kicks being represented with an incorrect icon in the death screen.


[b]Melee Combat & Controller[/b]

[b]●[/b] Players are now able to more quickly switch between combat and shoulder arm stances. 

[b]●[/b] Players are now provided with more leeway to drag an attack after releasing or holding a strike.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which was at times causing players to get stuck holding a strike.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance where sometimes a strike dealt twice the intended damage.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes prevented players from going into melee mode if they found themselves killed whilst holding a strike then respawned.

[b]●[/b] You can now kick whilst equipping a 2H Axe or Sledgehammer.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the 2H Axe idle animation stance.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the 2H Axe running animations were not displaying as intended.

[b]●[/b] Slightly reduced movement speed for when holding or releasing a strike whilst wielding a sword.

[b]●[/b] Slightly increased the melee strike release timer for swords. This allows some more leeway to determine and block the attack.


[b]Shooting & Firearms[/b]

[b]●[/b] Players are now able to more quickly go in and out of the crouching stance.

[b]●[/b] Slightly increased the range of kill-shots by auxiliary pistols.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which was somethings causing other players to be seen firing their musket before the aiming animation fully completes.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which very rarely caused a player to load a blank round resulting in a non-lethal shot from a firearm.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused players to get stuck while reloading a firearm.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the firearm trajectories command outputting an error when switching the round.


[b]Cavalry Units[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved issues related to sound for cavalry units and their movement. 

[b]●[/b] Solved an occurrence which was causing horses to de-spawn when a player from the enemy team mounts them.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where allied faction players could kill a horse that you’ve captured from the enemies’ team using a swivel gun while mounting it.


[b]Roleplay Gestures[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to play a gesture while interacting with cannons, ladders, the ship’s wheel amongst others.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to play gestures while equipping an un-intended weapon.

[b]●[/b] Players are now displayed with information as to why they are unable to play a gesture when they hover on the pictogram.
» Must Be Standing
» On Cooldown
» Gesture Already Playing


[b]Achievements[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the ‘Gifted Surgeon’ achievement.

[b]●[/b] Reworded the ‘Strike’ achievement.


[b]Custom Server Panel[/b]

[b]●[/b] Default server address has been set to ‘localhost’ in the custom server panel. 


[b]Map Related[/b]

[b]●[/b] Attackers on Fort Salettes whilst the Army Siege game mode is in play will now find an additional position to spawn on in limited numbers.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with twice the sappers appearing atop one another in the main menu scene.

[b]●[/b] Line Infantrymen in the main menu scene now have their arms shouldered upright and proper. Same goes for the Flag Bearer’s stance.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with floating bushes on Snowy Plains 1.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players could get stuck behind one of the houses on Aunby Valley.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to spawn atop the bathhouse on Desert Ruins.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to spawn atop one of the barns on Dutch Canals.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the ladders on Desert Ruins.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the ruin models missing faces on Aunby Valley.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with warning appearing on Tahir Desert.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to go underneath one of the bridges on Fort Salettes.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the capture points on Fort Christina appearing disconnected from the ground.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the spacing between ladders on the ramp leading to Fort Salettes when playing on the Army Siege game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the ladders on Sharpton appearing disconnected from the ground.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with players being able to hide within one of the ruin models on Fort Schwarz.


[b]Holdfast SDK[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with interaction door restrictions on modded maps.


[b]Graphical[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the Prussian Hussar’s cap display a white border.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the Depth of Field post-processing effect blurring our player nameplates and banners.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which disabled impactful particle effects such as that of fires when the player is using the lower graphical settings.

[b]●[/b] Beautified the area behind the dam on Aunby Valley.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the brightness of the yellow guardhouse.


Once again, we thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/64752cbe85e826e1678d4abeff312f08efa81198.png[/img]


[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

Refleax, Rycon, Dreas, Wrexial, Walki, Cameron, Jackson, Rejenorst & Harper

notes.title: Major Update. Shoulder Arms! Forward Positions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/25fcfa2a5c43fd2010ef5c5bd84e7e100d80f53f.png[/img]

Holdfast as one of the largest content updates to date has just been released! March with your arms shouldered alongside other fellows in the ranks, salute officers or proclaim your surrender through roleplay gestures, a regimental registry for in-game clans to thrive and proposer, call for reinforcements allowing others to spawn on your location, detachable bayonets and so much more.

Celebrating this release, you can gather Holdfast: Nations At War at [b]50% Off[/b] for the remaining duration of [b]Steam’s Summer Sale[/b]. Help us spread the word around about the sale to bring this growing genre of Musket Warfare games that we all love in the limelight. We want to continue strengthening the following behind the game as it grows and develops.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

There’s plenty to go through in this major content update release! Hang in there for a short while longer as we contain our excitement before letting you know of all the details.

[previewyoutube=Bcx4IL7XBRE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Shoulder Arms! Marching Onwards[/h1]

Shoulder your arms and march onwards with musket in hand! Napoleonic formations are a glorious sight to behold and now more so than ever with this latest addition. A new set of animations will hold your musket upright and proper when in firing mode.

Consisting of well over 70 new animations and amendments to existing ones for the character to walk, run and transition through different stances more soldierly, it was certainly quite the substantial task to behold. Nevertheless, it was damn well worth the effort.

[b]Shoulder Arms - March[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e66248990037083ba853694a1d9a8ed03212f866.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d50949fd5c9cc719d5a47bec5cef2f4d5f096f08.gif[/img]

[b]Shoulder Arms - Run[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/790388b8cb61096b5defed961de894a7ea86fc24.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b78a9100f62377efe27e1bc34b80fbdfdfd66dd5.gif[/img]

Many requests were received from those within the community wanting to look better whilst playing as one of the most popular support roles - The Flag Bearer class. We, of course, couldn’t agree more. As you parade your faction’s colours to bolster morale in the ranks, your flag will be held upright in true Napoleonic fashion.

[b]Flag Stances[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/412753094f1ba80ad754be562a86c5005809d208.gif[/img]

[h1]Roleplay Gestures! Drills & Salutes[/h1]

Attention! Present your arms and await further orders, salute those in high-command to pay your respects, proclaim your surrender and cower for your precious life or simply point in the enemies’ general direction. Check out the full selection of roleplay gestures by pressing the ‘V’ key and clicking on the pictogram.

[b]Officer Salute[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8d5337754851e66cb6c2aa419d4855bfc129838f.gif[/img]

[b]Infantry Salute[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/7c6559ca322947b51cfe3899fbc03f6251c9d564.gif[/img]

[b]Present Arms[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/b6b0386e813fd0ddba102007b32f6b4b0d970abe.gif[/img]

[b]Surrender[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8455484833176cec508a2168feee0a3f821ac415.gif[/img]

[b]Point[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/6574ab5852c5da212b787493c6f8c1a549b852f2.gif[/img]

[h1]Regiment Registry! Clan Standing[/h1]

Envisioned as a concept going as far back as the budding early days of Holdfast’s creation is finally coming to life! Providing a space for in-game clans to organise, thrive and prosper the Regimental Registry is a feature long-awaited by many.

Come to the release of this update, you’ll be able to establish your very own regiment within the game, customise its ranking structure, promote or demote enlisted based on the ranking structure you designate, assign moderators to help you manage new applicants, customise your very own regiment banner, transfer its ownership, raise its rank through a total of 50 levels in a group-wide effort and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/492719aee28adfe977e680739b1988044b2ccd0a.png[/img]

You may surely wonder how involving it is to get started so let’s start getting into some of the details. Forming your very own regiment couldn’t get any simpler! Locate the ‘Regiment Registry’ from the main menu, select the ‘Create Regiment’ button, fill the form and you’re good to go.

[b]Creator Basics[/b]
Here are a few things you’ll be needing to create a regiment. Start by defining your regiment’s affiliation and take up the fight for the British Empire, French Empire, Kingdom of Prussia, Russian Empire or any other nation then select the region your regiment is to be located in. This will help potential new applicants browsing the registry to find one with a matching time zone.

Searching for new recruits? Set the ‘Recruitment’ status to open. If it is to be a group amongst your peers, set this to closed. You’ll then be needing to define a name and tag to be used by your desired regiments. A tag must be unique and cannot be similar to that of another regiment.

Then write a description to let others know what your regiment stands for. Carefully think this through! We also highly recommend that you input a link to your Discord to stay in touch with those in the regiment or let others know where they can reach out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d3d98798ab6bdc55c423694161045284ba1f7636.png[/img]

[b]Ranking Structure[/b]
Proceed to designate a ranking structure that suits best your regiment. Leaders and moderators will be able to promote or demote others through these ranks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/077c73b0743a019337fa3a023ac8a0356246429f.png[/img]

[b]Regiment Banner[/b]
Utilise a massive selection of backgrounds and symbols to create your very own regimental banner. You can access the editor by pressing on the ‘Edit Banner’ button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/34f944a97d7de19ba9295c30f51d6cbf38ad0751.png[/img]

Representing your regiment and all of its deeds, the unique custom banner you design through the editor will show on every enlisted member in your regiment. Besides sporting a banner similar to one another, members of the same regiment will also display in green whilst playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ab11f16010524cfb5152681e5b1603f2f9c712ae.png[/img]

Finish it all up by selecting the ‘Submit’ button to submit your regiment to the registry. 

[b]Management[/b]
Should you wish to make amendments to any of the above after creating your regiment, you can freely do so by clicking on the ‘Manage’ button visible only to you, the leader of the new up and coming regiment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/74a9f5711a5a57dc792ffb68b06fea762d8b6e5d.png[/img]

If you put in the effort, the regiment will steadily see a rise in numbers and as it grows you may want to start thinking about shifting some of the responsibilities to those other dedicated few. Select the ‘Grant Privileges’ button to provide moderator privileges to any of the enlisted. They will be able to help you accept new recruits, promote or demote others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a585b28728b16b9a6f494418871bb36efd0f42fa.png[/img]

Transferring the ownership of the regiment can be actioned through the same panel. By selecting the ‘Transfer Ownership’ button you will be provided with a list of moderators to handover the regiment revoking your privileges as a leader over to another individual of your choosing.

There can only be one Regiment Leader and they have total control and ownership of the regiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/179931142379f42c830d2ef5d875106d51dc74d3.png[/img]

If the regiment comes to an unfortunate end, as the owner of the regiment you are also provided with the option to disband it. Regiments that are disbanded will disappear from the registry after a few days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1f6493e2e2691db8262948508eb44bfbe3225723.png[/img]

[b]Regiment Rank[/b]
Prepare to embark on a competitive stand-off between game clans! Collaborate and assemble in a group-wide effort for those fellows in your regiment to rise through a total of 50 ranks. Regiments that rank higher than others will be displayed at the top of the registry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2d39c4cebab7322ed4fb941da6d48e0ea6ca876d.png[/img]

Those dedicated few that manage to make their way to all 50 ranks will be rewarded with a prestigious golden banner distinguishing them from the rest. Score gathered by an enlisted based on how well they did during a match on any of the official Army Front, Naval Warfront or Linebattle Event servers will contribute towards this great effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/86151398c7558776a91509fa16766d1943d00124.png[/img]

[h1]Reinforce! Forward Positions[/h1]

In dire need of reinforcements? Call for those in the rank and file to spawn on your forward position. Coming to this update Infantry Officers have been provided with a new ‘Reinforce’ ability ordering Line Infantry, Grenadier and Guard units to come to their aid changing the dynamics of the battlefield.

One should carefully evaluate their surroundings when doing so however as these forward positions are destructible by both cannon, explosives and melee weapons. You will also find that the number of units that can spawn is limited in number. Getting overrun won’t be a pretty sight.

Infantry Officers advanced in their leadership skills are sure to strategically use forward positions as a means to capture and hold key stronghold positions pivotal to achieving victory. 

[b]New Ability[/b]
[b]●[/b] Reinforce - Call for infantrymen to bolster your ranks when in dire need of reinforcements. A forward position will be placed on your location enabling Line Infantry, Grenadier and Guard units to spawn on it.

[b]Forward Position[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/24eff6b1d3f24e1f4f7e59478a397b1ae77a5b2e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5a9931da515a6c4da0387015e500d5abdd93e59d.gif[/img]

Pressing the ‘M’ key will now open the spawn menu. This menu will now be seeing more use outside that of selecting or changing to another class. It’s definitely bound to come in handy.

[h1]Bayonettss! Attaching & Detaching[/h1]

At a distance, a shout from an overzealous officer ensues throwing everyone into a charge! Holdfast: Nations At War has always been missing something dear to make these decisive moments ever more brilliant but this can be said no longer. 

Musket-wielding classes are now equipped with a new ability allowing them to attach and detach bayonets. Detaching your bayonet will gather you a 5% in firearm accuracy at the cost of limiting your melee capabilities with the weapon. Try not to get caught without it if things get up close and personal.

[b]New Ability[/b]
[b]●[/b] Bayonet Handling - Drilled in the handling of bayonets. Charge with a bayonet equipped and make use of your trusty musket as a makeshift spear in melee combat or detach it from your weapon to gather a 5% increase in firearm accuracy.

Press the ‘T’ key to attach or detach your bayonet when equipping a musket.

[b]Detach Bayonet[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a902fbf9988699239648b17af13004f0b5a9ab50.gif[/img]

[b]Attach Bayonet[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8382ab35f90da78657449964ca762e27d1a1b973.gif[/img]

[h1]4 New Units! Regiments of the Line DLC[/h1]

Take up arms and march with the Regiments of the Line for Emperor or King! Enlist with the British Empire’s Loyal Lusitanian Legion, the Prussian Kingdom’s 11th Regiment of Reserves, the Russian Empire’s Pavlovsk Fusilier or the French Empire’s Bavarian Fusiliers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324000

Content present in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/]Holdfast: Nations At War[/url] DLCs is purely cosmetical. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay. Your kind generosity will be put to good use and bring this genre of musket warfare games which all of us are fond of in the limelight.

The Regiments of the Line DLC unlocks 4 unique uniforms for the Line Infantry class.

[b]ROTL DLC Uniform Unlocks[/b]
● Unlock the British Empire's Loyal Lusitanian Legion uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5b487e07f7546628bf598bb01c4bc75d6f9deecd.png[/img]

● Unlock the French Empire's 6th ‘Herzog Wilhelm’ Bavarian Fusiliers uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/dad775769a5c754457237889ed5a20d61899b48b.png[/img]

● Unlock the Kingdom of Prussia's 11th Reserve Regiment uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d58e2204a3644f0a2a7f560be383cbca11e43f46.png[/img]

● Unlock the Russian Empire's Pavlovsk Fusiliers uniform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/115628b4e28c7fc8bc1bafeb31c6b1eb4afce039.png[/img]

[h1]Surgeon Bandage! Healing Oneself[/h1]

Ever found yourself in a right pickle healing wartime injury but couldn’t do the same for yours? In this release, we’ll be introducing yet another ability for the Surgeon class. Surgeons are now provided with the option to heal themselves using the ‘Bandage’ ability. 

There’s a 1-minute cooldown being applied in between uses so be sure that you play your cards well.

[b]New Ability[/b]
[b]●[/b] Bandage - Experienced in healing wartime injuries. You can utilise the same knowledge to bandage your own by pressing the 'Q' key.

[b]Surgeon Bandage[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/557772591d24dc7d090cd60983ce62957d40fe23.gif[/img]

[h1]Melee Combat. Knock Backs[/h1]

Not quite into developing quick work of your enemy using conventional weaponry? A good old-fashioned brawl might just be the thing you’re looking for and things will be taken up a notch come to this update. Kicks rather than being instant on button press will require both precision and careful timing to land but should you be successful in doing so, your enemy will be stunned and knocked back a few paces.

There are plenty more changes coming to the melee combat system in this update. You can check out all that we’ve been up to in the changelog.

[b]Madness![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/408f9a6f14d361d7c4a3466c6851c802c3e86329.gif[/img]

[h1]A New Map! Aunby Valley[/h1]

Aunby Valley makes its way into the game uniquely combining many beloved aspects of other battlefields featured in the game. Inspired by the valleys of South Wales, a large river runs down the middle of this map, only to be held back by a giant dam that will see many a fallen infantryman atop it. 

At the base of the dam, two opposing sapper houses can be found and garrisoned to control the main crossing point of the valley. Should the enemy overwhelm you there, plenty of other crossing points leading to caves and ruins can be alternatively utilised as strategic flanking points.

Verticality is an important feature of this battlefield and those who use it to their advantage can expect great victories upon this land. With river crossings, buildings, caves, ruins and a giant dam you can be sure to experience every aspect of Holdfast: Nations At War in all its glory!

[b]Changelog 55 - Game Version 1.6.7489.31280[/b]


[b]New Features[/b]

[b]●[/b] [b]Shoulder Arms! Marching Onwards.[/b] Shoulder your arms and march onwards with musket in hand! Napoleonic formations are a glorious sight to behold and now more so due to this latest addition. 
» A new set of animations will hold your musket upright and proper when in firing mode.
» Flags can be held upright in true Napoleonic fashion.

[b]●[/b] [b]Roleplay Gestures! Drills & Salutes.[/b] Present your arms and await further orders, salute those in high-command to pay your respects, proclaim your surrender and cower for your precious life or point in the enemies' general direction.
» Check out the full selection of roleplay gestures by pressing the ‘V’ key and clicking on the pictogram.

[b]●[/b] [b]Regiment Registry![/b] Providing a space for in-game clans to organise, thrive and prosper the Regimental Registry is a feature long-awaited by many.
» A Regiment Registry allowing players to easily find and locate a regiment to join.
» Ability to establish your very own regiment with the game.
» Ability to customise the regiment’s ranking structure.
» Ability to promote or demote enlisted based on the ranking structure you designate.
» Ability to kick enlisted out of the regiment. 
» Ability to assign enlisted moderator privileges and help you manage new applicants.
» Ability to transfer the regiment’s ownership.
» Ability to define a description for your regiment. Let others know what you stand for.
» Ability to disband the regiment should it come to an unfortunate end.
» Ability to customise your very own regiment banner.

[b]●[/b] [b]Regiment Banners.[/b] Utilise a massive selection of backgrounds and symbols to create your very own regimental banner. 
» Representing your regiment and all of its deeds, the unique custom banner you design through the editor will show on every enlisted member in your regiment. 
» Members of the same regiment will also display in green whilst playing the game.

[b]●[/b] [b]Regiment Standing.[/b] Raise your regiment through a total of 50 levels in a group-wide effort and be rewarded for it. Score gathered by an enlisted based on how well they did during a match on any of the official Army Front, Naval Warfront or Linebattle Event servers will contribute towards this great effort.
» You will be rewarded with a prestigious golden banner distinguishing your regiment from the rest.
» Regiments that rank higher than others will be displayed at the top of the registry.

[b]●[/b] [b]Reinforce! Forward Positions.[/b] Call for those in the rank and file to spawn on your forward position. A new ‘Reinforce’ ability enables Line Infantry, Grenadier and Guard units to come to your aid changing the dynamics of the battlefield.
» Players that can spawn on a forward position are limited in number.
» Forward positions are destructible by melee, cannon and explosives.
» Forward positions will be destroyed if the Infantry Officer meets their demise.
» Input the following command per map rotation to enable or disable the use of this ability: class_system_orders_reinforce true
» Input the following command per map rotation to define a limit for the number of players that can spawn on a particular forward position: [i]class_system_orders_reinforce_limit 25[/i]
» Input the following command per map rotation to change the cooldown of this ability: [i]class_system_orders_reinforce_cooldown 240[/i]

[b]●[/b] [b]Bayonettss! Attaching & Detaching.[/b] Musket-wielding classes are now equipped with a new ability allowing them to attach and detach bayonets. Detaching your bayonet will gather you a 5% in firearm accuracy at the cost of limiting your melee capabilities with the weapon.
» Press the ‘T’ key to attach or detach your bayonet when equipping a musket.
» Input the following command per map rotation to define if players should start with their bayonet attached or detached by default: [i]start_bayonet_attached true or false[/i]

[b]●[/b] [b]4 New Units! Regiments of the Line DLC.[/b] Unlock four new Line Infantry uniforms for each of the existing factions in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324000]Regiments of the Line DLC[/url]. You can access the Steam Store page to unlock these uniforms directly through the game. Content present in Holdfast: Nations At War Game DLCs is purely cosmetical. It doesn’t and never will impact gameplay.
» Unlock the British Empire's Loyal Lusitanian Legion uniform.
» Unlock the French Empire's 6th ‘Herzog Wilhelm’ Bavarian Fusiliers uniform.
» Unlock the Kingdom of Prussia's 11th Reserve Regiment uniform.
» Unlock the Russian Empire's Pavlovsk Fusiliers uniform.

[b]●[/b] [b]Surgeon Bandage! Healing Oneself.[/b] Surgeons are now provided with the option to heal themselves using the ‘Bandage’ ability. There’s a 1-minute cooldown being applied in between uses so be sure that you play your cards well.
» A new UI whilst playing with the Surgeon class will show alerting you of the uses and cooldowns for both the Bandage and Medicine abilities.

[b]●[/b] [b]A New Map! Aunby Valley.[/b] Inspired by the valleys of South Wales, a large river runs down the middle of this map, only to be held back by a giant dam that will see many a fallen infantryman atop it. 
» Input the following command per map rotation to play this map on your community server: [i]map_name aunbyvalley[/i]


[b]Quality of Life[/b]

[b]●[/b] You are now able to access the Spawn Menu by pressing the ‘M’ key. 

[b]●[/b] Reorganised the key bindings menu for easier access.

[b]●[/b] Capturable points which no players can spawn on by default will no longer show in the Spawn Menu.

[b]●[/b] Introduced additional tips informing players on the use of the newly introduced abilities.


[b]Gameplay - Musket Combat[/b]

[b]●[/b] Redesigned the secondary strike mechanics to rebalance the meta.
» Changed the shoving animations to feature a kick instead. It allows players to better distinguish between primary and secondary attacks while improving consistency.
» Secondary attacks will now knock-back a player if the aggressor successfully lands their hit.
» Secondary attacks now have a windup allowing players time to evade the knock-back.
» Secondary attacks can now be dragged slightly providing for greater fluidity during play.
» Secondary attack kills now show a unique boot icon in the kill log.
» You can now Spartan a poor fellow off an elevated position rewarding you with the kill.
» Players will instantly face their demise if the knock-back throws them into an anti-infantry spike.
» Damage for secondary attacks increased from 5 to 10 and from 2 to 5 if the Resilient trait is in effect.

[b]●[/b] Your movement speed no longer gets slightly reduced whilst blocking with a musket.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which enabled players to rotate quicker than intended after releasing their strike. Relative to their framerate, they would be able to rotate faster than others providing them with an advantage during competitive play.

[b]●[/b] Improved the accuracy of player positions whilst rotating. Rotating player movement is now more in sync with the server. Latency, however, will still cause inconsistencies.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue that allowed players to pitch down and up quicker than intended when in melee combat mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which allowed a player to skip the melee hold release state resulting in an invisible strike.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple instances which affected melee swing and block direction detection on different screen resolutions.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes enabled two striking players to damage each other at the same time.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple inconsistencies with block grace timers. 

[b]●[/b] Readjusted the damage duration of the musket when doing an up strike.


[b]Gameplay - Sword Combat[/b]

[b]●[/b] Your movement speed no longer gets slightly reduced whilst blocking with a sword.

[b]●[/b] Players wielding a sword now move slightly hastier than those equipping a musket when holding a strike or striking. It provides them with a better chance to close distances when facing those equipped with longer reach weaponry.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes prevented a sword strike from hitting a player based on their field of view.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with sword strikes having a significant hit delay.


[b]Gameplay - Artillery[/b]

[b]●[/b] Cannons will now recoil through Sapper defences and destroy them. You will no longer be able to utilise them as a mean to prevent a cannon from recoiling.


[b]Gameplay - Sappers[/b]

[b]●[/b] Sapper built Ammo Boxes and Rockets Stacks can now be shot at and destroyed by firearms. It’ll prevent players from using these objects to block entry points.


[b]Gameplay - Army Conquest[/b]

[b]●[/b] You are no longer able to spawn on capturable positions in the Army Conquest game mode. Utilise the Infantry Officer’s ‘Reinforce’ ability decisively to capture, hold or retake key positions.
» Input the following command per map rotation to once again allow players to spawn on capturable spawn points: [url=https://wiki.holdfastgame.com/Server_Configuration#Class_Limit_Override_On_Spawn_Points]Wiki - Class Limit Overrides[/url]


[b]Holdfast SDK[/b]

[b]●[/b] Introduced additional documentation covering the modification of flags and characters. 

[b]●[/b] Creators can now find an example on how to set up the Melee Arena game mode in the land scene.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which prevented doors from functioning as intended when playing on the Melee Arena game mode. 

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the ammo boxes placeable through the Holdfast SDK being slightly elevated.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue in the Holdfast SDK with the character fingers in the ‘Create Screenshot Scene’ appearing incorrectly. We have also improved the lighting in the scene enabling you to take more beautiful shots of your modded uniforms.

[b]●[/b] Creators now have a new set of un-destructible doors to make use of specifically designed for the Melee Arena game mode.
» Look for ‘MeleeArena_Door’ in the SDK.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues with farm walls and modular siege walls not properly switching through the different destruction stages.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the destruction stages on the siege gatehouse switching textures.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues where players could pass through some of the destructible stages on modular siege walls.

[b]●[/b] Changed the default image for uploaded modifications visible in the Steam Workshop.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which was sometimes causing issues when loading multiple mods containing flags.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with Coastal Siege spawn points in the Holdfast SDK naval scene.


[b]Graphical Additions[/b]

[b]●[/b] Significantly improved the quality of all face textures in the game.

[b]●[/b] Improved the quality of all uniform textures to bring out more detail.


[b]General Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which enabled players to go atop the windmill’s second floor.

[b]●[/b] Solved another issue with rockets dealing less damage than intended in the Hardcore Game Type.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players were unable to sit on one of the chairs present on Fort Pierre.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the French Marine missing a greyed-out image in the spawn menu when the class slots become full.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players could get stuck behind one of the carts present on Sharpton.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with some of the Russian Cuirassier faces being incorrectly skinned.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which caused horse reins to appear visually detached.


It’s been an outright blast developing this update! We do certainly hope that you enjoy all that this major content update has to offer as much as we will. Our heartfelt thanks go to all those good folks in the community. Your constant support, feedback and enthusiasm make us want to strive for better.

Once again, we thank you and until next time, may good health be yours.
