notes.title: Major Update. Cavalry! Ride To Glory
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/fed66133f657e6ce318299e6ea60f138859da1a7.png[/img]

Gallop away gentleman as tides of glory await! Ride into battle with your trusty steed and engage the enemy from horseback with the new Hussar, Cuirassier and Dragoon classes. Come have a read of our blog post as there’s plenty more to look forward to in this much-anticipated major update release.

Before you do so, as is well deserved of all this mounted goodness, there’s a [b]new trailer[/b] for your viewing pleasure.

[previewyoutube=W8hJmdfDHIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Cavalry Units! The Hussar[/h1]
Have your pick at one of these well-dressed cavalrymen. Sporting a rather flamboyant uniform won’t come of much use in the field of battle but their increased damage with swords while riding on horseback and increased speed will certainly come in handy while playing this class.

Discharge your pistol at the general direction of the enemy, equip your sword and charge away.

[b]Hussar[/b]
[b]Role:[/b] Cavalry - [b]Branch:[/b] The Army

Well-dressed. Great showmanship with swords on horseback.

[b]British Hussar – 15th (The King’s) Hussars[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4889e67beb167a2840ef27494c14d0644ad23c6b.png[/img]

[b]French Hussar – 7e Regiment de Hussards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/47eaa7e230733907181bca74510f72ae45facca0.png[/img]

[b]Prussian Hussar – Leib-Husaren-Regiment[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/351e9a4e581cdb0bc905b8832e45a4c1f5d92925.png[/img]

[b]Abilities[/b]
[i]Horseback Riding[/i] - Trained in the art of horseback riding. You are able to mount and ride glorious steeds of war.

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Skilful Rider[/i] - Well-versed in the art of horseback riding. Your speed while riding a horse is increased by 10%.
[i]Mounted Sword Specialisation[/i] - Drilled in various sword combat techniques while on horseback. Your damage when wielding a sword while on horseback is increased significantly.

[h1]Cavalry Units! The Cuirassier & Dragoon[/h1]
Carbineers on horseback. These units excel at the use of this firearm while mounted and combined with the versatile mobility their steed provides, they can quickly traverse the battlefield, take careful pickings of the enemy and retreat back in support of your lines.

Well trained Carabineers can excel just as much as a hussar in melee combat albeit the advantages traits provide.

[b]Cuirassier & Dragoon[/b]
[b]Role:[/b] Cavalry - [b]Branch:[/b] The Army

Mounted infantryman. Carbineers on horseback.

[b]British Dragoon – 1st Royal Regiment of Dragoons[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1e94e07f028571f73093c67cba39dc6f49060cfe.png[/img]

[b]French Cuirassier – 4e Regiment de Cuirassiers[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3c263f006d811e35f9837c17f31524a465f510cd.png[/img]

[b]Prussian Cuirassier – Brandenburg Kurassier-Regiment Nr. 3[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56e68ced5908baeed4b9f9c2e6ad16e6ca850337.png[/img]

[b]Abilities[/b]
[i]Horseback Riding[/i] - Trained in the art of horseback riding. You are able to mount and ride glorious steeds of war.

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Mounted Firearm Specialisation[/i] – Experienced with the use of firearms while on horseback. Your damage when firing pistols and carbines from horseback is increased by 10% and accuracy by 10%.

[h1]Horseback Riding. Cavalrymen & Combat[/h1]
Master the art of horseback riding as those brave gentlemen once did. You’ll have a much easier time doing so should you give a quick read to what’s going to follow. Mounting, dismounting, putting your steed on the gallop, firing from horseback and various other aspects related to combat.

[h3]Riding On Horseback[/h3]
Let’s get to the riding now, shall we? Hussars, Cuirassier and Dragoons all spawn readily mounted. Once you’ve had your pick at one of these classes, you’ll find yourself on horseback. Holding the ‘W’ key will take the horse from one gait to the other gradually building up its momentum. An indicator to the left of your steed’s health bar will reflect the pace at which the horse is moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/ef93f5280146333f40e4f3263d5b862e273c91df.gif[/img]

Pressing the ‘Shift’ key once your steed reaches a full gallop, will take it into a sprint further increasing the speed at which it travels. While the horse is at a sprint, your movement on horseback will be limited as you grab tightly of its reins. Tread carefully as this can place you at a disadvantage when engaged in battle since you can only strike forward and cannot make use of your firearm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a39467e9425fa7865dd6747dc5936c88dac7cd35.gif[/img]

Should you need to make a turn, press the ‘A’ key to go left and the ‘D’ key to head right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/186b07353e70db038a372697b0961520caa75156.gif[/img]

Horses travelling at a slower gait can alternatively toggle and go into strafe mode by hitting the ‘Z’ key.  Your steed will consequently move to the left or to the right at the press of the ‘A’ or ‘D’ keys. You’ll find no excuse to neatly dress the gaps and keep in formation. A regiment must uphold its reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/19513907142d5aad2ecfa7d29b1874398ed0429c.gif[/img]

Slowing down is at times key to ensure your survival. You can do so by pressing the ‘S’ key. Should this key be held long enough, your steed will start moving backwards at a slow pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/dc3685204bbc31a61688af6bc4b1c9031d9d13a1.gif[/img]

Holding the ‘Ctrl’ key will similarly reduce the horse’s speed. There’s one key difference however, your horse will not go backwards after it reaches its lowest speed and instead come to a halt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2bd9d82378fda9cb3ccbd4d5bd33892fa6098bd7.gif[/img]

Make your way over smaller defensive emplacements and fences by jumping with your steed while on horseback. Carefully time your jump and press the ‘Space’ key at the right moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/d17f40a02af4e05d4455769f9fa402d86717719e.gif[/img]

It is not a simple feat to handle these beasts but you’ll get used to their ins and outs as you go by. Practice makes perfect. 

[h3]Swimming While On Horseback[/h3]
Go for a swim all the while remaining mounted. Controls here remain as usual but you are unable to engage in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/bd04c254ca7b8c8837e322ca277ea00a44d73f2c.gif[/img]

[h3]Halting The Horse[/h3]
Spotting a Chevaux De Frise reaching ever closely? Should you find yourself in a pickle, firmly hold the ‘F’ key and pull on your horse’s reins. This will rear the horse and bring it to a complete halt.

Hitting this defensive emplacement will kill your mount and diminish your health points as you fall from horseback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/656a60016669709d3dd367e6977d703265d93903.gif[/img]

[h3]Dismounting From Horseback[/h3]
Instructed to fall in line? You can dismount from horseback by pressing the ‘E’ key while your horse is going at the slower gaits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/86dab40de7e785e9708f9e371e879aa4f126257f.gif[/img]

[h3]Mounting Back On Horseback[/h3]
Keep your steed at a safe distance as you never know when the need arises to climb on horseback once more. Press the ‘E’ key while looking at your horse, mount and get going. Riders that have met an unfortunate end will leave their horse ownerless. Should you find yourself dismounted, try to mount another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/045d3f4cea04cd056077a9d1d2c2c9af175f4a5e.gif[/img]

[h3]Mounted Swordsmanship[/h3]
If you favour the Hussar class, you’ll find yourself engaged in combat up close and personal more so than often. Equip your Sword by scrolling to the relevant weapon or pressing the ‘3’ key, move your mouse to your desired strike direction and stab or slash away at the enemy.

If you have yet to release your strike, you can cancel and switch to another by holding the ‘Right Click’ mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c689a542ba2cf27cabe923a24491fefbc4f2ac84.gif[/img]

[h3]Mounted Marksmanship[/h3]
Carbineers make use of their firearm on horseback as you would whilst playing an infantryman. Hold ‘Right Click’ to aim, press ‘Left Click’ to fire then ‘R’ to reload. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3f45e97246dbd88c563c0b191a23bf291a66450c.gif[/img]

The speed at which you travel on horseback will be restricted to the slower gaits whilst reloading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5fb8d76047ce41948ba9c97ed77f4bd73a0888a3.gif[/img]

[h3]Trampling Infantryman[/h3]
Horses are mighty beasts! Blocking their path is of little to no use and you’ll find yourself injured or killed in the process. Horses travelling at a faster gait will deal greater damage to those unfortunate infantrymen. 

Should you be enough in good favour to remain alive after the fact, you will no longer have your weapon equipped. Wait a short while to come to your senses after the knockback and equip your weapon using the scroll wheel or number keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/01ecd3526a7d040ef301fb1c37c7c8e13d020ab8.gif[/img]

[h1]Community. Join The Discord![/h1]
Looking for a good bunch of fellows to play the game with? Do join our Discord! Linebattle events where players are encouraged to play in formations relevant to the Napoleonic era are hosted by the community through the week. Discord is also a great place to be to stay in touch with the game’s development. Feedback is always greatly welcomed.

If you’re a fellow in the ranks of a regiment, go [b]declare your enlistment[/b]. Through this, you can gather access to the ‘Field Camp’ where regimental specific discussion ensues. We look forward to seeing you there!

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame]https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/e68e7beaa6fba76377b7c39509539df29df532f9.png[/img]

There’s more to look out for in this major update! Additions focused towards gameplay balance, quality of life improvements, performance optimisations, administrative tools, plenty of bug fixes and more.

Take a look at the changelog for all the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 45 - Game Version 0.39.7290.31301[/b]

[b]Game Features[/b]
[b]●[/b] [b]New Cavalry Unit! The Hussar.[/b] Have your pick at one of these well-dressed cavalrymen. Great showmanship with swords on horseback.

[b]●[/b] [b]New Cavalry Units! The Cuirassier & Dragoon.[/b] Carbineers on horseback. These units excel at the use of this firearm while mounted and combined with the versatile mobility their steed provides, they can quickly traverse the battlefield.

[b]●[/b] [b]Horseback Riding![/b] Ride glorious steeds of war. Mount, put your steed on the gallop and charge into battle.
» Hussars, Cuirassier and Dragoons spawn readily mounted.
» Line Infantry Officers are able to mount and issue commands all the while remaining on horseback.
» Press ‘Shift’ to sprint when at full gallop and the ‘F’ key to instantly halt a horse.

[b]●[/b] [b]Horseback Combat![/b] Engage the enemy on horseback with swords, pistols and carbines. 

[b]●[/b] [b]Trampling Infantryman.[/b] Horses are mighty beasts! Blocking their path is of little to no use and you’ll find yourself injured or killed in the process.

[b]●[/b] [b]Chevauxs De Frise.[/b] Riders that find their way into these player-built defensive emplacements will find themselves dismounted. Make sure to make good use of these anti-cavalry defences.

[b]●[/b] [b]Cavalry Leaderboards.[/b] Rise to the top in the new leader boards. 

[b]●[/b] [b]Small Shell Rockets.[/b] New shell rockets to be mounted atop launchers and fired away! They have less range than their larger variant and can, therefore, more easily target those making their way near the launcher.

[b]●[/b] [b]Scrollable Scoreboard.[/b] Players can now scroll through the scoreboard should they wish to view themselves at the very bottom of the list. It won’t be a great sight to behold but it stood as one of the most player-requested quality of life additions so we delivered.

[b]●[/b] 1st Person Field Of View. Players can now adjust their field of view while in 1st person from the game options.

[b]●[/b] Dedicated chat channel for Infantry Officers, Hussars, Dragoons and Cuirassiers. Co-ordinate in the field of battle.

[b]●[/b] Carpenter Axes. Carpenters are now able to destroy wooden emplacements with their 2H Axe. This also includes palisades that make up for defences on some of the game’s fortifications.

[b]Game Polish[/b]
[b]●[/b] Players are no longer able to destroy moveable field guns and rocket launchers being operated by their own faction with explosive barrels or other artillery pieces. Should an artillery piece be captured by the enemy, this can still be destroyed.
» Setting ‘friendly_fire’ to true will once again allow players to destroy friendly moveable field guns and rocket launchers.

[b]●[/b] You are no longer required to ram swivel guns and mortars. Instead, a short cool-down timer is applied between shots.

[b]●[/b] You can now adjust the VoIP volume of each and every individual through the Round Players ‘P’ menu.
» Adjusting a player’s volume will persist through rounds.
» You’re now also able to ramp up and boost the volume of those low-sounding players.

[b]●[/b] Players can now enact defences in more locations when playing the Sapper class.
» The fortification present on Fort Christina.
» The fortification present on Fort Schwarz.
» The elevated grounds near the church on Training Grounds.
» Multiple areas within Fort Salettes.

[b]●[/b] Players can no longer capture flags from underneath the bridge whilst playing the Army Conquest game mode on Highlands.

[b]●[/b] Players will now find themselves killed if they jump in the fire present atop the lighthouse on King George.

[b]●[/b] Players are no longer able to angle the Infantry Spikes and Chevaux De Frise (S) player-built defences.

[b]●[/b] Carbines now come animated with a ramrod when reloading.

[b]●[/b] You are now able to change the default Windows audio device without restarting the game.

[b]●[/b] Renamed the ‘Weapon Fire’ audio slider to ‘Weapon’ as players can now adjust the firearm reload sounds through the same slider.

[b]●[/b] You can now adjust audio related to destructibility through the ‘Ambience’ slider.

[b]●[/b] Players that die during the match then select the ‘Freeflight Mode’ will now remain able to type in chat.

[b]Gameplay Balance[/b]
[b]●[/b] Flag Bearers and Musicians now only gather assist score from kills done by others through firearms of which they provide bonuses to.

[b]●[/b] Similarly, Infantry Officers only gather assist score respective to the buff they are providing. For instance, if the ‘Fire At Will’ command is issued, the Infantry Officer will gather assist score for kills by the ‘Rank & File’ using firearms.

[b]●[/b] Spikes situated around the Highlands and Fort Christina fortifications damage cavalry if an attempt is made to traverse the walls with them.

[b]●[/b] Slightly reduced the damage dealt by sword and muskets against player-built defences.

[b]●[/b] Increased the damage dealt by axes that the Carpenter class wields against player-built defences.

[b]●[/b] Light infantryman now moves at a greater speed while on foot. They also had their accuracy when firing whilst crouching slightly increased.
» Light Footed trait increased from 5% to 7%.
» Skirmisher trait crouching accuracy increased from 13% to 15%.

[b]●[/b] Destroying objects with the Carpenter Axe now gathers you a total of 5 score instead of 2.

[b]●[/b] You can no longer switch from 1st to 3rd person view to shoot from behind hills while remaining in better cover whilst playing the hardcore game type.

[b]●[/b] Slowed down the rate at which players can feint from one strike to another.

[b]●[/b] Increased the speed at which the ladder can be carried.

[b]Gameplay Balance - Naval Combat[/b]
[b]●[/b] Carpenter axes can now deal damage to wooden structures aboard naval vessels.

[b]●[/b] Rowers assisting the fellow steering the rowboat now properly contribute to its increased in speed. Rowboats are now able to travel at a faster speed due to this.

[b]●[/b] Coastal and naval artillery pieces had their effective range reduced to promote closer-range engagements.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the maximum aim of naval guns present aboard ships by a few degrees.

[b]●[/b] Opposing naval vessels now spawn slightly closer to one another on Harouti Islands and Open Waters to make up for what was mentioned above.

[b]●[/b] Increased the maximum speed of the 1-Gun Gunboat and Rocketboat.

[b]●[/b] Decreased the maximum ship speed of the 13-Gun Brig-Sloop when in favour of the wind.

[b]●[/b] Decreased the maximum ship speed of the 50-Gun Frigate when in favour of the wind.

[b]Game Optimisations[/b]
[b]●[/b] Undergone an upgrade to the game engine Holdfast: Nations At War runs on.

[b]●[/b] Player models received optimisations to ease some burden off the CPU.

[b]●[/b] Optimised the main menu scene. It will no longer ramp up your CPU usage. Locked to 60 FPS.

[b]Server Administration[/b]
[b]●[/b] Input the following command per map rotation for the Infantry Officer class to spawn readily mounted. We’re sure you’ll be able to find a use for this during events!
» officers_spawn_mounted true or false

[b]●[/b] Input the following command per map rotation to limit the number of lives for the defenders on the Army Siege game mode. 
» max_player_respawn <No. Of Lives>

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to define an introductory message which displays itself when the player joins the server or a new round starts. This can be used to define rules during linebattle events amongst others.
» You can make use of rich text to customise the message. Input the following in the server configuration to display the message.
» server_intro_title Welcome To My Server!
» server_intro_body Greetings to everyone. You will see this message every time you join the server.

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to log in-game chat messages. The messages will be saved to a file you predefine through the command below after the round ends.
» --chatLogFilePath "FilePath\chatlog_server1.txt"

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to log the in-game scoreboard. Player score and other relevant round details will be saved to a file you predefine through the command below after the round ends.
» Information is exported in CSV format for easier accessibility.
» --scoreboardLogFilePath "FilePath\scorelog_server1.txt"

[b]●[/b] Server administrators can spawn horses by issuing the following command. Horses will spawn on the defined faction’s spawn location.
» rc vehiclesSpawn <No. Of Horses.> <Faction> <Cavalry Class>

[b]●[/b] Input the following command to allow all classes to ride on horseback.
» rc set vehicleHorseForAll true or false

[b]●[/b] Gather a thousand blessings by spawning the holiest of horses. Blessed be thy cavalrymen.
» rc set useSpecialHorseVariants true or false

[b]●[/b] Server administrators can adjust the conditions for when and how an idle horse is despawned after its rider meets their end.
» A cavalryman's horse is immediately despawned if the cavalryman respawns. The horse timers only kick-off when the horse's original owner dies. Once the original owner dies, if the horse is no longer mounted by another player, the below conditions will kick in.
» rc set secondsToPassAfterDismounted <Time> - Defines the required time for when a horse gets despawned after a cavalryman dismounts or is killed.
» rc set secondsSpawnedBeforeDespawn <Time> - Defines the time a horse needs to have been alive before it gets despawned.
» rc set secondsToPassAfterHealthUpdated <Time> - Defines the time required to pass before a horse is despawned after it has been damaged. If the timer was at 5 seconds, it will reset back to the defined time.

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to disallow blocking with melee weapons.
» rc set allowBlocking true or false.

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to allow players to change to another weapon direction while blocking is disabled. The command mentioned above must be set to true.
» rc set allowWeaponHoldSwapOverride true or false.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to go through the base of the windmill present on Spanish Farm amongst others.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the outhouse doors to produce incorrect SFX when destroyed.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues with invisible objects on Camp Salamanca.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with stairs being difficult to climb on Fort Salettes.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where other players could appear sliding when healing others using the Surgeon class.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused players to get stuck on map load.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the Custom Naval Map missing a loading screen.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where a notification message informing the player that they were unable to authenticate to Steam was overlaid by the leader boards user interface when launching the game.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the player’s nameplate and voice chat indicator kept on showing while spectating.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple issues with user interface elements not scaling correctly on different aspect ratios.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the ‘Lantern Box’ was incorrectly shown as a ‘Spyglass Box’

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which allowed players to go outside the gate before the round starts on the Melee Arena game mode by utilising benches.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused an exception to occur when a player damaged another.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused moveable field guns and rocket launchers to not respawn.

[b]●[/b] Solved an error that was sometimes outputted when a player received a buff.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sometimes non-fully built explosive barrels could still be chain exploded.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with text sometimes being offset for administrative functionality in the Round Players ‘P’ panel.


[b]Changelog 46 - Game Version 0.40.7292.26678[/b]

[b]Optimisations[/b]
[b]●[/b] Performed several optimisations on both the scoreboard and cavalry units to improve client-side and server-side framerate.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the time idle horses remain alive on the field of battle.

[b]New Features[/b]
[b]●[/b] Should you not be feeling the holiday spirit, you now have the option to toggle off the ‘Festive Event’ through your ‘Game’ options. It will take effect after the next map loads.

[b]Gameplay Balance[/b]
[b]●[/b] Increased the cooldown timer after firing swivel guns and mortars by a few seconds.

[b]●[/b] Slightly increased the time it takes to go from crouching to standing and standing to crouching.

[b]●[/b] Slightly reduced the range and angle of the shoves and kicks.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which caused the server to crash unexpectedly.

[b]●[/b] Solved multiple exceptions on both the server and client.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where trampling someone with a horse would grant you the ‘Pub Brawler’ achievement.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players could get stuck on the wooden bridge present near Arendan River while riding on horseback.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the Field of View setting slider reverted back to default values on game launch.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused players to sometimes be unable to join a server. 

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the ‘K, D, S and Latency’ indicators on the scoreboard appeared to be miss-aligned.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where cannonballs didn’t their correct festive addition.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where antlers for the ongoing Christmas Event were at times not showing.


It has been an utmost pleasure developing this update, delivering on yet another promise prior to our release on Early Access. Months of hard work were had leading to the glorious introduction of cavalry units in Holdfast: Nations At War. 

We would like to extend a heartfelt and personal thanks to all of those good chaps that joined us in our testing and shared with us their feedback. The same goes for all those members within the Holdfast community that patiently partook in the filming of the trailer.

Once again, we thank you for your support and until next time may good health be yours.

Go forth now and ride you beauties, ride!

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Lamarsh Fen! Holdfast: Nations At War is now 50% Off
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/4ef93dcf444bf8e8515177479a8426daa7a5b285.png[/img]

Holdfast: Nations At War embarks on a [b]two-week[/b] long game sale presenting the opportunity to gather the game at [b]half the price![/b] Leading to the much-anticipated release of the next major update we’ll be introducing 2 maps to engage in heated battle - Lamarsh Fen and Causeways. You’ll also find that the game is now available in more languages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/589290/

It would be great if you can help us spread the word around about the sale to bring this genre of Musket Warfare games that we all love in the limelight. We want to continue strengthening the following behind the game as it grows and develops.

Come have a look at what’s to come. Check out our recent blog-post.

[h1]2 Maps! Lamarsh Fen & Causeways[/h1]
Present and playable with the latest game update, you will find two new maps to sink your teeth into on the Army Front rotation. Lamarsh Fen is designed to encourage and promote action-packed engagements as players can quickly get into the fray. Capture and hold key positions on the Army Conquest game mode or co-ordinate assault on Army Battlefield.

[b]Lamarsh Fen[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5ad966fb027a4a2ec539b156a13245a5f1678cb9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1d1a186e8b8e2542a2ccaced86cac32d4b9a59fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/be50f04f1108574242ed1870390ad570f66c6c15.jpg[/img]

Causeways is making a comeback. Long-time followers of our on-goings may keenly remember that a concept for this level was undergoing BETA testing but didn’t just make it to release due to its sheer size. We’ve gone back and revisited the map to bring the engagement closer.

[b]Causeways[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/41aa7a1aa0d1209d7680ecaac9abd47e22aced82.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/558462c5bb0ef596cb27901db79abbc7fa9bd4d2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1f50c309b3265d76202819344b7da5d8c7e617fc.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Languages! Localisation[/h1]
In support of niches within our dedicated community, we’ve expanded the selection of available languages to Polish, Italian, Czech as well as Dutch. Existing languages have also been revisited to improve upon their translation. Our sincere thanks go to all of those who supported this community-wide effort!

[b]New Languages[/b]
[b]●[/b] Italian - Barba Rossa, Aranos92, Jack Aubrey & Helbert.
[b]●[/b] Polish - Czechu, Wiking & Samowar.
[b]●[/b] Dutch - Wordsmith, Plastie, Timsel, Xeha, Fireman & VergerNL.
[b]●[/b] Czech - Billy Mays, Moley, Fainey, Kockonos, Svatda & Mimu.

[b]Update Languages[/b]
[b]●[/b] Chinese (Traditional & Simplified) - FeX Xcd, Marshmallows & Kamoeth.
[b]●[/b] French - Persess, Spitch & Mcfloy.
[b]●[/b] German - Loler, Mendoza, Pixelfall, Darknightmare100, Friedrich, Jan v. Richthofen & Airborne.
[b]●[/b] Japanese - Sato.
[b]●[/b] Korean - SNG.
[b]●[/b] Portuguese (Brazil) - Tatic, Frex20K & Blonde Mechanics.
[b]●[/b] Russian - Cortez, Paul & Progylkin.
[b]●[/b] Spanish - Belle, Voli, Humsl, OGNrazer, Zarko985, Carlos Pedretti, Dionant, Arsen & Fischer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/29f6d726bbc325a8331e0890f3b69dfb27c695c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]What’s Next? Cavalry Units[/h1]
It won’t come as a surprise to many but we are indeed gearing up for the much-anticipated cavalry release! They will be seeing an introduction in Holdfast: Nations At War with the next major update. 

It is quite the undertaking for our rather small development team and there's a lot that needs doing but our sights are still set on releasing the update this year and to this date, things are still very much on schedule.

Here’s a little something for your eyes to feast upon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/68074af61dd57e78e05f859ce0017089eb86d268.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 44 - Game Version 0.38.7223.25126[/b]

[b]Game Features[/b]
[b]●[/b] [b]2 New Maps![/b] Lamarsh Fen and Causeways are now playable on the Army Front rotation.
» Input the following parameters to play these maps on your community server: [i]map_name lamarshfen[/i] and [i]map_name causeways[/i]
[b]●[/b] Amended the Army Front rotation to include one instance of Ernest Ridge on Conquest.
[b]●[/b] [b]New Languages![/b] In support of niches within our dedicated community, we’ve expanded the selection of available languages and improved on existing ones.
» Italian, Polish, Dutch, Czech, Chinese (Traditional & Simplified), French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian & Spanish.

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[b]●[/b] You can now type in chat while auto-running.
[b]●[/b] Implemented a command to reset the server configuration back to its default state.
» rc set default

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the highest level 50 soldier rank medal wasn’t showing correctly.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the time played in the extended leader board to display incorrectly.
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused certain piano tunes to play less often then others.


Once again, we thank you for your support and as always, may good health be yours.

We’re working on the next update.

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Update Released. Fixes & Admin Tools
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/90290f71c7e70354ea1b91940d34917bbd6b4b1f.png[/img]

We’re pushing forward yet another update for Holdfast: Nations At War! Similar to our previous release, you’ll find plenty of bugs being tackled and administrative tools to make use of further facilitating the hosting of community events.

Have a read of our latest blog post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 43 - Game Version 0.37.7202.30892[/b]

[b]Game Balance[/b]
[b]●[/b] Players are no longer able to use buildable ammo boxes and rocket stacks to block pathways.

[b]●[/b] Player-built ammo boxes and rocket stacks are now destructible.

[b]●[/b] Similar to other melee weapons, you will now find yourself killed within a single strike if someone lands a hit on you with a flag while you’re reloading a firearm.

[b]Administrative Tools[/b]
[b]●[/b] The ‘rc ForceFirstPersonMode’ command now immediately forces players in third-person view to the first-person view.

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to parse multiple commands within a single line. The syntax goes as follows. Use a semicolon between commands and don’t repeat the rc parameter.
» You must always log in as an administrator first before issuing a remote command.
» rc <Command 1>;<Command 2>;<Command 3>;... 
» rc broadcast Form a line!; set characterRunSpeed 5

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to prevent players from shooting with firearms through an rc command. You’ll certainly find a use for this when a melee all charge is issued during events.
» Keep in mind that rc commands persist through rounds. If a command is enabled in one round it must be manually disabled on the next by setting it to false.
» rc set allowFiring <true or false>
» rc set allowFiring false

[b]●[/b] Server administrators are now able to delay the application of a particular rc command to a specific time. For instance, you could set ‘rc delayed 300 broadcast All Charge!’ to kick in at the 5-minute mark followed by a command to prevent players from firing during the charge by issuing ‘rc delayed 300 set allowFiring false’. 
» Keep in mind that rc commands can also be inputted in the server configuration file per map rotation.
» rc delayed <Time To Be Issued> <Command>
» rc delayed 300 broadcast All Charge!
» rc delayed 300 set allowFiring false

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Players making use of older AMD cards will no longer be presented with texture-less terrain.

[b]●[/b] Players making use of older AMD cards will now correctly render ocean while playing on the Naval Battlefield, Naval Assault or Coastal Siege game modes.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with audio when player-built or static defences where destroyed. It could be heard from a great distance afar and was otherwise quite loud.

[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an intermittent issue which causes players to spawn with their hands always pointing towards a carriable object.

[b]●[/b] Solved an exception that occurred when a player requested to auto-join a round.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the player’s score breakdown overlapped the spectate text.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where graphics preset would instead show as vsync in the settings.

[b]●[/b] Vistula, 92nd, friekorps and musician classes now show their correct medals in game.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which causes the Top 5 leaderboards to not refresh correctly.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where players could gather the 'Pomp & Circumstance' achievement without playing as a musician.

[b]●[/b] Solved an exception that occurred during the end of round when the leaderboard standing was being displayed.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with medals showing next to a player’s name becoming blurry when a player selects one of the lower graphical settings.

[b]●[/b] Solved an exception that occurred when an administrator slayed another player.

[b]Optimisations & Others[/b]
[b]●[/b] Conducted multiple server-side optimisations for when players connect to a server.
 
[b]●[/b] Optimised the scoreboard accessed through the ‘Tab’ key.

[b]●[/b] Update the ‘Join Custom Server’ panel.


Once again, we thank you for your generous support and as always, may good health be yours.

We’re working on the next update.

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Update Released. Bug Fixes & Additions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8338cb01ce728e8e944bcbc9248758c0a97ebce5.png[/img]

Holdfast: Nations At War has been updated! There’s going to be plenty of bug fixes amongst other minor additions coming in this one. Come have a read at our latest blog post to keep abreast with our on-goings.

We'll remain on the lookout for any issues that may occur.

Check out the full change log below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 41 - Game Version 0.36.7200.32417[/b]

[b]Game Polish[/b]
[b]●[/b] There’s now more leeway for players to move about while a surgeon is healing them. It will not immediately cancel it as a player moves away.

[b]●[/b] Improved the surgeon’s healing animation.

[b]●[/b] Rockets, round shot and grapeshot assist and kills now contribute towards your leaderboard standing and soldier rank.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the damage dealt when standing on a campfire. You’ll be instantly killed should you try to make your way into a larger fire. We’re looking at you good fellows unfairly rising through the ranks with the surgeon class.

[b]●[/b] You can now see the server your Steam friend is playing on through your Steam’s friend list.
» You may need to restart Steam to be able to view this new addition.

[b]Server Administration[/b]
[b]●[/b] Server administrators now have the option to enable a command which restricts game play to first-person view.
» rc set forceFirstPersonMode true or false

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with older ATI graphics cards crashing when the spawn button was pressed on. The game will now launch using a different DirectX for the graphics cards players reported issues with.
» For these older cards, the terrain will appear to be white once launched using an older DirectX. We will push a fix towards this in a future update.
» If you’re still experiencing issues with crashes upon clicking the spawn button, please be sure to make this known to us on the #bug-reports channel on our Discord.
» https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame

[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue which causes players to get stuck while loading the map.
please be sure to make this known to us on the #bug-reports channel on our Discord.
» https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused the game to freeze and only show a black screen on launch due to missing pre-requisites.

[b]●[/b] Solved a recurring exception which caused framerate to plummet when a player was carrying an object.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance which caused players playing with the surgeon class to be unable to reload.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where some of the images present in the spawn menu appeared white when a spawn point becomes full.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with missing localisation for the Korean, Japanese and Chinese languages on the leaderboards.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused nameplates of enemy players to show.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused player nameplates while in spectate to show.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which sometimes caused nameplates of players who already faced their end to continue to show.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where nameplates would flash when switching between spectating players.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which prevented leaderboards from populating and player medals from showing.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused soldier rank medals in the game to be offset by one. You would have received your first medal upon gaining the 6th rank instead of the 5th.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where you could sometimes be unable to see yourself on the leaderboard.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with white squares appearing in the leaderboards that are supposed to be representing medals.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the highest soldier rank medal wouldn’t show.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue that caused soldier rank progress to sometimes not be accounted for while playing on the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with an incorrect set of medals showing next to the player’s name for both his leaderboard standing and soldier rank.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the leaderboard would show the player’s Steam name instead of the custom name set from within the game. You can now represent your regiment in the leaderboards without having to change your Steam name.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the leaderboards would display multiple players as [Unkown] instead of their custom name.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused increased leaderboard loading times.

[b]●[/b] Improved the reliability of the Steam friend minimap tracking pointer. In the game, your steam friends show in yellow on the minimap.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sometimes the extended leaderboards view showing the Top 100 players would not display the correct results.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the player’s playtime wouldn’t show on the leaderboards.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where sometimes the extended leaderboard button would become unresponsive.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with underpopulated leaderboards not loading correctly.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with achievements which required progress not to function.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the 'Conscientious Objector' achievement still being awarded if the player killed someone using a cannon.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the destroyed guns aboard the 50-Gun Frigate would produce an invisible collider making it difficult for the crewman to move about on deck.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed players to go inside one of the ruins present on Fort Schwarz.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with textures on the spawnable Martello Tower prop.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where one of the rock slabs on Desert Ruins was missing a face.


[b]Changelog 42 (Hotfix) - Game Version 0.36.7200.35090[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which was causing the server to get stuck after the map loads.

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Leaderboards! Rise Through The Ranks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/299dd5bbc95db2d904d01b87747010d2a929b294.jpg[/img]

Sound the drums of competitive fervour as the latest update sees a release! Better your standing in the class-based leaderboards and rise through the ranks as you gather battlefield experience. You’ll be awarded medals for your honourable feats and achievements to distinguish yourself from the rest.

Come decorate yourself with Steam achievements! There are 50 of them to unlock in this release. Have a read of our blog post for all the details.

[h1]Leaderboards. Better Your Standing[/h1]
Excitement and revel as those good folks in the rank and file, artilleryman, skirmishers, crewman, those playing a support role as well as the ones in high-command strive to better their standing in the newly introduced class-based leaderboards.

Particularly good at playing your preferred class? We’ll surely be seeing your rise to the top! Score you’ve accumulated after the round ends whilst playing with one of the many classes that make up for Holdfast: NaW’s selection will be put towards bettering your standing in the leaderboards. You’ll also have a few medals to show for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/c5530181e80ab54c3a7d703c2025e23baaa5dcbb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Leaderboards. Medals[/h1]
Leaderboard medals are awarded based on a particular bracket you fall under. As you reach your way to the top 500, you’ll gather your first bronze medal followed by a silver medal once you make it to the top 100 and eventually the prestigious gold medal should your standing reach its way to the top 25.  Amongst those distinguished few that made their way to the top 3? You’ll similarly be rewarded with a unique decorative medal specific to your standing.

Show-off your honourable feats to those good men standing shoulder to shoulder. These medals will be displayed right next to your name whilst playing the game.

[b]Awarded Medals[/b]

[b]Bronze Medal - Standing +500[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/70199471cd4747961f17556036d9968f5fcc0b25.png[/img]

[b]Silver Medal - Standing +100[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/2ec82a45f831babb1d7983afdabd7c8ea771f1ae.png[/img]

[b]Gold Medal - Standing + 25[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/3fb0b99f130a7c840b56c26804194192949ab02a.png[/img]

[b]Top Tier - Standing 3rd Place[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a514ef47386c83481c72126795b9ca1a9fbfdc77.png[/img]

[b]Top Tier - Standing 2nd Place[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/58db05b374d1e2f745693c78044ae69273893594.png[/img]

[b]Top Tier - Standing 1st Place[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/556511f9e35c5fba0ebf9601d7df9819f059c9f1.png[/img]

[h1]Soldier Rank. Battlefield Experience[/h1]
Soldier your way through the field of battle and rise through the ranks! You’ll gather experience based on how well you did during a match. Start by picking one of the many classes to join the fray and advance through all 50 ranks. 

Staying true to Holdfast’s core design, you will find no unlockable firearms or melee weapons that otherwise provide an advantage over other players locked behind the soldier ranking mechanic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/5a31684877e79b1ae0fa4a2162e804a4e01ee154.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soldier Rank. Medals[/h1]
There’s a total of 9 medals you can gather through soldiering. Similarly, these will also be displayed next to your name while playing. It’ll certainly be quite the sight to see those good fellows well decorated.

[b]Awarded Medals[/b]

[b]Bronze Medals - Soldier Rank 5, 10 & 15[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1dc01b34dc986d5f9a09a5e329b29b08a67031b5.png[/img]

[b]Silver Medals - Soldier Rank 20, 25 & 30[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/38e38cd9669b060de7e1a8469e8e8aadb0c64923.png[/img]

[b]Gold Medals - Soldier Rank 35, 40 & 50[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/466de566ece77406b2808be89f60a861f4d562ae.png[/img]

[h1]Scoring. Game Balance[/h1]
Player scoring has undergone balance changes. Musicians and flag bearers will see an increase in score they gather by playing a supportive role indicative of their class, infantry officers gather more score while issuing orders to the rank and file and a variety of other related additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/a582645f516f965b2c3a040a41b20d8e58c507b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Achievements. Decorate[/h1]
Up for hunting a few Steam achievements? There are 50 ones to unlock all of which vary in difficulty. Humourful references to community ongoings, legendary works of art and more. Take a look at all the achievements you can gather below.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/589290/achievements]Holdfast NaW - Steam Achievements[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/1da8158d6f43c89a5fa3a5292f1a6e3168694639.png[/img]

[h1]What’s Next? A Subtle Hint[/h1]
Rest assured that the team is hard at work developing more game-play focused updates. In the next major update, Holdfast will see the introduction of one of the most community-requested features. I’m pretty sure you can guess what’s next in line from our rather [i]subtle[/i] hint below. 

It’s been months of hard work but it is nearing ever closer. You may also be seeing a new map being introduced leading to the release of the next major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/de83ebdbb45f5daee366b4b3df3b12df29b92041.jpg[/img]

[h1]Community. Join The Discord![/h1]
Looking for a good bunch of fellows to play the game with? Do join our Discord! Linebattle events where players are encouraged to play in formations relevant to the Napoleonic era are hosted by the community through the week. Discord is also a great place to be to stay in touch with the game’s development. Feedback is always greatly welcomed. 

If you’re a fellow in the ranks of a regiment, go [b]declare your enlistment[/b]. Through this, you can gather access to the ‘Field Camp’ where regimental specific discussion ensues. We look forward to seeing you there!

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame]https://discordapp.com/invite/holdfastgame[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/8bebda6023a1c7037a93c353917c67528a32168e.jpg[/img]

Here’s the full changelog for all the bug fixes and additions we have undergone in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 38 - Game Version 0.35.7196.27294[/b]

[b]Game Features[/b]
[b]●[/b] [b]Leaderboards. Better Your Standing.[/b] Good folks in the rank and file, artilleryman, skirmishers, crewman, those playing a support role as well as the ones in high-command strive to better their standing in the newly introduced class-based leaderboards.
» You can view the leaderboards by clicking the button present on the main menu or by pressing the ‘Esc’ key during a match.
» Expand the leaderboard to show the top 100 fellows by pressing the arrow button next to each class.
» Class-based leaderboards are respectively split into 'Class' and 'Melee Arena'. You will only be able to better your standing in the 'Melee Arena' leaderboard by playing on the respective servers.
» You require a minimum of 10 players on the Army Front servers for your score to contribute towards bettering your leaderboard standing or soldier rank advancement. Naval Warfront servers only require 6.

[b]●[/b] [b]Leaderboards. Medals.[/b] Leaderboard medals are awarded based on a particular bracket you fall under. Show-off your honourable feats to those good men standing shoulder to shoulder. These medals will be displayed right next to your name whilst playing the game.

[b]●[/b] [b]Soldier Rank. Battlefield Experience.[/b] Soldier your way through the field of battle and rise through the ranks! You’ll gather experience based on how well you did during a match. Start by picking one of the many classes to join the fray and advance through all 50 ranks.
» You can view the ranks of your soldiers through the leaderboards.

[b]●[/b] [b]Soldier Rank. Medals.[/b] There’s a total of 9 medals you can gather through soldiering. Similarly, these will also be displayed next to your name while playing. It’ll certainly be quite the sight to see those good fellows well decorated.

[b]●[/b] [b]Scoring. Game Balance.[/b] Player scoring has undergone balance changes. Musicians and flag bearers will see an increase in score they gather by playing a supportive role indicative of their class and more. 

[b]●[/b] [b]Steam Achievements. Decorate.[/b] Up for hunting a few Steam achievements? There are 50 ones to unlock all of which vary in difficulty. Humourful references to community on goings, legendary works of art and more. Take a look at all the achievements you can gather below.
» [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/589290/achievements]Holdfast NaW - Steam Achievements[/url]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused players to be pushed back when jumping aboard a moving ship.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused players to get stuck ramming or loading a cannon.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which prevented players from opening the spawn menu user interface when a ship was sunk by the enemy faction.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed infantry officers to stack ‘fire at will’ and ‘fire’ firearm accuracy bonuses.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused special characters from various localised languages on enemy player name plates to show.

[b]●[/b] Experimental fix towards an issue which causes interaction icons indicators to stretch throughout the map.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which broke subsequent Army Battlefield and Army Assault map rotations if a greater or lesser number of spawn points where present and using spawn overrides.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed server administrators to slay a player which was already dead. 

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which caused other players to disappear when looking at a specific area on Fort Salettes.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with invisible rock models on Snowy Plains 2 (L).

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with invisible gabions on King George.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with invisible rocks on Fort Winston.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with one of the pillar models missing a face on Desert Ruins.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue where the background appeared to be cut-off on Desert Plains 1.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the church door override props always spawning sideways.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the door1 props always spawning sideways.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which allowed gates on Fort Salettes to be openable while playing as the attackers on the Army Siege game mode.

[b]●[/b]Solved an issue which allowed gates on Southsea Castle to be openable while playing as the attackers on the Army Siege game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with floating barrel props on Palisade Arena.

[b]●[/b] Pianos are no longer destructible. 

[b]Game Polish[/b]
[b]●[/b] Hiding behind partially built Chaevaux De Frise (L) will no longer make you impervious to shots from firearms.

[b]●[/b] Reduced the number on infantry spawns on Fort Salettes gatehouse while the Army Siege game mode is playing.

[b]●[/b] Several maps have received amendments to prevent players from capturing points from obscure locations on the Army Siege and Army Conquest game modes.
» Fort Christina - Fort Flag = You can only capture this flag from the top of the blockhouse.
» Fort Salettes - Gatehouse = You can only capture this flag from ground level.
» Fort Salettes - Cellar = You can only capture this flag from the cellar itself.
» Fort Salettes - Tower = You can only capture this flag from the first floor upwards.
» Fort Schwarz - Fort Flag = You can only capture this flag while atop the tower.
» Balamor Bay - Tower Flag = You can only capture this flag from atop the fortification’s base.
» Fort Imperial - Fort Flag = You can only capture this flag while standing at the very top of the fort.
» Martello Tower - Tower Flag = You can only capture this flag from inside the tower.
» Martello Tower - Shipwreck = You can no longer capture this flag without going ashore.
» South Sea Castle - Fort Flag = You can only capture this flag from the first floor upwards.
» Fort Winston - Fort Flag = You can no longer capture this flag from atop the walls.

[b]●[/b] Increased the number of Infantry Officers playable on the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Blocked a few pathways on the walls present on Fort Arena to prevent players from running around in circles unnecessarily delaying the round.

[b]●[/b] Players can no longer enter inside the towers present on Watchtower Arena.

[b]●[/b] You will now find the kill streak announcer present on the Army Deathmatch game mode.

[b]●[/b] Several amendments to the top bar user interface while playing the Army Deathmatch game mode.
» It now shows neutral flags instead of faction-based ones.
» Flag to the left now tracks the kills you’ve gathered.
» Flag to the right now tracks the player that has gathered the most kills while excluding yourself from the equation.

[b]●[/b] Removed obsolete centre screen text from showing during the end of round screen while playing on the Army Deathmatch game mode.

[b]●[/b] Changed the winning condition of the Melee Arena game mode so it enables teams to make a comeback. Victory is now determined based on the team which first reaches a set number of rounds.

[b]●[/b] Several amendments to the top bar user interface while playing the Melee Arena game mode.
» It now correctly tracks the winning team.
» It now correctly represents the maximum number of rounds.

[b]●[/b] Solved an issue with the match duration being displayed incorrectly in the end of match screen while playing the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance where the maximum player respawns parameter would break the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance in which the round start countdown timer would flash shortly after the round reset in the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Solved an instance in which the wave spawn timer would be displayed whilst spawning in the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Prevented double kills from occurring inside spawn locations for fresh spawns in the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] The battle timer is now visible for spectators in the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] The end of round score now displays for longer in the Melee Arena game mode.

[b]●[/b] Removed the respawn timer displayed in the death screen whilst playing the Melee Arena game mode as it served no purpose.

[b]●[/b] Solved a rare occurrence which caused the Army Assault game mode to end early.

[b]●[/b] Disabled the wave spawn timer on the army Assault game mode. Players should spawn in instantly.

[b]●[/b] Slays from Administrators and player suicides now correctly count towards the enemy team in the Army Assault game mode. This sometimes resulted in the top bar displaying incorrect information.

[b]●[/b] In the Naval Assault game mode, the out of time winning condition was changed to count the number of ships sunk instead of the ships that remain alive.

[b]Map Editing[/b]
[b]●[/b] Implemented a command that copies the position and rotation of the player automatically to the clipboard. You will no longer have to get position then rotation and typing everything over manually to the server configuration file to place object overrides.
» Make use of the following command: [i]get details[/i]

[b]●[/b] Players can now spawn green and blue screens through overrides.
» bluescreen
» greenscreen

[b]●[/b] You can now make use of more spawnable objects during your map editing endeavours.
» Palmetto_1
» Palmetto_2
» CoconutPalm_1
» CoconutPalm_2
» MusketStack
» CrateLong_Red
» CrateLong_Brown


[b][b]Changelog 39 (Hotfix 1) - Game Version 0.35.7196.286[/b][/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue when the round resulted in a draw which could halt the server.

[b]●[/b] Client-side optimisations to reduce framerate spikes. We'll be working more on this.


[b][b]Changelog 40 (Hotfix 2) - Game Version 0.35.7197.2161[/b][/b]
[b]●[/b] Solved an issue which resulted in players being unable to spawn or join the round.

[b]●[/b] Pushed more client-side optimisations towards instances where players experienced a sudden drop in framerate.


[b]Know Issues - Upcoming Fixes[/b]
[b]●[/b] Players sometimes don't see medals while playing the match or are unable to open the leaderboard. 

[b]●[/b] Launching the scoreboard will cause a spike in framerate.

[b]●[/b] We're currently looking into these issues. All of the data throughout your play-session is being logged and accounted for. You will not lose any progress.


Once again we thank you for your support and until next time, may good health be yours.

We’re working on the next update.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]
