notes.title: Game Update. Single Life! Linebattles & Organised Play
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/48913f83c78aa5a0e0ff4fe7af2ff7f1238aef99.jpg[/img]

[b]Holdfast: Nations At War[/b] has been [b]updated[/b]. Ever took part in an organised event and experienced the thrill of the [b]single life[/b] game mode? Within today’s addition, we’ll be bringing that on our official servers! We’ll also be paying more well-deserved attention towards [b]organised play[/b]. 

In addition to all of this, you’ll also find [b]new maps[/b] being added to the game and more of our work on [b]localisation[/b].

[h1]Army Assault! Single Life Game Mode[/h1]
Strategize, coordinate and make good use of cover to turn the tide of battle in your favour! You’ll have to wait until the [b]round finishes[/b] before you can [b]respawn[/b] if you meet an unfortunate end. New players joining the server will be unable to spawn if the three-minute mark has already passed.

Hop in on one of the [b]official servers[/b] today to check it out yourself.
[list]
[*]Anvil Game Studios Official EU3 - Hardcore Assault
[*]Anvil Game Studios Official NA3 - Hardcore Assault
[/list]

[h1]Hardcore Mode! Organised Play[/h1]
As new strategies and tactics evolve within the line battle scene so must the game! Crews and regiments (clans) host weekly events where they follow the rules of engagement relevant to the Napoleonic era. It is a delight of ours seeing servers fill up to the brim with players, as regiments battle in formation.

In the [b]Hardcore Mode[/b], enemies are no longer visible on the minimap, you’ll find yourself spawning with limited ammunition and most importantly, the accuracy of firearms over long distances have been reduced. This will encourage closer range engagements to take place and promote tactical play. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/f4eb7d0273afd9c73eeaaf2adfd9616d5d731c4a.jpg[/img]

[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Your accuracy with firearms over long distances is reduced. The distance at which you engage your enemy is vital to increase your success at hitting your target!
[*]Your ammunition is limited. Every shot counts!
[*]Enemies don’t show on the minimap when they fire. Pay attention to your surroundings!
[*]Friendlies are only displayed on the minimap at a close distance. Officers must pay attention to the ongoings of the battlefield!
[/list]

If you haven’t done so already, we highly suggest that you enlist in a crew or regiment and join in the good fun. You can also form your own if you’re up to the task. Head over to our forums using the link down below to do so.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?board=6.0]Enlist in a Crew or Regiment.[/url][/b]

[h1]Firearm Recoil! Pistols, Muskets, Rifles & Blunderbusses[/h1]
We’ve now introduced [b]firearm recoil[/b] into the game to give you that extra kick whilst you’re burning powder. Kills are now also more satisfactory when your shot hits your [i]intended[/i] target! 

Your aiming reticule will no longer remain in the same position after you fire. During line battles and other forms of organised play, it has now become increasingly important for officers to teach their rankers how to fire at various distances. It is in your best interest to maximise the effectiveness of volley fire.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/ed68eec3a3627052408097d46fa08425125e0478.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map! Training Grounds[/h1]
A place for regiments to call home! An Officers’ quarters, a shooting range, melee arenas, field guns, mortars, several areas to host promotions at and most importantly, plenty of open space to train formations in.

Feedback is greatly welcome. If you’d like to provide us with suggestions on how we can improve the [b]Training Grounds[/b], you can do so on our Forums or Discord. One thing we have in mind is to place multiple spawn locations on the map so players can save time travelling from one area of the map to another.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/77633eec89c132d508f17a5c51d122a28fe4b2ed.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map! Snowy Plains II[/h1]
We have another map coming in with today’s patch! [b]Snowy Plains II[/b] has been specifically designed for organised play. You can find the code to play this map on your community hosted server further down the changelog.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/5420b10717d492c9e6a374469abf00872c7b1778.jpg[/img]

[h1]Localisation! Multiple Languages[/h1]
We’ve now finalized the underlying system that takes care of [b]localisation[/b]! Holdfast: Nations At War is now playable in [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Portuguese (Brazilian)[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Chinese (Traditional & Simplified)[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b]. 

You can change your desired language by clicking on the ‘[b]Language[/b]’ button on the main menu. 

Our heartfelt thanks go to these members of our community for their assistance with translation.

[b]Language Translators[/b]
[list]
[*]Chengda 'FeX Xcd' Xu
[*]Lingyun Zeng
[*]Refrain Song
[*]Hutao
[*]ilam
[*]George 'Winterfell' Miracle
[*]Sang-Min 'Bomulsun' Lee
[*]Ken R 'Hyuga' Kaminski
[*]Kimura 'Kagra' Kenta
[*]Obata 'Date' Takuto
[*]Sergei 'Mousecatcher' Zybin
[*]Oleg 'Haxor' Lukin
[*]Nico 'Deathstar' Jakobs
[*]Sergio 'Tenford' Cobo Peláez
[*]Alex 'Viriathus' Alexandre
[*]Charles 'iWeester62' Margueritte
[*]Alexandre 'Nastax' Lefeuvre
[*]Yann 'Black Wolf' Lopez
[/list]

As this is our very first pass on these translations, there are bound to be mistakes. You can inform us on our Forums or Discord if you encounter any grammatical errors. We’ll continue improving upon and adding new languages as the game progresses.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/2bfef7b2389d62c38f3f7f836dd915f4b6aa44ab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Engine Upgrade[/h1]
Holdfast: Nations At War has now undergone another [b]game engine upgrade[/b]. We’ve decided to embark on this [b]massive undertaking[/b] in an effort to improve [b]stability[/b]. Engine upgrades also provide us with additional features to [b]optimise[/b] the game.

You’ll definitely be seeing more of these happening as we progress further through the game’s development.


There’s more to this update than what we’ve mentioned above! You can check the full changelog out yourself down below. We’ve also put more effort this time around into a couple of quality of life additions to aid with the [b]administration of events[/b]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 11 - Game Version 0.11.6620.1843[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Single life official servers[/b]. Strategize, coordinate and make good use of cover to turn the tide of battle in your favour!
[*][b]Hardcore mode![/b] A mode specifically designed for organised and competitive play. 
» Playable on all the [b]existing game modes[/b]. Army Siege, Coastal Siege, Army Battlefield and more.
» Input the following parameter per map rotation to enable the Hardcore mode on your community server: [i]game_type Hardcore[/i]
[*][b]Firearm recoil![/b] Giving you that extra kick whilst you’re burning powder.
[*]New map! [b]Snowy Plains II[/b] is now playable in the game.
» Input the following parameter to host this map on your community server: [i]map_name snowyplainsII[/i]
[*]New map! [b]Training Grounds[/b]. A place for regiments to call home.
» Input the following parameter to host this map on your community server: [i]map_name traininggrounds[/i]
[*][b]Game engine upgrade[/b]. A massive undertaking in an effort to improve stability and broaden our options to further optimise the game.
[*][b]Localisation[/b]! Holdfast: Nations At War is now playable in [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Portuguese (Brazilian)[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Chinese (Traditional & Simplified)[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b].  We want to make sure that the game is widely available to everyone.
[*][b]NA Coastal Siege Server[/b]! We’re now hosting an official Coastal Siege server in North America.
[*]The round timer on the Coastal Siege official servers has been reduced by 5 minutes.
[*][b]Game information panel[/b]. To the top right of the spawn menu, a flashing question mark resides which if clicked on will present you with various information relative to the game mode you are playing.
[/list] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/fae231e754e65955353fbd7036b277e267cd638e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]The [b]Crews & Regiments[/b] button on the [b]main menu[/b] now [b]links directly[/b] to the [b]recruitment section[/b] our [b]forums[/b]. You better start planning ahead to keep your regiment thread more active! New players looking to join one will be browsing our forums more often.
[*]Players will now receive a notification if they are unable to join the round in the [b]Army Assault[/b] game mode. This can either be caused by the player’s death or if they attempt to join the round after the round close timer has been surpassed.
[*][b]Server administrators[/b] can now [b]privately message[/b] other players in the server through the ‘Round Players’ panel. We’re sure that this will come in handy for the administration of events! You no longer have to bother everyone with intrusive broadcast messages unless necessary.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/1ac8c5da41a1963bab72516ca3cec4949dd0e995.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]We’ve also introduced [b]search functionality[/b] in the ‘Round Players’ panel. It’ll make scrolling through a list of 150 players just a little bit easier.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/0ec0cbd2aa0301ba4a7948c9bb2e1f2f75f4ef81.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Players now have the option to [b]always show player names[/b] whilst using the [b]Free-Roam Camera[/b]. Once again, we’re sure that this will come in handy for the administration of organised events. 
» The 'Show Player Names' option can be found in the 'Game' tab under Free-Roam Camera.
[*]You can now [b]adjust the volume[/b] of [b]firearm and artillery shots[/b]. We’ve done this so players can communicate better through VoIP. 
» This can be done by adjusting the ‘[b]Weapon Volume[/b]’ slider found in the 'Audio' tab.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/7403935b812354b9fff3112bec906bb3d53187b5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Voice phrases in chat no longer show for Administrators.
[*][b]Client-side optimisations[/b]. Players running the game on low-end hardware should now see a slight performance improvement.
[*][b]Server-side optimisations[/b]. Servers will be seeing a slight increase in performance with this update.
[*]Chinese, Russian, Japanese and Arabic characters in broadcast messages now appear in white.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused 3D VoIP not to work for certain players.
[*]Additional tips have been included in the game. These tips are displayed when a map is loading.
[*][b]Desert Plains[/b] received a graphical re-work! In addition to this, two camps located near the spawns of both factions have been reinforced with mortar emplacements. The loading screen has been updated to reflect the new looks.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/68f08dce5a3a8ee115d48bb97f0417c8551ac4b7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Graphically improved the snow and desert environments. ‘Cold’ particle effects have been added on all snow themed game levels. The looks of the Atmospheric Scattering effect has also been improved.
[*]The British should now be able to destroy the French cannon using their own artillery piece on the Grassy Plains II map.
[*]Sharpton now has more artillery pieces when played on the Siege game mode.
[*]Added a natural crossing next to the bridge near one of the spawn locations on Sharpton.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused one of the wooden bridges on Sharpton to be inaccessible.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused players to get stuck underneath one of the shooting platforms on Sharpton.
[*]Fixed several issues with objects culling early on Sharpton.
[*]Several assets have been re-textured.
[*]Improved the grass wind animation.
[*]Improved the looks of the Polish Vistula’s shako.
[*]Improved the looks of grass on Dutch Canals and Sharpton.
[*]Adjusted the spawn points for the Army Assault, Army Battlefield and Deathmatch game modes on Southsea Castle.
[*]Fixed several issues with destruction on Fort Imperial.
[*]Fixed an error that occurred whilst loading the Spanish Farm map.
[/list]

You’re welcome to join us on our [b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/XsHBUNs]Discord[/url][/b] for a chat.

Thank you very much for your support and as always, may good health be yours.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]

Within today’s addition, we’ll be bringing that on our official servers! We’ll also be paying more well-deserved attention towards [b]organised play[/b]. 

In addition to all of this, you’ll also find [b]new maps[/b] being added to the game and more of our work on [b]localisation[/b].

[h1]Army Assault! Single Life Game Mode[/h1]
Strategize, coordinate and make good use of cover to turn the tide of battle in your favour! You’ll have to wait until the [b]round finishes[/b] before you can [b]respawn[/b] if you meet an unfortunate end. New players joining the server will be unable to spawn if the three-minute mark has already passed.

Hop in on one of the [b]official servers[/b] today to check it out yourself.
[list]
[*]Anvil Game Studios Official EU3 - Hardcore Assault
[*]Anvil Game Studios Official NA3 - Hardcore Assault
[/list]

[h1]Hardcore Mode! Organised Play[/h1]
As new strategies and tactics evolve within the line battle scene so must the game! Crews and regiments (clans) host weekly events where they follow the rules of engagement relevant to the Napoleonic era. It is a delight of ours seeing servers fill up to the brim with players, as regiments battle in formation.

In the [b]Hardcore Mode[/b], enemies are no longer visible on the minimap, you’ll find yourself spawning with limited ammunition and most importantly, the accuracy of firearms over long distances have been reduced. This will encourage closer range engagements to take place and promote tactical play. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/f4eb7d0273afd9c73eeaaf2adfd9616d5d731c4a.jpg[/img]

[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Your accuracy with firearms over long distances is reduced. The distance at which you engage your enemy is vital to increase your success at hitting your target!
[*]Your ammunition is limited. Every shot counts!
[*]Enemies don’t show on the minimap when they fire. Pay attention to your surroundings!
[*]Friendlies are only displayed on the minimap at a close distance. Officers must pay attention to the ongoings of the battlefield!
[/list]

If you haven’t done so already, we highly suggest that you enlist in a crew or regiment and join in the good fun. You can also form your own if you’re up to the task. Head over to our forums using the link down below to do so.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?board=6.0]Enlist in a Crew or Regiment.[/url][/b]

[h1]Firearm Recoil! Pistols, Muskets, Rifles & Blunderbusses[/h1]
We’ve now introduced [b]firearm recoil[/b] into the game to give you that extra kick whilst you’re burning powder. Kills are now also more satisfactory when your shot hits your [i]intended[/i] target! 

Your aiming reticule will no longer remain in the same position after you fire. During line battles and other forms of organised play, it has now become increasingly important for officers to teach their rankers how to fire at various distances. It is in your best interest to maximise the effectiveness of volley fire.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/ed68eec3a3627052408097d46fa08425125e0478.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map! Training Grounds[/h1]
A place for regiments to call home! An Officers’ quarters, a shooting range, melee arenas, field guns, mortars, several areas to host promotions at and most importantly, plenty of open space to train formations in.

Feedback is greatly welcome. If you’d like to provide us with suggestions on how we can improve the [b]Training Grounds[/b], you can do so on our Forums or Discord. One thing we have in mind is to place multiple spawn locations on the map so players can save time travelling from one area of the map to another.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/77633eec89c132d508f17a5c51d122a28fe4b2ed.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Map! Snowy Plains II[/h1]
We have another map coming in with today’s patch! [b]Snowy Plains II[/b] has been specifically designed for organised play. You can find the code to play this map on your community hosted server further down the changelog.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/5420b10717d492c9e6a374469abf00872c7b1778.jpg[/img]

[h1]Localisation! Multiple Languages[/h1]
We’ve now finalized the underlying system that takes care of [b]localisation[/b]! Holdfast: Nations At War is now playable in [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Portuguese (Brazilian)[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Chinese (Traditional & Simplified)[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b]. 

You can change your desired language by clicking on the ‘[b]Language[/b]’ button on the main menu. 

Our heartfelt thanks go to these members of our community for their assistance with translation.

[b]Language Translators[/b]
[list]
[*]Chengda 'FeX Xcd' Xu
[*]Lingyun Zeng
[*]Refrain Song
[*]Hutao
[*]ilam
[*]George 'Winterfell' Miracle
[*]Sang-Min 'Bomulsun' Lee
[*]Ken R 'Hyuga' Kaminski
[*]Kimura 'Kagra' Kenta
[*]Obata 'Date' Takuto
[*]Sergei 'Mousecatcher' Zybin
[*]Oleg 'Haxor' Lukin
[*]Nico 'Deathstar' Jakobs
[*]Sergio 'Tenford' Cobo Peláez
[*]Alex 'Viriathus' Alexandre
[*]Charles 'iWeester62' Margueritte
[*]Alexandre 'Nastax' Lefeuvre
[*]Yann 'Black Wolf' Lopez
[/list]

As this is our very first pass on these translations, there are bound to be mistakes. You can inform us on our Forums or Discord if you encounter any grammatical errors. We’ll continue improving upon and adding new languages as the game progresses.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/2bfef7b2389d62c38f3f7f836dd915f4b6aa44ab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Engine Upgrade[/h1]
Holdfast: Nations At War has now undergone another [b]game engine upgrade[/b]. We’ve decided to embark on this [b]massive undertaking[/b] in an effort to improve [b]stability[/b]. Engine upgrades also provide us with additional features to [b]optimise[/b] the game.

You’ll definitely be seeing more of these happening as we progress further through the game’s development.


There’s more to this update than what we’ve mentioned above! You can check the full changelog out yourself down below. We’ve also put more effort this time around into a couple of quality of life additions to aid with the [b]administration of events[/b]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 11 - Game Version 0.11.6620.1843[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Single life official servers[/b]. Strategize, coordinate and make good use of cover to turn the tide of battle in your favour!
[*][b]Hardcore mode![/b] A mode specifically designed for organised and competitive play. 
» Playable on all the [b]existing game modes[/b]. Army Siege, Coastal Siege, Army Battlefield and more.
» Input the following parameter per map rotation to enable the Hardcore mode on your community server: [i]game_type Hardcore[/i]
[*][b]Firearm recoil![/b] Giving you that extra kick whilst you’re burning powder.
[*]New map! [b]Snowy Plains II[/b] is now playable in the game.
» Input the following parameter to host this map on your community server: [i]map_name snowyplainsII[/i]
[*]New map! [b]Training Grounds[/b]. A place for regiments to call home.
» Input the following parameter to host this map on your community server: [i]map_name traininggrounds[/i]
[*][b]Game engine upgrade[/b]. A massive undertaking in an effort to improve stability and broaden our options to further optimise the game.
[*][b]Localisation[/b]! Holdfast: Nations At War is now playable in [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Portuguese (Brazilian)[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Chinese (Traditional & Simplified)[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b].  We want to make sure that the game is widely available to everyone.
[*][b]NA Coastal Siege Server[/b]! We’re now hosting an official Coastal Siege server in North America.
[*]The round timer on the Coastal Siege official servers has been reduced by 5 minutes.
[*][b]Game information panel[/b]. To the top right of the spawn menu, a flashing question mark resides which if clicked on will present you with various information relative to the game mode you are playing.
[/list] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/fae231e754e65955353fbd7036b277e267cd638e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]The [b]Crews & Regiments[/b] button on the [b]main menu[/b] now [b]links directly[/b] to the [b]recruitment section[/b] our [b]forums[/b]. You better start planning ahead to keep your regiment thread more active! New players looking to join one will be browsing our forums more often.
[*]Players will now receive a notification if they are unable to join the round in the [b]Army Assault[/b] game mode. This can either be caused by the player’s death or if they attempt to join the round after the round close timer has been surpassed.
[*][b]Server administrators[/b] can now [b]privately message[/b] other players in the server through the ‘Round Players’ panel. We’re sure that this will come in handy for the administration of events! You no longer have to bother everyone with intrusive broadcast messages unless necessary.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/1ac8c5da41a1963bab72516ca3cec4949dd0e995.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]We’ve also introduced [b]search functionality[/b] in the ‘Round Players’ panel. It’ll make scrolling through a list of 150 players just a little bit easier.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/0ec0cbd2aa0301ba4a7948c9bb2e1f2f75f4ef81.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Players now have the option to [b]always show player names[/b] whilst using the [b]Free-Roam Camera[/b]. Once again, we’re sure that this will come in handy for the administration of organised events. 
» The 'Show Player Names' option can be found in the 'Game' tab under Free-Roam Camera.
[*]You can now [b]adjust the volume[/b] of [b]firearm and artillery shots[/b]. We’ve done this so players can communicate better through VoIP. 
» This can be done by adjusting the ‘[b]Weapon Volume[/b]’ slider found in the 'Audio' tab.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/7403935b812354b9fff3112bec906bb3d53187b5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Voice phrases in chat no longer show for Administrators.
[*][b]Client-side optimisations[/b]. Players running the game on low-end hardware should now see a slight performance improvement.
[*][b]Server-side optimisations[/b]. Servers will be seeing a slight increase in performance with this update.
[*]Chinese, Russian, Japanese and Arabic characters in broadcast messages now appear in white.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused 3D VoIP not to work for certain players.
[*]Additional tips have been included in the game. These tips are displayed when a map is loading.
[*][b]Desert Plains[/b] received a graphical re-work! In addition to this, two camps located near the spawns of both factions have been reinforced with mortar emplacements. The loading screen has been updated to reflect the new looks.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/68f08dce5a3a8ee115d48bb97f0417c8551ac4b7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Graphically improved the snow and desert environments. ‘Cold’ particle effects have been added on all snow themed game levels. The looks of the Atmospheric Scattering effect has also been improved.
[*]The British should now be able to destroy the French cannon using their own artillery piece on the Grassy Plains II map.
[*]Sharpton now has more artillery pieces when played on the Siege game mode.
[*]Added a natural crossing next to the bridge near one of the spawn locations on Sharpton.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused one of the wooden bridges on Sharpton to be inaccessible.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused players to get stuck underneath one of the shooting platforms on Sharpton.
[*]Fixed several issues with objects culling early on Sharpton.
[*]Several assets have been re-textured.
[*]Improved the grass wind animation.
[*]Improved the looks of the Polish Vistula’s shako.
[*]Improved the looks of grass on Dutch Canals and Sharpton.
[*]Adjusted the spawn points for the Army Assault, Army Battlefield and Deathmatch game modes on Southsea Castle.
[*]Fixed several issues with destruction on Fort Imperial.
[*]Fixed an error that occurred whilst loading the Spanish Farm map.
[/list]

You’re welcome to join us on our [b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/XsHBUNs]Discord[/url][/b] for a chat.

Thank you very much for your support and as always, may good health be yours.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]

notes.title: Huge Update! Bagpipers, Grenadiers, Melee, 4 Maps & More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/14fafc2ab44820bbd1d091bff6e6ff39420c4542.jpg[/img]

[b]Holdfast: Nations At War[/b] has been [b]updated[/b]. Things have been extremely busy here during the past few months setting up a new office space. With everything now back on track, we’re releasing one of the [b]largest updates[/b] that Holdfast: NaW has ever seen!
 
We’re bringing forth kilted men into the field of battle with the most recent addition of the [b]Bagpiper Class[/b], more line infantry units for both the British and French factions - The [b]92nd Gordon Highlanders[/b] and the [b]Polish Legion[/b], an entirely new class - The [b]Grenadiers[/b], [b]four new maps[/b] - two of which are specifically designed to cater for organised gameplay, the [b]start of our improvements on melee combat[/b], [b]five new tunes[/b] for the [b]drummers[/b] and [b]fifers[/b], [b]quality of life[/b] additions and [b]more[/b].

[h1]Loud & Glorious. Bagpipers![/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]
 
Against all odds, these [b]kilted Scotsman[/b] marched gloriously into battle with their [b]Pipes[/b]. Equipped with a sabre and a pistol, they can also be effective on the charge. You’ll most certainly be seeing a frequent occurrence of this class during matches - They’ll become the next big thing! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/eba44059a2d00d52c7af326ab8570b73963d1268.jpg[/img]

What’s more impressive however is the selection of tunes available! A total of [b]22 bagpipe tunes[/b] were recorded in a studio, and have been introduced into the game in this update. Here’s the list of tunes.

[b]Bagpipe Tunes (British Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]With a Hundred Pipers
[*]War or Peace
[*]The Standard on the Braes O’ Mar
[*]The Point of War
[*]The Garb of old Gaul
[*]The Black Bear
[*]Scotland The Brave
[*]Muckin’ O’ Geordie’s Byre
[*]March of the Cameron Men
[*]Lochaber No More
[*]Lads With the Kilt
[*]Highland Laddie
[*]Hey Johnnie Cope
[*]Flower of Scotland
[*]Cock O’ the North
[*]Campbells are Coming
[*]Cabar Feidh
[*]Brose and Butter
[*]Bonnie Dundee
[*]Blue Bonnet
[*]Battle of Waterloo
[*]A Man's a Man
[/list]

A big thanks goes to everyone who brought this class to fruition. Calumn played the pipes, Joseph managed the recording session, Rejenorst edited the audio, Jackson took care of the art and Monroy which programmed the whole thing.

That is not all we have today for the musician classes. Fifers and Drummers certainly shouldn’t go amiss! [b]5 new fife and drum tunes[/b] are present in this update.

[b]Fife & Drum (British Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]The Girl I Left Behind Me
[*]The Campbells Are Coming
[/list]
 
[b]Fife & Drum (French Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]Fanchon
[*]Le 31 Du Mois D'Août
[*]On Vas Leur Percer Le Flanc
[/list]

[h1]New Class. Grenadiers![/h1]
[i]Role: Offense[/i]
 
Chosen from the strongest and largest of soldiers, [b]Grenadiers[/b] excel at killing other infantry units. With this we’ve continued adding to an already vast selection of classes but we won’t be stopping right here. Do look forward to future additions to both this class as well as others. 

[b]French Grenadiers[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/30fdb22537f645f0325c3ae53c2191c099e42324.jpg[/img]

[b]British Grenadiers[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/e509faee85b7cc561951fbb3a058e41a750577c1.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Bayonet Specialisation[/i] - Excels with using bayonets. Your melee damage when wielding a bayoneted musket is slightly increased.
 
[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Musket[/i] - Muzzle loaded firearms equipped with a pointy end. They’re your best bet at making quick work of your enemy if things get up close and personal.

Historically grenadiers weren’t equipped with [b]grenades[/b], however these throwables were already present during the Napoleonic Era. As a future addition to this class, it would certainly be possible to consider including them in the game but the [b]head’s up will need to be given by the community[/b] on this matter first. They will not have a large area of effect so their effectiveness against line formations will not be great, they’ll be operated through a fuse, available in limited numbers and server administrators can disable them directly through the config file.

This question will be put forward to the community in a [b]future poll[/b]. You will be the ones to decide.

[h1]New Units. The 92nd Highlanders & Polish Legion![/h1]
This will come as quite the surprise to some since we’ve never mentioned this particular addition to the game within our development roadmap. However, we’ve heard time and time again requests to introduce more units to the existing classes so we’ll be doing just that!
 
Scotsmen! Play as the [b]92nd Gordon Highlanders[/b] in the British Army or fight for your emperor with the [b]Polish Vistula Legion[/b]. Both of these new units are an additional variation to the existing Line Infantrymen class.

[b]Polish Vistula Legion (French Empire)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4272c10123d57030cf1803688bad82ddb377f6f5.jpg[/img]

[b]92nd Gordon Highlanders (British Empire)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/2aff9ed13b3a380c6bb805c478cc635dffff0f93.jpg[/img]

[h1]Melee Combat Improvements![/h1]
Now that most of the backend work is done we can start pushing [b]improvements[/b] towards melee combat! In this update you will be able to go into [b]melee combat whilst crouching[/b]. It’s an especially useful quality of life addition when you’re engaged in the heat of battle.
 
[b]Blocking[/b] will also be seeing a drastic improvement when it comes to [b]responsiveness[/b]! It has since undergone a substantial rework towards this effort. From our preliminary testing, our testers have experienced [b]little to no delay[/b]. Before the rework, blocking was highly dependent on latency so now players can expect a much more responsive defensive mechanic.
 
There has also been a variety of other additions that both directly and indirectly contribute to melee combat from optimisations, fluidity between transitions and general responsiveness.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/917ec1ee11d5f80893c87bde3e6982ac07aba074.jpg[/img]

These improvements have [b]yet to be tested[/b] on [b]high player count servers[/b] as we don’t have the in-house resources to do that. In the future, we may require some more volunteers for testing. We will be monitoring this throughout the coming weeks on our official servers and changes will commence accordingly. Joining a low latency server that correctly reflects your region is still highly recommended of course.
 
We do understand that melee is a core mechanic of the game, and is at the heart of what the community wants! You’ll most certainly be seeing more improvements and new additions in future updates. This is only the [b]beginning of our work[/b] on [b]improving the melee[/b].

Be sure to forward us your suggestions and feedback so we can continue improving upon the system. Thank you for everything thus far!

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=813.150]Go here to provide us with feedback.[/url][/b]

[h1]4 New Maps! Sharpton, Dutch Canals & Plains Maps[/h1]
With this update, we’ll be introducing yet even more maps in Holdfast: Nations At War all featuring different scenarios and environments. They will also be plenty in number! A total of [b]four new maps[/b] playable on a variety of different game modes are now being rotated on the official servers.
 
Inspired by one of the most famous battles during the Napoleonic Wars, [b]Sharpton[/b] features two farm houses that where pivotal towards turning the tide of the battle. In this map, both of these conflict points will see plenty of engagements. This map is playable on the Army Battlefield, Assault, Deathmatch and Siege game modes.

[b]Sharpton[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/02dd954500fd475160d374c05170f6177b57654b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/bf40a851c5ecf880201e48f504ca119048de1882.jpg[/img]

[b]Dutch Canals[/b] is another map featuring plenty of space for open field engagements, farms surrounded by fences, windmills and a whole lot of flat terrain. This map is playable on the Army Battlefield, Assault and Deathmatch game modes.

[b]Dutch Canals[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/8161a2a3c7ea75c5495355db75a14dc4252d8785.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/083f51209a1c20726c705f631e3fa0a076108b54.jpg[/img]

We have been gathering feedback from various regiments (clans) and event hosts to improve on our current designs for line battle maps. [b]Desert Plains[/b] and [b]Grassy Plains II[/b] are specifically designed to cater for organised play. You’ll definitely be seeing more of these maps crop up as we progress through the development of the game.

[b]Desert Plains[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/efec09f8b6b4cd259a3b13970b18a411fe8b4e6d.jpg[/img]

[b]Grassy Plains II[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/a462967ab90c79123a515d0f4532a74029dad3e0.jpg[/img]

You’re welcome to hop in and check them out yourself! If you’d like to host these maps on your Community server, further details are provided in the full changelog below.

[h1]New Office Space. We’ve Grown The Team![/h1]
Besides a few remaining aesthetics, the [b]new office space[/b] is pretty much [b]complete[/b]. It has been quite the endeavour to set everything up but we’re now in a position to continue [b]growing the team[/b]. This is of the utmost necessity for the [b]well-being of the game[/b]!

We have been listening very closely as to what the community wants. Improvements upon melee combat, the introduction of cavalry, more naval mechanics or even a map editor all require a programmer’s skill set to be developed.
 
We’re very pleased to announce our latest addition to the team, [b]Dylan ‘Monroy’ Vassallo[/b]. Monroy is working closely with our lead programmer Andreas ‘Dreas’ Grech on a full time basis to bring new and improved gameplay oriented features to the game. He has only been with us for a couple of weeks but thanks to his skill and dedication he already started effectively contributing towards the project! He’s been taking care of integrating game levels, quality of life additions as well as the bagpiper class.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/3c7eee84e73069493c6dde6743a559d5c5f9f71e.jpg[/img]

[b]Rohail ‘Austro’ Leghari[/b], a 3D Artist has also joined the team! He’ll be there designing new models for game levels during the weekends. You can have a look at some of his work down below. He’s currently designing a set of Spanish themed destructible buildings.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/c9ef16b4dd77a8987aee5eea7363ae7b0b1bbc18.jpg[/img]

Please join us in welcoming both of these good chaps! We look forward to showing you more of their content.
 
This is [b]not all there is to this update[/b]! You can continue reading the full changelog below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 10 - Game Version 0.10.6593.29863[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Bagpipers[/b]! A grand total of [b]22 tunes[/b] are available for this class. You can check them out by joining the British faction.
[*][b]5 new tunes[/b] for the [b]fifer[/b] and [b]drummer[/b] musician classes have been added into the game. 2 of those tunes are British and the remaining are French.
[*]A new map! [b]Sharpton[/b] is now playable in game.
» Use the following parameter to host the map on your community server: [i]map_name sharpton[/i]
[*]A new map! [b]Dutch Canals[/b] is now playable in game.
» Use the following parameter to host the map on your community server: [i]map_name dutchcanals[/i]
[*]2 new line battle maps! [b]Grassy Plains II[/b] and [b]Desert Plains[/b] are now playable in game.
» Use the following parameters to host these maps on your community [i]server: map_name GrassyPlainsII[/i] or [i]map_name DesertPlains[/i]
[*][b]Grenadiers![/b] Chosen from the strongest and largest of soldiers. They’re available to be played in both the British and French factions.
[*]2 new line infantry units! The [b]92nd Gordon Highlanders[/b] and [b]Polish Vistula Legion[/b].
[*][b]Melee combat improvements[/b]! You’ll be seeing more updates on this from us in future patches. This is only the [b]beginning of our work[/b] on [b]improving the melee[/b]. Here are more specifics. These changes have yet to be tested on high player count servers.
» Blocking will be seeing a drastic improvement when it comes to responsiveness, and is no longer highly dependent on latency.
» You are now able to go into melee combat whilst crouching. Your character will stand up so you can commence with melee combat. You can do so by pressing the ‘X’ key or striking or blocking with your melee weapon from a crouching position. 
» A variety of other additions that both directly and indirectly contribute to melee combat from optimisations, fluidity between transitions and general responsiveness.
[*]Transitions when going from running to aiming and vice versa are now more fluid.
[*]You can now reload your firearm directly from melee mode. Once again this should add to the overall fluidity of combat!
[*]You can now cease reloading your firearm by jumping.
[*]You will now stop crouching if you jump.
[*][b]Reworked Arendan River’s Siege mode[/b]! This map has been re-designed with the intention to prevent players from losing to much reinforcement’s needlessly by attempting to defend an optional capture point.
[*]The [b]scoreboard[/b] has been [b]re-designed[/b]. The player IDs have been removed and are now visible in the Round Players panel instead. We’ve also changed the font to a more readable text.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/5a5103c23eb1debd2ae674e5a68ad13f4dbb0661.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Free roam camera improvements[/b]! You can now see the names of other players irrespective of the faction you have joined. It’ll certainly come in handy for all those generous fellows who take up their precious time to host events.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/001f36f42fd8ca65d4e62fc9945497c1bf2f167f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the free roam camera to collide with invisible walls.
[*][b]Spectator camera improvements[/b]! You can now view nameplates of other players by rotating your camera when spectating another player. This is yet another addition to aid with the administration of events.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/c6e4ca31bbba6b437d8689e8de940237d541911c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Server side optimisations. More to come in future updates.
[*]Additional work to improve game stability.
[*]You now have the option to listen to your microphone input when speaking through VoIP by enabling ‘Listen Locally’ from the ‘Audio’ settings.
[*]There’s now a very slight delay when you stop pressing the push to talk key for 3D VoIP.
[*]The list of official game servers displayed in the ‘Join Other Server’ panel that is accessed through a button on the server browser has been update. You can make use of this if you ever face issues with not being able to see servers in the lobby.
[*][b]Multiple language support[/b]! The game now supports [b]Chinese[/b], [b]Japanese[/b], [b]Korean[/b], [b]Russian[/b] and [b]Arabic[/b] languages. You can now make use of or see these characters being displayed for all the above mentioned languages in the game chat, player names, scoreboard, admin broadcast message as well as the round players panel. We’re now also supporting extra [b]special characters[/b] that are especially useful for [b]regimental tags[/b].
[*]There has also been a variety of changes to fonts in a variety of other places including the main menu and settings options. Everything here was done in preparations for localisation. It’s going to be our next step after multiple language support to ensure that the game is widely available to everyone. More on this in future updates!
[*][b]Game tips and map information[/b]. We’re now displaying the map’s name, game mode and a variety of tips specific to the game mode being played on the map loading screen. We’ll be including more information in here as the game progresses.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4b1a2286ab9389da25861214403ca38d42b0d659.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]More line battle maps have been included in the official server map rotation. This was voted on by the community. You can see the results of the poll yourself here on our forums.
» [b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=3164.0]Poll - Official server linebattle map rotation. Cast your vote![/url][/b]
[*]Player joined notifications are no longer displayed when you hide the UI using the ‘Scroll Lock’ key.
[*]Canyon has been optimised even further.
[*]Improved the looks of the flora on Grassy Plains.
[*]We’ve also added more spawn locations on all maps to reduce the chance of players spawning on top of each other.
[*]Improved the looks of the snow particle effect.
[*]Improved and changed ambient sounds on a variety of maps.
[*]Organised the order of classes on the Palisade Arena map.
[*]Removed HTML tags from the game chat and administrator broadcast messages.
[*]Fixed a spelling mistake in one of the messages that get displayed when reinforcements are depleted.
[*]Fixed an issue on Spanish Farm which caused players to fling into the air and access the attic inside the two story house.
[*]Fixed several spots on the Desert Ruins map which were never intended to be accessible.
[*]Fixed issues with rain and snow accumulation on various maps.
[*]Fixed issues with collisions that made some stairs inaccessible on Arendan River.
[*]Fixed several issues with objects culling (disappearing at long distances) before they should on Arendan River.
[*]Fixed several errors that occurred whilst playing on the Grassy Plains map.
[*]Fixed an issue with grass being limited to a certain distance on Fort Christina.
[*]The official server map rotation has been changed to reduce the chance of night scenes and weather.
[*]The Join Game button in the main menu has been renamed to Play.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Sometimes, the leg movement of other players whilst holding a bagpipe doesn't look as intended. We'll be investigating the root cause.
[*]If you experience a graphical bug on Sharpton, kindly restart your game to solve the issue until we push forward a fix.
[*]If your 3D VoIP is not working, kindly take a look at the below. We'll be pushing a permanent fix to solve this issue in the upcoming update.
» Enable "Stereo Mix" (It's in the recording tab) from your PC's "Sound" settings.

[/list]

Whilst you’re all enjoying the latest update, we’ve already started our work on the next one. This time around we will be featuring new modes, maps and other additions focused on organised play. We want to give back to the regimental community which has been instrumental towards the success of the game!

You'll also be pleased to hear that there has been plenty of progress on the [b]Prussian[/b] faction. Keep a look out on our [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/holdfastgame]Facebook[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://twitter.com/holdfastgame]Twitter[/url][/b].

Thank you very much for your support and as always, may good health be yours.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]

notes.title: Huge Update! Bagpipers, Grenadiers, Melee, 4 Maps & More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/14fafc2ab44820bbd1d091bff6e6ff39420c4542.jpg[/img]

[b]Holdfast: Nations At War[/b] has been [b]updated[/b]. Things have been extremely busy here during the past few months setting up a new office space. With everything now back on track, we’re releasing one of the [b]largest updates[/b] that Holdfast: NaW has ever seen!
 
We’re bringing forth kilted men into the field of battle with the most recent addition of the [b]Bagpiper Class[/b], more line infantry units for both the British and French factions - The [b]92nd Gordon Highlanders[/b] and the [b]Polish Legion[/b], an entirely new class - The [b]Grenadiers[/b], [b]four new maps[/b] - two of which are specifically designed to cater for organised gameplay, the [b]start of our improvements on melee combat[/b], [b]five new tunes[/b] for the [b]drummers[/b] and [b]fifers[/b], [b]quality of life[/b] additions and [b]more[/b].

[h1]Loud & Glorious. Bagpipers![/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]
 
Against all odds, these [b]kilted Scotsman[/b] marched gloriously into battle with their [b]Pipes[/b]. Equipped with a sabre and a pistol, they can also be effective on the charge. You’ll most certainly be seeing a frequent occurrence of this class during matches - They’ll become the next big thing! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/eba44059a2d00d52c7af326ab8570b73963d1268.jpg[/img]

What’s more impressive however is the selection of tunes available! A total of [b]22 bagpipe tunes[/b] were recorded in a studio, and have been introduced into the game in this update. Here’s the list of tunes.

[b]Bagpipe Tunes (British Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]With a Hundred Pipers
[*]War or Peace
[*]The Standard on the Braes O’ Mar
[*]The Point of War
[*]The Garb of old Gaul
[*]The Black Bear
[*]Scotland The Brave
[*]Muckin’ O’ Geordie’s Byre
[*]March of the Cameron Men
[*]Lochaber No More
[*]Lads With the Kilt
[*]Highland Laddie
[*]Hey Johnnie Cope
[*]Flower of Scotland
[*]Cock O’ the North
[*]Campbells are Coming
[*]Cabar Feidh
[*]Brose and Butter
[*]Bonnie Dundee
[*]Blue Bonnet
[*]Battle of Waterloo
[*]A Man's a Man
[/list]

A big thanks goes to everyone who brought this class to fruition. Calumn played the pipes, Joseph managed the recording session, Rejenorst edited the audio, Jackson took care of the art and Monroy which programmed the whole thing.

That is not all we have today for the musician classes. Fifers and Drummers certainly shouldn’t go amiss! [b]5 new fife and drum tunes[/b] are present in this update.

[b]Fife & Drum (British Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]The Girl I Left Behind Me
[*]The Campbells Are Coming
[/list]
 
[b]Fife & Drum (French Empire)[/b]
[list]
[*]Fanchon
[*]Le 31 Du Mois D'Août
[*]On Vas Leur Percer Le Flanc
[/list]

[h1]New Class. Grenadiers![/h1]
[i]Role: Offense[/i]
 
Chosen from the strongest and largest of soldiers, [b]Grenadiers[/b] excel at killing other infantry units. With this we’ve continued adding to an already vast selection of classes but we won’t be stopping right here. Do look forward to future additions to both this class as well as others. 

[b]French Grenadiers[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/30fdb22537f645f0325c3ae53c2191c099e42324.jpg[/img]

[b]British Grenadiers[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/e509faee85b7cc561951fbb3a058e41a750577c1.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Bayonet Specialisation[/i] - Excels with using bayonets. Your melee damage when wielding a bayoneted musket is slightly increased.
 
[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Musket[/i] - Muzzle loaded firearms equipped with a pointy end. They’re your best bet at making quick work of your enemy if things get up close and personal.

Historically grenadiers weren’t equipped with [b]grenades[/b], however these throwables were already present during the Napoleonic Era. As a future addition to this class, it would certainly be possible to consider including them in the game but the [b]head’s up will need to be given by the community[/b] on this matter first. They will not have a large area of effect so their effectiveness against line formations will not be great, they’ll be operated through a fuse, available in limited numbers and server administrators can disable them directly through the config file.

This question will be put forward to the community in a [b]future poll[/b]. You will be the ones to decide.

[h1]New Units. The 92nd Highlanders & Polish Legion![/h1]
This will come as quite the surprise to some since we’ve never mentioned this particular addition to the game within our development roadmap. However, we’ve heard time and time again requests to introduce more units to the existing classes so we’ll be doing just that!
 
Scotsmen! Play as the [b]92nd Gordon Highlanders[/b] in the British Army or fight for your emperor with the [b]Polish Vistula Legion[/b]. Both of these new units are an additional variation to the existing Line Infantrymen class.

[b]Polish Vistula Legion (French Empire)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4272c10123d57030cf1803688bad82ddb377f6f5.jpg[/img]

[b]92nd Gordon Highlanders (British Empire)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/2aff9ed13b3a380c6bb805c478cc635dffff0f93.jpg[/img]

[h1]Melee Combat Improvements![/h1]
Now that most of the backend work is done we can start pushing [b]improvements[/b] towards melee combat! In this update you will be able to go into [b]melee combat whilst crouching[/b]. It’s an especially useful quality of life addition when you’re engaged in the heat of battle.
 
[b]Blocking[/b] will also be seeing a drastic improvement when it comes to [b]responsiveness[/b]! It has since undergone a substantial rework towards this effort. From our preliminary testing, our testers have experienced [b]little to no delay[/b]. Before the rework, blocking was highly dependent on latency so now players can expect a much more responsive defensive mechanic.
 
There has also been a variety of other additions that both directly and indirectly contribute to melee combat from optimisations, fluidity between transitions and general responsiveness.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/917ec1ee11d5f80893c87bde3e6982ac07aba074.jpg[/img]

These improvements have [b]yet to be tested[/b] on [b]high player count servers[/b] as we don’t have the in-house resources to do that. In the future, we may require some more volunteers for testing. We will be monitoring this throughout the coming weeks on our official servers and changes will commence accordingly. Joining a low latency server that correctly reflects your region is still highly recommended of course.
 
We do understand that melee is a core mechanic of the game, and is at the heart of what the community wants! You’ll most certainly be seeing more improvements and new additions in future updates. This is only the [b]beginning of our work[/b] on [b]improving the melee[/b].

Be sure to forward us your suggestions and feedback so we can continue improving upon the system. Thank you for everything thus far!

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=813.150]Go here to provide us with feedback.[/url][/b]

[h1]4 New Maps! Sharpton, Dutch Canals & Plains Maps[/h1]
With this update, we’ll be introducing yet even more maps in Holdfast: Nations At War all featuring different scenarios and environments. They will also be plenty in number! A total of [b]four new maps[/b] playable on a variety of different game modes are now being rotated on the official servers.
 
Inspired by one of the most famous battles during the Napoleonic Wars, [b]Sharpton[/b] features two farm houses that where pivotal towards turning the tide of the battle. In this map, both of these conflict points will see plenty of engagements. This map is playable on the Army Battlefield, Assault, Deathmatch and Siege game modes.

[b]Sharpton[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/02dd954500fd475160d374c05170f6177b57654b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/bf40a851c5ecf880201e48f504ca119048de1882.jpg[/img]

[b]Dutch Canals[/b] is another map featuring plenty of space for open field engagements, farms surrounded by fences, windmills and a whole lot of flat terrain. This map is playable on the Army Battlefield, Assault and Deathmatch game modes.

[b]Dutch Canals[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/8161a2a3c7ea75c5495355db75a14dc4252d8785.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/083f51209a1c20726c705f631e3fa0a076108b54.jpg[/img]

We have been gathering feedback from various regiments (clans) and event hosts to improve on our current designs for line battle maps. [b]Desert Plains[/b] and [b]Grassy Plains II[/b] are specifically designed to cater for organised play. You’ll definitely be seeing more of these maps crop up as we progress through the development of the game.

[b]Desert Plains[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/efec09f8b6b4cd259a3b13970b18a411fe8b4e6d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/a462967ab90c79123a515d0f4532a74029dad3e0.jpg[/img]

You’re welcome to hop in and check them out yourself! If you’d like to host these maps on your Community server, further details are provided in the full changelog below.

[h1]New Office Space. We’ve Grown The Team![/h1]
Besides a few remaining aesthetics, the [b]new office space[/b] is pretty much [b]complete[/b]. It has been quite the endeavour to set everything up but we’re now in a position to continue [b]growing the team[/b]. This is of the utmost necessity for the [b]well-being of the game[/b]!

We have been listening very closely as to what the community wants. Improvements upon melee combat, the introduction of cavalry, more naval mechanics or even a map editor all require a programmer’s skill set to be developed.
 
We’re very pleased to announce our latest addition to the team, [b]Dylan ‘Monroy’ Vassallo[/b]. Monroy is working closely with our lead programmer Andreas ‘Dreas’ Grech on a full time basis to bring new and improved gameplay oriented features to the game. He has only been with us for a couple of weeks but thanks to his skill and dedication he already started effectively contributing towards the project! He’s been taking care of integrating game levels, quality of life additions as well as the bagpiper class.

Please join us in welcoming this good chap! We look forward to showing you more of his content.

notes.title: Holdfast: Nations At War is now 25% OFF! Progress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/b4b1c8ed012741fbe382fabbf16633ed28f0e984.png[/img]

Holdfast: Nations At War is now [b]25% off[/b] for a [b]limited time[/b] during Steam's winter sale.

Muskets with [i]relatively[/i] long reload times, men marching into battle at the sound of drums, fifes and violins - Played by specific classes, Officers leading others to victory or to an inevitable death and mighty warships from the golden age of sail are some of the things that you’ll find in Holdfast: Nations At War. This all happens with over [b]150 players[/b] per server!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

Things have been extremely busy here at the office! Keep on reading the blog post as we have a few rather [b]exciting announcements[/b] to make. Your help with [b]spreading the word[/b] around about the sale would be greatly appreciated. We’re doing our very best to bring this genre of Musket Warfare games that we all love in the limelight.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/220e523b5646525cf9b0666bdaf4c0b44ac2ad5e.jpg[/img]

[h1]We’re Growing The Team![/h1]
There’s going to be an [b]instrumental addition to the team[/b] coming [b]next month[/b]! We have been listening very closely as to what the community wants. Improvements upon melee combat, the introduction of cavalry, more naval mechanics or even a map editor all require a programmer’s skill set to be developed.

As such, we are now embarking on a major investment towards the success of Holdfast: Nations At War - [b]Another programmer[/b] will be joining the team! [b]Dylan[/b] ‘Monroy’ Vassallo, will be working closely with our lead programmer Andreas ‘Dreas’ Grech to bring new and improved gameplay oriented features to the game.

There’ll also be another [b]3D Artist[/b] working on the game. We’ll do an official introduction for both of these good fellows later on next month.

Here’s a look at our progress on the new office space we mentioned in our previous blog post. We’re still awaiting the delivery of hardware but other than a few remaining aesthetics, everything’s pretty much done!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/8076ed6083a86ea1d09a465cad69a242633a1fe1.jpg[/img]

[h1]More About The Next Game Update![/h1]
The upcoming update is not ready just yet. We're [b]working very hard[/b] towards its release! You’ll be seeing four new maps - two of which are specifically designed to cater for line battle gameplay, improvements to the free flight camera, the ability to go into melee combat while crouching, smoother transitions when going from running to aiming, other direct improvements towards melee combat and more.

This will only be the [b]beginning of our work[/b] on [b]improving the melee[/b] - There’ll be a lot more to come after the next patch. There has also been ample progress on preparing the game so it can be translated into other languages. We want to make sure that the game is widely available to everyone.
 
Let’s move forward with a few more sneak peaks, shall we? We have been gathering feedback from various regiments (clans) and event hosts to improve on our current designs for line battle maps. [b]Desert Plains[/b] is another line battle map that will be available in the next patch.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/c3c6d7bce04cda1ea58027d6ae8e7654a2c61bc1.jpg[/img]

A [b]new class[/b]! Chosen from the strongest and largest soldiers, [b]Grenadiers[/b] will excel at killing other infantry units. More information about the Grenadier class will be made available in the patch notes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4e093221759d07750d75f9c3b78a41ac1f239176.jpg[/img]

We won’t be revealing everything just yet! There’s more to the update than what we’ve shown above. In the spirit of this festive season, we’ll be providing you with another hint as to what you might be seeing get into the game relatively soon.

[b][i]Loud and glorious. They are coming! But what could it be?[/i][/b]

[h1]Join A Crew or Regiment! Clans.[/h1]
Interested in organised play, firing volleys in a formation and all that goodness? Join a crew or regiment of your choice by posting an application in one of the threads on our forums. These clans partake in events which brings the game to a whole new level.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?board=6.0]Apply to join a crew or regiment here.[/url][/b]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/582f5424607852347ed4f07ddc1628fd33a46425.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for your support. Be sure to keep forwarding us your feedback and suggestions.

There's a lot more in store for [b]Holdfast: Nations At War[/b] in 2018! Stay tuned. From all of us here at [b]Anvil Game Studios[/b], we would like to wish you the best of holidays and as always, may good health be yours.

Feel free to give us a follow on our [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/holdfastgame]Facebook[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://twitter.com/holdfastgame]Twitter[/url][/b].

[b][i]- Anvil Game Studios[/i][/b]

notes.title: Office space. Prussia and the upcoming update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/e7c8404895f26bb37131a7eaafa491019a896d9c.png[/img]

Things have been very busy the past few weeks setting up a new office space. We’re investing time into that with the sole purpose of growing the team! However, that doesn’t mean that we have halted our work on the next update.

[h1]The Upcoming Update[/h1]
You’ll be seeing at least two new maps (maybe a third one as well), improvements to the free flight camera, the ability to go into melee combat while crouching, smoother transitions when going from running to aiming, other direct improvements towards melee combat, and more.
 
This will only be the [b]beginning[/b] of our work on improving the melee - There’ll be a lot more to come after the next patch. There has also been ample progress on preparing the game so it can be translated into other languages. We want to make sure that the game is widely available to everyone.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/b97eac5a436d3d465fec05b6359cdc05ea9e6b13.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Next Nation. Prussia[/h1]
It’s a good time to start showing off the [b]Prussians[/b]! Here’s the very first look at one of the uniforms for the line infantry class - More to follow. We’re also head hunting voice actors as this faction will be requiring an entirely new set of voices along with tunes for the musicians.
 
[b]Which regiments from the Prussian faction would you most like to see in the game?[/b] Let us know! Historical references are also greatly welcome.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/c05b5c29e9bd5bd824ea107cf944a16294b0e1ac.jpg[/img]

Don’t let the new faction fool you, work isn’t finished on UK or France either. We have more units for the existing British and French nations done and ready, but we’ll be leaving them as a little surprise for future content.

[h1]IndieDB Awards. Cast Your Vote For Holdfast: NaW[/h1]
Holdfast: Nations At War is in indieDB's Top 100! We now need your help for one last push.

Visit the below link to go cast your vote. Please do help us spread the word around!

[b][url=http://www.indiedb.com/groups/2017-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote57505]Cast your vote for Holdfast: Nations At War![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/1dd181de313fe34766460dd44b41ee07ea52a3af.png[/img]

[h1]Growing The Team. More Office Space[/h1]
We promised to grow the team and we’ll be doing just that. Everyone would love to see more content-filled updates!
 
Therefore, we are now in need of more office space. Things are progressing smoothly but there are a few more things that need to be done - Segregating the office’s electricity outlets from the rest of the appliances, awaiting the delivery of furniture due to next week, hardware is being shipped over from overseas (our current PCs crash at random intervals and that doesn’t exactly make for the best of productivity) and network all the devices.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/8d64ad93db0298f3246325330996e3f2567d7d40.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/43c2d81852e45ecfd5afe30e80005a374b68932e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/6312fd27014257e412f0886aaa989f2c4cc4f8c5.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Community. Events & Regiments[/h1]
More updates to the game focused on promoting organised play are also being considered. Besides our ongoing efforts on improving melee combat, we have other things planned out such as more maps to cater for the regimental style of gameplay for instance.
 
Here’s a look at one of the new maps we’ll be introducing in the next patch! We’ve gathered feedback on our previous designs for line battle maps from various regiments and event hosts to create a second variation of the [b]Grassy Plains[/b] maps. Similar maps will follow after the third map has been finalised.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4c472740a3bf44b8c3f3c0cd0060260512bca8a6.jpg[/img]

Every Saturday, a [b]Public Linebattle[/b] event is being hosted of which [b]regiments[/b] and [b]public players[/b] alike are more than welcome to attend! Join in on the “[b]Saturday Public Linebattle Event[/b]” server between [b]19[/b] and [b]21 UTC[/b], follow the ruleset and you’re good to go.

We’ve been filling up the server during the past 3 weeks! For the next one, a second server will be launched to care for the demand.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=2861.0]Participate in the public linebattle.[/url][/b]

Don’t shy away from chatting with us. We’re very open to suggestions! Once again, thank you very much for your support and may good health be yours.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]

notes.title: Official server linebattle map rotation. Cast your vote!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/76e1319c8cd0f4ca8bf5a0843cb6bfc3f6ea7cc9.png[/img]

We have another question that needs answering today! [b]Should we make line battle maps rotate more frequently in the official server map rotation?[/b] This means that you’ll be seeing them more often. 

Linebattle maps such as Tahir Desert, Grassy Plains and Snowy Plains feature a lot of [b]open spaces[/b] that allows players to organise and [b]fight in formations[/b]. We’ll be introducing another map focusing on this style of gameplay in the next update!

Head over to the polling booth on our forums to cast your vote. You need to register an account on our forums in order to do so.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=3164]Go to the Polling Booth - Cast your vote today![/url][/b]

Another set of line battle maps will be included in the rotation if we receive the go-ahead from the community. There needs to be [b]70%[/b] more ‘Yes’ than ‘No’ votes for this to pass.

[h1]An Overview Of The Map Rotation[/h1]
Here’s how the map rotation on the official servers hosting the Army Battlefield game mode looks like. 
[olist]
[*]Sharpton (New Map Present In The Next Patch)
[*]Canyon
[*]Arendan River
[*]Highlands
[*]Tahir Desert (Linebattle Map)
[*]Fort Christina
[*]Crosshills
[*]Desert Ruins
[*]Spanish Farm
[*]Grassy Plains or Snowy Plains (Linebattle Maps)
[/olist]

[h1]Holdfast: NaW. The Next Update[/h1]
You’ll be seeing at least two new maps, improvements to the free flight camera, the ability to go into melee combat while crouching, smoother transitions when going from running to aiming, other direct improvements towards melee combat and more. 

This will only be the [b]beginning[/b] of our work on improving the melee - There’ll be a lot more to come after the next patch.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/02dd954500fd475160d374c05170f6177b57654b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/bf40a851c5ecf880201e48f504ca119048de1882.jpg[/img]

[h1]Prussia! Community Vote[/h1]
We’re quite sure that a lot of you are already aware that Prussia has passed the poll with almost a [b]thousand[/b] votes from the community. We're extremely looking forward to starting work on this! You’ll be hearing more from us as soon as some other units we have planned for the existing British and French factions are finalised. 

All we can say for now is that things will be getting [i]relatively[/i] loud and glorious.

[b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=2753.0]View the previous poll.[/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/8965afe1cf5f60c13421c53c698656146488ce9f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Saturday Public Linebattle - Community Event[/h1]
Interested in attending an [b]organised event[/b]? The public line battle takes place every [b]Saturday[/b] between [b]19 and 21 UTC[/b]. Officers lead others to victory or to an inevitable death whilst fighting in formations!

We highly recommend you check out one of these events hosted by the community. They serve as a great introduction to organised gameplay.

notes.title: Holdfast: NaW - New Map & Freeroam Camera! Changelog 9
notes.content:
Holdfast: Nations At War has been updated! For this update you’ll be seeing a brand [b]new map[/b], a [b]free roam ‘spectator’ camera[/b], an option to [b]toggle the entirety of the User Interface[/b], [b]surround sound support[/b] and many other changes and additions to the game. This update also includes more [b]backend work[/b] in preparation for direct improvements on [b]melee combat[/b].

Improvements on [b]stability[/b] has been a primary focus of ours during this week's patch.

[h1]A New Map! Canyon[/h1]
Another map for Holdfast: Nations At War is here! [b]Canyon[/b] is designed to promote close quarter engagements through bridges, tunnels and other pathways that can be found around the map.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/cf832750da029e5e65077da71e1c4108d564b791.jpg[/img]

[h1]Free-Roam Spectator Camera[/h1]
You now have the option to see the battle unfold through a [b]free-roam spectator camera[/b]! This will continue to further facilitate the administration of events. 

You can control your ascend and descend through a selection of customisable key-binds, speed up with the shift key as well as adjust its field of view. The camera itself collides and bounces off the terrain and objects around the map. It can also go through doors and windows.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/7c6565fc6e1a24ee5213552b14c52deb0f954c4a.jpg[/img]

We’re very much open to ideas on how we can continue improving upon the free-roam camera.

[h1]Toggle User Interface[/h1]
The entirety of the in-game [b]User Interface[/b] is [b]toggle-able[/b] through the ‘ScrollLock’ key. We'll be crossing this one off of our development roadmap.

[h1]Surround Sound Support[/h1]
Holdfast: Nations At War supports [b]surround sound[/b]! You can select from a variety of modes specific to your setup through the Audio options. The red icon to the right of the drop down menu is used to test your speaker setup in the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/188d07d749e8a4cb9706215b1cf77f4e84c916c4.jpg[/img]

There have also been other changes and additions. The full changelog for this update can be found further down below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/81e7ab7036a923e50d30e8782de64fd494642dd9.png[/img]

[H1]Holdfast: Nations At War Is 15% Off (Halloween Sale)[/h1]
Holdfast: Nations At War is [b]15% off[/b] for a [b]limited time[/b] during Steam's Seasonal Halloween sale. Play with your friends! Lead your men into battle as an officer, show your musical genius with the drummer, fifer or violinist, captain and crew a naval vessel and more.

We want to continue [b]strengthening the following[/b] behind the game as it [b]grows[/b] and [b]develops[/b].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/589290

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 9 - Game Version 0.9.6511.1337[/b]
[list]
[*]A new map has been added into the game! [b]Canyon[/b].
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/de090ac729ee3bca632c4ca9a682683c2b1ca9db.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/37a415ba7ebe6e8cc35bf0512d24a5a87356154a.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Added a new Free-roam Spectator camera. This will allow spectating players to get a better bird's eye view of the unfolding battles. Controls for the Free-roam Spectator camera are customizable from the Keys Options menu. You can also adjust a variety of settings related to the Free-roam camera from the Game settings.
[*]Added Speaker Mode settings in the Audio Options to allow for surround sound setups. The Speaker Mode options are Mono, Stereo, Quad, 5 Speaker Surround, 5.1 Surround, 7.1 Surround and Dolby Pro Logic 5.1. The red icon to the right of the drop down menu is used to test your speaker setup.
[*]Added a new key bind option to toggle on and off the entirety of the User Interface in the game. The default key is set to ‘ScrollLock’.  You can use this key to toggle the entire set of in-game elements without individually toggling them from the Game Options menu.
[*]When friendly fire is disabled, ships will now no longer take damage from other friendly ships.
[*]Decreased the amount of simultaneous entries in the kill feed to prevent it from taking up too much screen space.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Riflemen's chat channel was not working as intended.
[*]Fixed an issue where the reinforcements and scores that are shown in the top part of the screen were not showing the correct values when a player is spectating before he spawns the first time
[*]Fixed an issue where admin-killing (slaying) a player on the Assault Game Mode still allowed them to respawn back in the game.
[*]The grass on Grassy Plains is now slightly darker.
[*]Changed the spawning positions on Grassy Plains for the Army Assault game mode.
[*]Fixed an issue with the snow particle effects.
[*]Fixed an issue with gaps on the rock formations of the Desert Ruins map.
[*]The admin 'broadcast' message has been re-designed to match the rest of the User Interface.
[*][b]Canyon[/b] has been added to the Official Server map rotation.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]In the Naval Battlefield game mode, an issue might occur after a relatively long time which causes other players to start floating or become invisible on a ship. This is an engine side issue and we're currently awaiting for a fix. Kindly restart your game if this occurs.
[/list]

We'll be including functionality that displays player names when using the free roam camera in the upcoming patch.

Once again, thank you very much for your support! May good health be yours.

[i][b]- Anvil Game Studios[/b][/i]
