notes.title: Musicians! In-game footage
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/77f14dd8b00cdb7a0287a52dd26c086085d98880.png[/img]

Drum roll, please. You heard me! Make wood hit leather because today we are taking a look at the musician class. This time around, we also coupled it with some in-game footage to give this class the proper attention it deserves.

[b]In-game footage:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D6guIAV4Yl4
The objectives user interface to the left of the screen, the buff icons as well as the menu to select music from shown in the video, are all placeholders.

[h1]Play me some tunes! How does it work?[/h1]
The music system is designed with cooperation in mind. A team-mate playing a tune in your vicinity can be joined at any point in the tune. Tracks are selected from a list that are colour coded to show which songs are being played around you (yellow) as well as which song you are currently playing (green).

[h1]The current selection[/h1]
We have selected a list of music associated with the era from upbeat tunes like Rule Britannia to slower ballads such as Over The Hills and Far Away. Each tune has an accompanying percussive element to it for joint play. The idea was to represent many iconic sounds and to have players share this experience with each other.

The British Grenadiers
Lilliburlero
Men of Harlech
Rule Britannia
Over The Hills and Far Away
Hearts of Oak
Spanish Ladies
La Victoire est à Nous
Pas Cadencé
Auprès de ma Blonde
Le Chant de L'Oignon
Cadet Rouselle
Trois Jeunes Tambours
A drum roll
A selection of tunes by Bach for the violins.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[h1]Fifer[/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]

It takes powerful lungs and a constitution of stone to play a fife into battle. This class supports nearby allied troops with bonuses.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/26805642e7c7da1b122d500ed207ae85042707df.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/aaecd39b55131c94e2a62acbadfdb72c8dd6fa85.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Musician[/i] - Inspiring presence. You increase firearm reloading speed of nearby allies when playing music.

[i]Resilient[/i] - A strong sense of duty. This trait slightly increases the HP of the fifer to give him a better chance of survival in battle.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Pistol[/i] - Single-shot muzzle loaded firearm limited by its short range. Pistols can be reloaded more quickly when compared to other firearms. A solid defensive choice for a front-line support unit.

[i]Sword & Sabre Briquet[/i] - The French musicians come equipped with a sabre briquet while the British have a sword available at their disposal. Sometimes the fighting gets uncomfortably close, even for a musician.

[b]Equipment[/b]
[i]Fife[/i] - There is a reason that a high pitched mouth instrument was used on the battlefield; you can hear the higher notes playing across the field of battle despite the deeper sounds of fierce conflict. Pierce the orchestra of war with your tunes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[h1]Drummer[/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]

An old favourite; Drums are the percussion of war, inspiring warriors with their thudding tempo since man first learned to kill. Like the fifer, nearby allied troops are supported with bonuses.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/48bac9296d019d8d75c98afdd6a6f924588ab66e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/6eb21ea5d555a2bb6f86d69a09c3badbe64efd9c.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Musician[/i] - Inspiring presence. You increase firearm reloading speed of nearby allies when playing music.

[i]Resilient[/i] - A strong sense of duty. This trait slightly increases the HP of the drummer to give him a better chance of survival in battle.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Pistol[/i] - Single-shot muzzle loaded firearm limited by its short range. Pistols can be reloaded more quickly when compared to other firearms. A solid defensive choice for a front-line support unit.

[i]Sword & Sabre Briquet[/i] - The French musicians come equipped with a sabre briquet while the British have a sword available at their disposal. Sometimes the fighting gets uncomfortably close, even for a musician.

[b]Equipment[/b]
[i]Drums[/i] - Thud, bang, crash and WAR! You know that chaos is around the corner when the war drums start to beat the percussion of battle.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[h1]Violinist[/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]

The violinist isn’t just for jaunty dancing tunes in small taverns, ship crews need their morale regular kept high by their ship’s musician prancing around the deck. We have a variety of deckhand outfits which the violinist will use. Keep the ship moving!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/3f81e6abc6ad9d966369cb5520008d91033db67d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/08b070e54b5a78b03780bfad2c76778ae6c0f070.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Musician[/i] - Inspiring presence. You increase firearm reloading speed of nearby allies when playing music. Violins make infantry more accurate, everyone knows it!

[i]Resilient[/i] - A strong sense of duty. This trait slightly increases the HP of the violinist to give him a better chance of survival in battle.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Pistol[/i] - Single-shot muzzle loaded firearm limited by its short range. Pistols can be reloaded more quickly when compared to other firearms. A solid defensive choice for a front-line support unit.

[i]Cutlass[/i] - A brutal slashing weapon primarily associated with naval troops. A scary choice for a close encounter, stay away from the violinist’s sword arm.

[b]Equipment[/b]
[i]Violin[/i] - A slender neck, gracefully curved body and smooth finish. In the hands of a master, it sings like the haunting Siren’s call. In the hands of an unskilled layman, it screeches like chalk on a wall.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[h1]Piano[/h1]
Here’s a little extra something! You can find these scattered across a variety of maps, find them and become a master pianist in the midst of the chaos of war.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/6c907dba829baa298ba7849bfeb03dee7532876f.jpg[/img]


This was a brief glimpse into a selection of different musician classes that we have currently in the game. We have plans to increase this roster as the game progresses. On top of that our hope is to expand the music available to play by hiring professional musicians to introduce later in the game’s development. Our priority at the moment is creating a stable, cohesive build for an early access release.

Currently, our thoughts for the benefits musicians give to players is that when a group plays together, a further bonus to friendly player’s reload experience will be applied. We are keen to hear feedback on this system and others like it from our early access adopters. Feel free to head over to our forums [b][i][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=780]here[/url][/i][/b] to join in the discussion.

Once again thank you for taking the time to read this and know that it brings us one week closer to getting the game into your hands!

May good health be yours.

notes.title: Line & Light Infantry. The rank and file
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/2cfa175c6d4e5b61ef3ab6c704b19f44970a1f78.png[/img]

Greetings ladies and gentlemen and welcome to another developer blog for Holdfast: Nations At War. Today we’ll be talking about two classes which are perhaps considered to be some of the most iconic units commonly available to be played on land based scenarios - The line and light infantryman.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/d871d4eb19f4b4d8f774da9fe340bcfb73182860.jpg[/img]


[h1]Line Infantry[/h1]
[i]Role: Offense[/i]

Part of the rank and file. Excels at killing other infantry.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/7a5c5f66d2803c72a39f7c4d9c8abff0f4001516.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/0b4404f08e068f8f12eaa7719c3a224ccc90c4d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Bayoneted Musket[/i] - Muzzle loaded firearms equipped with a pointy end. They’re your best bet at making quick work of your enemy if things get up close and personal.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[h1]Light Infantry[/h1]
[i]Role: Offense[/i]

Quick-footed skirmishers. Make use of their increase in running speed to navigate around the battlefield.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/9d7a6b3d6cd291c649167daf56041ec9df3aaa36.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/f70427fd13beca50806dbb873d11870218833c46.jpg[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Skirmisher[/i] - Drilled with knowledge on skirmishing tactics. Your musket reload speed is slightly increased and your melee combat damage slightly decreased.

[i]Light-Footed[/i] - Fast and nimble. Your running speed is slightly increased.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Bayoneted Musket[/i] - Muzzle loaded firearms equipped with a pointy end. They’re your best bet at making quick work of your enemy if things get up close and personal.

[i]Sword[/i] - The French light infantryman comes equipped with a sabre briquet. 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[h1]New Firearms[/h1]
The list of available weaponry to combat your enemies with is set to become much greater than before thanks to the feedback from our community.  

We are currently working on seven new firearms to compliment classes in the army military branch. No longer will these classes be equipped with sea service muskets!


[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
In our previous developer blog, we have mentioned that we’ve set up a discord channel for our community to reside in. It’s been great getting to know you all. We do hope to see you there soon if you haven’t made up your mind yet!

You can join in the community discord channel down below:
https://discordapp.com/invite/XsHBUNs


In our next developer blog, we’ll be revealing a support class which will surely be a sight to behold.

Until next time, feel free to join in the discussion for the following blog [i][b][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=768.0]here[/url][/b][/i] and may good health be yours.

notes.title: Sailors & Marines. Crew your ship
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/be7ab092b2e768f05d68bd2b6ca9eb68d533d0d9.png[/img]

Greetings ladies and gentlemen. Welcome back to another developer blog for Holdfast: Nations At War. The selection of classes available for the navy military branch shouldn’t go amiss! Today we’ll be revealing two classes which are essential to crewing your ship -The Sailor and the Marine.

Seeing as this is our first time we’re revealing some of the classes available to be played on our ships, it would be a great opportunity to start by announcing that swimming will be present in Holdfast: Nations At War. Certain classes will be able to swim for a temporary amount of time while others won’t.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/3a075f7c3ee163a5946189b3e16a99e1b40f6779.jpg[/img]

We have previously given an overview of the entire [i][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/News/Post?p=1010]class system[/url][/i] in one of our blogs. For a better understanding of what it all entails, we suggest that you give it a read.


[h1]Sailor[/h1]
[i]Role: Support[/i]

The main brunt and force of a ship’s crew. Excels at doing various tasks on a ship.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/67394261d4d85b48b1ab06003edc5c37a49cedeb.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/0d6d29dee66aa2a009d92ae9118a2a8c0c0502ee.jpg[/img]

[b]Abilities[/b]
[i]Deckhand[/i] - Drilled with knowledge on how to operate a ship. You are able to raise and lower sail, launch rowboats and do a variety of other tasks.

[i]Artillery Basics[/i] - Trained with the use of cannons. You are able to fire them.

[i]Swim[/i] - Familiar with the ways of the sea. You can swim for a short amount of time.

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Hasty Swimmer[/i] - Lightly equipped. Your swimming speed is slightly increased.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Pistol[/i] - Single-shot muzzle loaded firearm limited by its short range. Pistols can be reloaded more quickly when compared to other firearms.

[i]Melee Weapon Selection[/i] - Equip a 1-Handed Axe, Cutlass or a Boarding Pike.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]


[h1]Marine[/h1]
[i]Role: Offense[/i]

Equipped with a bayoneted musket, they excel at killing other infantry. You will find the Marine class present in greater numbers aboard ships during an assault on coastal emplacements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/4afc21e70eca8e4a49881471ea391ee11fba7ccb.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/732d2bf9e16ed0c9ead73b853cfc159a214e9007.jpg[/img]

[b]Abilities[/b]
[i]Guard[/i] - Duty bound to guard the high-command. You passively increase the HP of nearby allied captains.

[i]Swim[/i] - Familiar with the ways of the sea. You can swim for a short amount of time.

[b]Traits[/b]
[i]Bayonet Specialisation[/i] - Excels with using bayonets. Your melee damage when wielding a bayoneted musket is slightly increased.

[b]Weaponry[/b]
[i]Bayoneted Musket[/i] - Muzzle loaded firearms equipped with a pointy end. They’re your best bet at making quick work of your enemy if things get up close and personal.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/56ca75be1b6108ef265b7843fdfbf534a0e149b5.png[/img]

[h1]Giveaway - Play Before Early Access[/h1]
We have recently announced that we will be providing some members of our community with a chance to play and test Holdfast: Nations At War before it is out on Early Access this year.

If you’d like to give it a shot, be sure to like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/holdfastgame]Facebook[/url] page and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/holdfastgame]Twitter[/url].


Do you have any ideas or suggestions for these classes? Join in the discussion on our developer blog [b][i] [url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/index.php?topic=686]here[/url][/i][/b] and tell us about it. 

That is all we have for today folks, stay tuned for more developer blogs on Holdfast: Nations At War!

notes.title: Holdfast: NaW on Steam. Play before early access!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/6505f99bc79330d8c9ea269bcbda26d68150e690.png[/img]

[i]The smell of black powder leaves an acrid taste in your mouth. The enemy are so close now you can see patterned lace on their uniforms. You hear and feel the men beside you matching your movements, directed by the shouted orders. Another volley. Too late to run. Can you stand?[/i]

Holdfast: Nations at War is now visible on the Steam store. While you cannot purchase it as of yet being on the store means two things to you. The first is that much of the work required to integrate the game into the Steam family has been completed and therefore we are that much closer to an Early Access release. The second is that it now opens up Steam to be another platform for both discussion and the release of further news.

You’re more than welcome to give us a follow and add us to your wishlist.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28169799/46ddc6590d2c206fd5b1d927864d7298fdc476c6.jpg[/img]
 

[h1]Giveaway Announcement! - Play Before Early Access[/h1]
[i]Your very own chance to play Holdfast: Nations At War before Early Access![/i]

We will be hosting both testing and promotional events before our release into Early Access this year. To do this we need players and therefore we will be handing out a number of beta keys on our social media.

Be sure to like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/holdfastgame]Facebook[/url] page and give us a follow on [url=https://twitter.com/holdfastgame]Twitter[/url] so you don’t miss this opportunity! Start spreading the word around because when we host the giveaway, you will also have to involve your friends.


[h1]Pricing[/h1]
One of our most common questions is the price. We are now in a position to announce that Holdfast: NaW will be 19.99 EUR when it is out on Early Access.


We’re working as hard as humanly possible to bring Holdfast: Nations At War into your hands. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

Feel free to join us on our forums [b][i][url=http://www.holdfastgame.com/forum/]here[/url][/i][/b]
